plugins.description: Plugins for DeepSeek Harness: memory and system prompt, search routing, interactive visual cards, prompt rewriting.
plugins.readme_text: # DSH 插件集 **中文** | [English](#english) 一套用于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 桌面版的插件。每个独立成仓库、独立安装 —— 只取你需要的即可。 ## 插件一览 | 插件 | 作用 | |---|---| | [dsh-memory-system-prompt](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-memory-system-prompt) | 全局记忆（AI 主动写入与读取）+ 用户级系统提示词。索引每轮注入但不占上下文。 | | [dsh-web-search-router](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-web-search-router) | 按模型通道分流搜索：官方账号走 DeepSeek 官方搜索，其它通道走你的自建服务。失败时给出可读原因，而不是一句 500。 | | [dsh-visual-card](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-visual-card) | AI 交一段 HTML，在对话里渲染成可交互卡片 —— 能点、能键盘操作、能全屏、能导出。 | | [dsh-prompt-crafter](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-prompt-crafter) | 发送键旁一个按钮，把草稿改写成更好的提示词。三档力度；内置免费模型通道，零配置零费用，不可用时自动回退。 | ## 安装 **推荐：内置插件安装程序。** 打开「设置 → 内置插件」，粘贴包名，点安装，再重启应用： ``` dsh-visual-card ``` 安装程序会自动写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不用手改任何文件。 命令行方式（先完全退出应用）： ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-visual-card ``` 然后把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启应用。 > 四个包都已发布到 npm，当前版本 `1.0.0`。 ## 共同的取舍 这几个插件针对同一版 Harness 编写，有几处一致的判断： - **Host 与 Client 分开。** 凡是涉及模型可见状态的（工具、路由、提示词装配）都在 `index.js` 里跑在 Host；用户看得见的在 `client.js` 里填槽位。改 Host 要重启，改 Client 通常刷新页面即可。 - **填槽位，不改造。** 都不修改宿主原有界面，只往宿主已经渲染的槽位里注册内容，所以 Harness 升级不会悄悄把它们弄坏。 - **失败要说清楚。** 配置不对时，提示直接指出该去改哪个设置，而不是甩一段堆栈。 - **设置在 `~/.dsh/` 下。** 每个插件各占一个目录，卸载包不会删数据，重装后自动接上。 ## 许可 MIT，各仓库内有独立副本。 --- **English** | [中文](#chinese) A set of plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Desktop. Each lives in its own repository and installs independently — take only the ones you want. ## The plugins | Plugin | What it does | |---|---| | [dsh-memory-system-prompt](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-memory-system-prompt) | Global memory the model writes and reads itself, plus a user-level system prompt. The index is injected every turn without consuming context. | | [dsh-web-search-router](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-web-search-router) | Routes search by model channel: official DeepSeek search on account routes, your own endpoint elsewhere. Readable failure reasons instead of a bare 500. | | [dsh-visual-card](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-visual-card) | The model hands over HTML and it renders as an interactive card in the conversation — clickable, keyboard-operable, fullscreen, exportable. | | [dsh-prompt-crafter](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-prompt-crafter) | One button next to the send key rewrites your draft into a better prompt. Three levels; bundled free model channel, zero cost and zero setup, falls back automatically. | ## Install **The built-in plugin installer is the recommended way.** Open Settings → Built-in Plugins, paste the package name, press install, then restart the app: ``` dsh-visual-card ``` The installer writes the entry into `dsh.profile.bundles` for you; no manual file edits. From the command line (quit the app completely first): ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-visual-card ``` Add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart the app. > All four packages are published to npm at `1.0.0`. ## Common ground These plugins were built against the same Harness and share a few deliberate decisions: - **Host versus client split.** Anything that touches model-visible state (tools, routing, prompt assembly) runs in `index.js` on the host; anything the user sees runs in `client.js` and fills a slot. Host changes need a restart, client changes usually just a page refresh. - **Slots, not forks.** None of them modify the shipped UI. They register into slots the host already renders, so a Harness update cannot silently break them. - **Readable failures.** When something is misconfigured, the message names the setting to fix, rather than surfacing a stack trace. - **Settings live in `~/.dsh/`.** Each plugin keeps its own directory there, so uninstalling the package leaves the data behind and reinstalling picks it up again. ## License MIT. See each repository for its own copy.

plugins.description: dsh 插件：AI 选择题自动加一项「幸运方块」随机决定 + 说「回滚」撤销；界面上的骰子按钮长按挖穿即触发随机事件（写论文/我的世界概念合成/冷笑话/冷知识/时事新闻/弹窗表演/蓝屏屏保），整体致敬《赛博朋克 2077》的四季宝
plugins.readme_text:
# 幸运方块 (dsh-lucky-block)

一个 dsh 插件，同时工作在 dsh web 与 dsh desktop。两件事：

1. **幸运方块选项** —— AI 向你提选择题时，每个问题的选项末尾会自动多出一个「幸运方块」。
   选它，就随机替你挑一个选项、或把几个选项揉成一个新方案，全随机。
   不满意？说一句「回滚」（或打 `/rollback`），立刻回到上一版本。
2. **幸运方块按钮** —— 屏幕角落一个可拖动、可锁定的我的世界幸运方块（16×16 原版方块面贴图）。
   闲着没事就戳它一下：**左键单点**零成本，抽弹窗表演 / 假蓝屏 / 今日运气 / 冷知识 / 冷笑话；
   **长按** 1.4 秒挖穿它，伴随裂纹、碎裂粒子和原版 Minecraft 挖石头声，接着它会在你的
   默认工作区自动开一个新会话，**全程不需要你做任何事**地随机写篇论文 / 扒几条新闻 / 整理待办。
   松手时方块若离屏幕边缘够近（48px 以内）会**自动吸附贴边**。

它会说话。所有随机事件都套着一层固定的说话腔调：短句、机器口吻、偶尔损你一句。
这套腔调是纯文本的，参数在 `lib/persona.js` 的 `DEFAULT_PERSONA` 里，
可以用配置里的 `persona` 整段换成你自己写的性格。
它**从不往会话里写东西**，所以绝不会污染你的对话历史。

## 两个池：单击零成本，长按才花钱

脚本现在分成**两个互相独立的池**，触发方式不同，抽的东西也不同：

| 触发 | 代价 | 池 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **左键单点** | 零 token、零延迟、**不建会话** | 弹窗 / 蓝屏 / 抽签 / 冷知识 / 冷笑话 / 音乐 |
| **长按挖满**（1.4 秒） | 开新会话、调模型 | 论文 / 新闻 / 待办整理 |

单点是手滑也会发生的动作，所以它不该有成本；长按是明确意图，才值得花 token。
分成两个池而不是一个池加过滤，是为了让两边的权重能独立调节 —— 否则往单击池
里加十条音频，会把长按事件的命中率一起稀释掉。

### 单击池（6 个事件，权重合计 16）

| 概率 | 事件 | 类型 | 会做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 12.5% | 无害弹窗表演 | 视觉 | 界面上连弹 24 个无意义提示框，再按创建顺序倒序全部关掉 |
| 12.5% | 蓝屏屏保（60 秒） | 视觉 | 全屏显示一份仿 Windows 蓝屏，60 秒后自动恢复，按 ESC 提前结束 |
| 18.8% | 抽今日运气 | 本地 | 抽一档签文：鸿运齐天 / 大吉 / 中吉 / 小吉 / 平 / 凶。**不调 AI**，附「无科学依据，仅供参考」 |
| 25.0% | 随机冷知识闲聊 | 本地 | 从 818 条本地冷知识库里抽 1~3 条，一次说完 |
| 18.8% | 冷笑话专场 | 本地 | 从 353 条本地笑话库里抽 1~2 条 |
| 12.5% | 随机播放音频 | 本地 | 从曲库里放一首（现在只有 42 秒副歌试水）。受「长按挖掘音效」开关影响 |

### 长按池（3 个事件，权重合计 8）

| 概率 | 事件 | 类型 | 会做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 37.5% | 随机选题写论文 | AI | 随机词条拼出题目（如「边缘计算 × 古籍数字化 × 的鲁棒性研究」），写 4 节正文并落盘到 `lucky-block-papers/<hash>.md` |
| 37.5% | 时事新闻速览 | AI | **联网**检索 3 条最近真实新闻，每条一句事实 + 一句点评 + 来源链接；查不到就直说，绝不编 |
| 25.0% | 随机整理待办 | AI | 列出工作区最近改的 5 个文件，随机分「紧急 / 不紧急」并明说自己不可信 |

**单击池六个全部零 token、不建会话、零延迟** —— 点下去立刻有反应。

「抽今日运气」**一天只抽一次**：当天再点，返回的还是那一签，并在末尾注明
「今天已经抽过了，明天再来吧。」。状态记在
`$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-lucky-block/fortune-state.json`，删掉这个文件就等于当天重抽。

「抽今日运气」的签文权重是刻意偏吉的：**吉类合计 90%**（鸿运齐天 5% / 大吉 26% /
中吉 33% / 小吉 26%），平 9.9%，凶只有 **0.1%**；
而且**「凶」的正文是反着写的**（「从某种角度来说，你运气还挺好 —— 今天该踩的坑都提前踩完了」），
抽到下签也能笑一下。这个插件是用来打发时间的，不是用来给人添堵的。

### 音频事件

`lib/audio-tracks.json` 里是曲库，往这个 json 填 `{ "file": "xxx.ogg", "title": "显示名" }`、
把文件丢进 `lib/audio/`，事件就自动开始参与抽取 —— **不用改代码**。
清单为空时这条事件权重为 0、整条摘掉，不会掷出一个什么都不播的空事件。
文件名只接受 `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` + `.ogg|.mp3`，防目录穿越。

曲库有两份查找位置，**用户目录优先**：先看
`$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-lucky-block/audio-tracks.json`，没有再退回随包的
`lib/audio-tracks.json`。第三方想扩展曲库时不用改插件包本体（插件升级会覆盖回去）。

已经有一首**《Never Gonna Give You Up》的 42 秒副歌**在包里试水 —— 只保留高潮段，
这是刻意切过的：完整版会让「随手点一下」变成一次三分钟的停留。切法写在
[`lib/audio/README.md`](<lib/audio/README.md>)。

### 骰子会话里你只会看到一行字

开新会话的那 3 个事件，**用户消息只有一行**（`🎲 随机事件：时事新闻速览`），
人格设定和任务正文走的是**系统提示**，不会糊在你眼前。

这样做纯粹是为了观感 —— 之前用户消息里塞着几百字的指令墙，点进会话第一眼就是它。
需要说明的是，宿主没有「发一条不显示的消息」这种能力（`PromptContentPart` 只有
text / image / file 三种，没有任何可见性字段），所以这里不是把消息藏起来，
而是**根本不把它发成消息**。

清单可用 `node tools/list-events.mjs` 随时重新生成 —— 它直接从 `lib/index.js`
的 `buildEvents()` 里解析并按池分组，不会和代码漂移。

## 设置面板（右键方块 → 设置…）

| 开关 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 长按挖掘音效 | 循环挖掘声 + 碎裂声。关掉就完全静音 |

面板分三块：

**方块外观** —— 大小（24~128 像素）、图案（幸运方块 / 命令方块 / TNT / 南瓜 /
自定义图片）、圆角、描边宽度与颜色、投影、背景。改动**立即生效并落盘**，
不用点保存。图片只接受 `data:image/` 或 `http(s)://` 开头的地址——
`blob:` 在这个缓存域里用不了、`file:` 会被 CSP 拦下来，两种都会让图片裂开。
「恢复默认」走的和手动改是同一套校验，所以恢复回来的一定是能用的值。

**随机事件** —— 每条事件一个复选框加一个权重输入框。**关掉一条事件时权重会同时写 0**，
两个字段说同一件事，不会出现「权重还在但事件没了」的假象。权重上限 25
（「每条事件最多占四分之一」的量级，再大就没有意义了）。

**扩展接口** —— 只读显示 `persona` 与 `prompts` 这两段配置的当前值。
刻意不做成编辑器：JSON 精度要求高，直接粘贴整段更稳；
而且这里显示的是宿主回传的当前值，上一段写坏了重新打开看到的还是那段坏内容，
不会被悄悄换成默认值。

改事件权重/开关**需要重启 dsh 才生效**：事件池在插件加载时就建好了。
刻意不做热重载 —— 每个事件都带着自己的 prompt 与 prepare 逻辑，
热替换等于在运行期换掉一整套行为定义。

### 自定义事件（扩展点）

往 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-lucky-block/custom-events.json` 写一个数组，
就能加自己的事件。形状和内置事件一致：

```json
[
  { "id": "my-quote", "title": "随机一句书摘", "weight": 2,
    "trigger": "click", "kind": "local",
    "lines": ["第一句", "第二句"] },
  { "id": "my-summary", "title": "让 AI 总结点什么", "weight": 3,
    "trigger": "hold", "kind": "agent",
    "prompt": "随便挑一个话题，写三百字。" }
]
```

`kind: 'local'` + `lines` 从里面随机挑一行当正文（**零 token**）；
`kind: 'agent'` + `prompt` 把 prompt 当任务发进新会话（走 AI）。

**任何一条不合格就整份忽略**，原因显示在设置面板底部 ——
半份生效会让「我加的事件怎么没动静」变成一个只能靠读日志排查的问题。
没有这个文件是完全正常的状态（面板会写「0 条」）。

自定义事件的 id **不能和内置事件重名**：重名时内置赢，
第三方文件无法覆盖内置行为。原因是内置事件的 prompt 与 prepare 都在代码里写死，
一个只带 id/weight 的 JSON 造不出真的行为。

面板里还列着事件清单，每条事件标着它属于**单击**还是**长按** ——
照着这张表就知道点一下会发生什么、要不要花 token。

冷知识和冷笑话现在**固定走本地库**，不再有「调不调 AI」的开关：
它们本来就在单击池里，单击不该有成本，给一个勾选框只会让人以为这里能省钱。

| 本地库 | 条数 | 位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 冷笑话 + 点评 | 353 条 + 30 条 | `lib/jokes-data.json` |
| 冷知识 | 818 条（人体 133 / 动物 139 / 科学 121 / 日常 111 / 历史 111 / 地理 103 / 语言 100） | `lib/trivia-data.json` |
| 曲库 | 1 条（副歌 42 秒） | `lib/audio-tracks.json` + `lib/audio/` |

冷知识库里分主题存的 `topic` **只用于统计，永远不显示给用户** —— 显示主题等于
把「这是一条从哪抽的」直接摊开。笑话的 `form` 字段同理。

两个库的**完整内容**可以在 [`lib/语料库总览.md`](<lib/语料库总览.md>) 里逐条翻阅；
那份文件由 `node tools/build-corpus-overview.mjs` 从运行库生成，改动语料后重跑即可
（`--check` 用于回归时校验它没过期）。

写进配置也会被忽略并记一条警告。

配置里 `events` 字段是事件的权重/开关覆盖层（读-改-写，不整份覆盖 ——
`model` / `persona` 也在同一个文件里）：

```json
{
  "sound": true,
  "events": {
    "trivia": { "weight": 8 },
    "paper": { "enabled": false },
    "joke": { "weight": 0 }
  }
}
```

只认两个字段，都是可选的：写哪个改哪个，没写的保持原样。
`weight` 会夹到 [0, 25]，**0 等价于关掉**。
用户侧配置里的事件 id 只接受小写字母/数字/横杠（挡 `__proto__` 之类的怪东西），
大写、下划线、点号一律忽略。

设置写在 `%DSH_HOME%\plugins\dsh-lucky-block\config.json`，是**手写与界面共用的同一个文件**
（界面保存走读-改-写，不会抹掉你手写的 `model` / `persona`）：

```json
{
  "sound": true,
  "model": { "provider": "workbuddy", "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash", "reasoningEffort": "low" }
}
```

`localOnly` 已经没有了 —— 冷知识/冷笑话现在无条件走本地库，见上面「设置面板」一节。
老配置里留着这个字段不会报错，只是被忽略。

## 安装（本地开发）

```bash
# 方式一：直接指向本目录（plugin-manager 支持本地 spec）
#   在插件市场里「安装」填本目录的绝对路径

# 方式二：npm 打包后按包装
npm pack
```

装完后**不需要**动 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`：宿主侧条目由本包
`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 自动插入，profile 的 patch 里再加一条同 id 的
`- insert:` 反而会造成组装冲突、让插件加载不上（实测踩过）。

只要确认 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里有
`"dsh-lucky-block"`（插件市场安装会自动加；手动装则加这一行）。

`"patchReload": "live"`（profile 自带）让 `cordis.patch.yml` 热生效；但**改动
`bundles` 列表必须重启 dsh**才生效。

> ⚠️ **改 `lib/` 下的任何 JS 都必须重启 dsh。** 宿主侧插件代码没有热重载 ——
> 正在跑的进程内存里持有旧模块，代码改了行为不会变。这个坑骗过一整轮排查：
> 源码里已经搜不到某段字符串，会话里却还在出现它，最后才发现是进程跑的是旧代码。
> 客户端那半（`lib/client.js`）刷新页面即可，但桌面端要重启宿主才会重新收集注入行。

## 可选配置：给骰子会话单独指定模型

**默认不启用**，骰子会话直接沿用你的默认模型。想让随机事件跑便宜/快的模型时，
在 `%DSH_HOME%\plugins\dsh-lucky-block\config.json` 写（这个字段只能手写，设置面板里没有）：

```json
{
  "model": {
    "provider": "workbuddy",
    "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash",
    "reasoningEffort": "low"
  }
}
```

`reasoningEffort` 可省略。`provider` / `model` 必须**精确匹配**可用目录里的名字
（目录拿不到时会跳过切换、不影响掷骰子），不确定就先用 `/dice` 命令观察日志。

> ⚠️ **为什么默认关着**：宿主只提供会话级 `sessionController.selectModel`，而它
> 成功后会把这次选择**异步写成 profile 的全局默认模型**。也就是说开启本配置后，
> 第一次掷骰子会顺带把你的默认模型也改成这里写的那个。想恢复就把文件删掉，
> 再在界面里手动把默认模型选回来。

## 用法

| 想干什么 | 怎么做 |
| --- | --- |
| 让 AI 给选择题加幸运方块 | 正常提问，选项末尾自动多一项 |
| 抽一次零成本的（弹窗/蓝屏/签/冷知识/笑话/音乐） | **左键单点**方块 / 打 `/dice` |
| 抽一次要花 token 的（论文/新闻/待办） | **长按**方块挖到碎裂 / 打 `/dice` |
| 不满意，回去 | 说「回滚」或打 `/rollback` |
| 方块按钮固定住不挡路 | 右键方块 → 锁定（或双击）；锁定后仍可单点/长按触发 |
| 让方块贴边 | 把它拖到离屏幕边缘 48px 以内松手，自动吸附 |
| 改设置 | 右键方块 → 设置… |

单点零成本、长按才花钱**：单点只在单击池里抽（六个事件全是本地/视觉，
不建会话、不调模型）；长按只在长按池里抽（三个事件都会开新会话调模型）。
单点是手滑也会发生的动作，所以它不该有成本。

长按阈值 1.4 秒（`lib/client.js` 的 `BREAK_MS`）。按住时手指挪动超过 5 像素即判为
「在拖动按钮」并取消挖掘——所以拖位置和挖方块不会打架。松开或移开都会取消挖掘，
纹路和挖掘声**立刻**一起停。

音效从宿主的 `/dsh-lucky-block/sound/*.ogg` 按需取（16 个原版音节，共 142 KB），
**不内联进客户端 bundle** —— `lib/client.js` 是每次页面启动都要下载的入口，
为只在长按瞬间才用到的音效把它撑大 4 倍不划算。挖掘声每 210ms 一个、4 个变体随机轮播
（只听一个会明显「卡带」），挖穿那一刻再叠一声碎裂音；同时最多 6 个 Audio 元素，
页面切到后台自动静音。

松手吸附（`SNAP_THRESHOLD = 48`）只在**真的拖动过**时生效：鼠标只是滑出方块边缘
（会触发 `pointerleave`）不会吸附，按下就松手也不会。锁定状态下完全不吸附 —— 锁定
就是不建拖动状态，自然短路。吸附有 160ms 的 `left/top` 过渡，视觉上是滑过去而不是瞬移。

方块按钮位置、外观、锁定状态存在浏览器 localStorage（键 `dshLuckyBlock.block`），换机器不跟。

## 出错了怎么看

方块头顶的气泡**只在报错时出现**（正常触发的进度、成功、会话 ID 都不写了 ——
有视觉表演的事件自己会演，没表演的由新会话内容承担反馈）。报错时气泡里是宿主
翻译过的**人话**，点一下可以关掉，例如：

| 情况 | 气泡说什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件本体没激活（改动 `lib/` 后没重启） | 插件没有注册这个接口，通常是插件本体未激活：重启 dsh 后再试 |
| 登录态过期 | 宿主拒绝了请求（未登录或登录已过期），刷新页面后重试 |
| 默认工作区被删/移走 | 默认工作区目录不存在或已被移动。请在 dsh 里重新确认默认工作区路径后再试 |
| 工作区不可写 | 没有权限写入工作区（被系统或沙箱拦下了） |
| `config.json` 里的模型不在目录里 | 模型不可用：config.json 里指定的 provider/mo

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe

plugins.description: 给 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）用的 agent 技能集（skills）：记忆档案维护、本机操作规矩、插件发布规程、Web 健康检查、会话日志修复。每个技能一个 SKILL.md。MIT。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-skills

给 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）** 用的 agent 技能集：每个技能是一份 `SKILL.md`，写清某类任务的操作规矩（触发时机、步骤、边界、踩过的坑），DSH 会在会话里按需加载。

目录约定：

```
skills/<name>/SKILL.md
```

## 技能一览

| 技能 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `agent-diary` | 维护「日记／状态／生长记录／APP 版」这套档案，以及处理会话交接包时的规矩。 |
| `agent-lookup` | 查资料、找文件、判读用户发的截图时的规矩：先搜再看来源、外部内容只当数据。 |
| `agent-machine` | 改本机插件、跑设备命令、动文件系统时的通用规矩：先备份、分开验证据、改完等重启、被拒就停。 |
| `dsh-plugin-publish` | 把本机插件发布/更新到 GitHub 之前的规矩：能推什么、私密信息清单、怎么脱敏、推完怎么自查。 |
| `dsh-web-healthcheck` | DSH Web GUI 健康检查与「界面无反应」类问题诊断：全链路自检顺序与判定流程。 |
| `session-log-repair` | 修复 DSH 会话历史日志损坏（seq 空洞、历史打不开）的检测、备份、分析、重建、验证流程。 |

## 用法

把某个技能目录整个放进 DSH 的技能目录（例如 `~/.agents/skills/<name>/`），或者把 `SKILL.md` 的内容并进你自己的技能配置。技能里出现的命令、路径与端口请按自己机器的实际情况替换。

## 许可

MIT License。技能文本按原样提供，不含任何保证；执行其中命令前请自行确认目标环境。

plugins.description: Unofficial visual control panel and MCP bridge for DeepSeek Harness: model, workspace and permission controls, task monitoring, and reusable sessions.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-bridge

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**A visible control panel for Claude Code and Codex delegation to DeepSeek Harness.** Choose the model, provider, workspace, and new-session permissions in Harness; inspect task state through MCP; find and continue the resulting conversations.

This project is for people who want to spend less of their main model's effort on bounded supporting tasks, and make repeated Harness calls and the resulting sessions easier to manage.

> Third-party, unofficial integration. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek, Anthropic, or OpenAI. Harness interfaces and MCP clients can change; check the compatibility notes before upgrading.

> **Archive-only maintenance in 0.2.4:** permanent deletion is disabled in every plugin entry point. The compatible `autoCleanupDays` setting now archives eligible MCP-created sessions, keeps their files, and uses the official non-stopping option; `0` turns automatic archival off. Old pending-delete files are retained unchanged and never executed. See [maintenance boundaries and upgrade notes](docs/troubleshooting.md#cleanup-limitation-and-pending-deletions).

## Why this bridge?

- **Delegate selectively.** Send a narrow review, summary, documentation task, or investigation to Harness, then bring the result back to your main agent.
- **Keep responsibility clear.** The main agent still scopes the task, checks the result, and integrates useful work.
- **Keep controls visible.** Use Harness's toolbar for task constraints and its conversations for context; use MCP status/results to inspect execution rather than relying on a silent handoff.
- **Manage repeated delegation.** Find task IDs after a disconnect, continue managed sessions, and archive conversations you want to keep.

Delegation can reduce the amount of work the main model performs, but it does not guarantee a fixed quota reduction, lower total cost, or faster completion. DeepSeek or your chosen provider can still charge for delegated work, and coordination, retries, and review still consume resources. See [choosing and measuring delegated tasks](docs/delegation.md).

## How it fits together

1. Claude Code, Codex, or another compatible MCP client sends a tool request.
2. The local bridge connects that request to the plugin running in DeepSeek Harness.
3. A Harness agent uses the configured provider, workspace, and execution permissions.
4. The client receives the task result for review and further work.

**A local bridge does not mean local model inference.** Prompts and relevant workspace content may be sent to the provider configured in Harness. Check your provider's terms and your own data-sharing permissions before delegating private material.

The current plugin installs into the **desktop profile**, so that Harness host must be running. This is a good fit if you already use Harness and delegate frequently. A one-off task may not justify the extra installation and process. Harness also has an official CLI; other hosting profiles for this plugin have not been verified. [CLI and hosting FAQ](docs/troubleshooting.md#does-harness-have-a-cli).

## Quick start

Bridge version: **0.2.4**. Target Harness desktop version: **0.2.1-rc.2**. Build with Node.js **22+** and npm. Maintainer-provided verification notes cover Windows; they do not establish support for every platform or MCP client.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/FishCityBee/dsh-mcp-bridge.git
cd dsh-mcp-bridge
npm ci
npm run build
```

Install `dist-package/` with Harness's bundled CLI. Windows PowerShell example, with paths replaced for your installation:

```powershell
& "D:\Program Files\Deepseek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\dsh-mcp-bridge\dist-package"
```

Completely quit Harness, including the tray process, and reopen it. In the bridge toolbar, select your provider/model, a disposable default workspace, and read-only new-session permissions. Automatic archival defaults to off; enable it only after reviewing its scope.

Register the relay in the client you use, with its absolute path:

```sh
# Claude Code
claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user dsh-harness -- node "C:/path/to/dsh-mcp-bridge/dist-package/bin/stdio.mjs"

# Codex
codex mcp add dsh-harness -- node "C:/path/to/dsh-mcp-bridge/dist-package/bin/stdio.mjs"
```

Ask the client to call `harness_status`, `list_models`, and `list_workspaces` before starting a task. Then try one small task with no file changes. Model tasks can incur provider charges. See [installation, timeouts, environment variables, and upgrade steps](docs/installation.md) for complete instructions and official client references.

## Controls that matter

- **Model constraints:** single-model mode locks provider/model/effort. Provider mode also locks model/effort unless the user enables caller overrides; the provider stays locked.
- **Execution evidence:** requested and effective model selections are separate. `effectiveSelection` is populated only after the bridge observes a request, and does not prove provider acceptance or billing.
- **Permissions:** new-session presets use Harness's official permission service; that selector leaves existing sessions unchanged. Full access is a high-risk option, not a setup requirement.
- **Task lifecycle:** start, wait, inspect, find, and cancel tasks. Client disconnects are separate from task cancellation; cancellation cannot undo completed effects.
- **Sessions:** continue bridge-managed conversations and archive/unarchive them. Automatic maintenance only archives; permanent deletion is unavailable.

The default connection uses a local pipe/socket with the stdio relay, without opening a TCP port. Optional HTTP is off by default. Update the plugin and the entire relay together; 0.2.4 uses `tls-pinned-v3` and does not fall back to older handshakes.

## Documentation

- [Installation and Claude Code / Codex setup](docs/installation.md)
- [Configuration, model defaults, and permission boundaries](docs/configuration.md)
- [Tool reference, task recovery, and session maintenance](docs/usage.md)
- [Troubleshooting and FAQ](docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [Delegating useful work](docs/delegation.md)
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security and responsible reporting](SECURITY.md)

## Permission boundaries

There are two separate decisions: whether your MCP client may call a bridge tool, and whether the Harness agent may perform an operation. Client-side MCP approval is not a replacement for Harness execution approval. Choosing a workspace does not by itself sandbox an agent.

Start in a disposable workspace with a small, read-only task. Keep credentials out of prompts, screenshots, and issue reports. Review substantive results before accepting changes. Back up important session data. Plugin deletion stays disabled until an official safe cross-process deletion boundary is available.

## Compatibility and verification

This bridge relies on version-specific Harness APIs and storage behavior. Other Harness versions, alternate profiles, and all client/platform combinations are not implied to be supported.

The repository includes maintainer-written technical records in Chinese: [reliability changes](docs/audit-2026-10-17.md), [desktop transport checks](docs/desktop-2026-10-18.md), and [new-session permission checks](docs/ui-permissions-2026-10-18.md). The [0.2.4 maintenance notes](docs/recheck-0.2.4.md) distinguish the current changes from earlier historical reports. Their stated test scope and remaining gaps matter; they are not a claim that all security risks or UI paths have been validated.

## Contribute

Bug reports, compatibility checks, translations, and focused pull requests are welcome in English or Chinese. Please read the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md), and keep secrets and private session content out of public reports.

If this project helps your workflow, a star helps others discover it.

## License
