plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ban-wait

One Host plugin that refuses tool arguments which would park the DSH agent loop.

It exists because the shell command timeout is not a ceiling. `pwsh-sandbox`'s
`timeoutMs: 1000` promotes a long command to a background job, but the model can
pass `timeoutMs: 180000` on the call itself and the executor honors it up to
`maxTimeoutMs` (600000 ms by default) — three minutes inside one tool call. The
same class of leak is `job_output { wait: true }`, clamped only by a 10-minute
default. This plugin makes "no single call parks the loop" a property of the
tool registry instead of a property of the model's discipline.

## Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | the plugin: policy + global `ctx.tools.guard()` |
| `check.mjs` | offline self-check of the policy (30 assertions, no DSH process) |
| `bundle-check.mjs` | pre-install check: replays what the plugin page inspects, with the harness's own patch loader |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the bundle's patch: inserts the Host-plane row |
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`; no dependencies |

## Policy

| Config field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `maxBlockingMs` | `1000` | ceiling for any per-call blocking hint the model supplies |
| `denyWaitTools` | `["job_output"]` | tools whose `wait: true` is refused |
| `timeoutHintTools` | `["pwsh", "bash"]` | tools whose `timeoutMs` / `timeout_ms` is checked against `maxBlockingMs` |
| `requireBackgroundTools` | `[]` | tools that must be called with `run_in_background: true` |

A refusal is a `Error: …` tool result that names the ban, clears the background
job of blame, and states how to re-issue the call, so the model recovers in one
step. An unusable config value is logged and replaced by its default rather than
thrown: a typo here must not fail the instance's boot.

## Install

Through the plugin page — the only channel that keeps the plugin visible in the
inventory with its own toggle:

1. **添加插件** → paste the absolute project directory
   (the checkout you just cloned). A local directory is recognised by
   `isAbsolute()` before any npm-spec parsing and never touches a registry, so
   the registry chooser in that dialog is irrelevant.
2. The manager reads `package.json`, requires a `name` and a `dsh.bundle`, adds
   the dependency to the profile, then reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles`
   automatically ("new bundle dependencies activate automatically"). The plugin
   then appears under 已安装 with a toggle.
3. If the result reports that a restart is required, restart the instance: a new
   Host module generation is not loaded into a running process.

Do **not** also add a raw loader row for this plugin to the profile patch. The
bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` inserts row id `ban-wait`, and two rows sharing that
id make id-targeted patches — the toggle, any override — reach only one of them.

Companion configuration, without which the guard is the only thing standing
between the model and a three-minute call:

```yaml
- id: pwsh-sandbox
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox"
  config:
    timeoutMs: 1000       # default for a command
    maxTimeoutMs: 1000    # ceiling for the model's timeoutMs argument — the line that matters
    maxOutputBytes: 10000
```

## Verify

```powershell
# the policy itself (30 assertions)
node check.mjs

# the package the plugin page will inspect: path, package.json, name, dsh.bundle,
# `files` coverage, and a real parse of cordis.patch.yml by the harness loader
node bundle-check.mjs
```

Neither proves activation — that happens when the profile mounts the bundle's
layer, which the plugin page reports in its install result.

Live probes (each returns a refusal instead of executing):

```
job_output   { job_id: "pwsh-1", wait: true }        → Error: … (ban-wait): job_output was called with wait: true
pwsh         { command: "ok", timeoutMs: 180000 }    → Error: … caps how long one tool call may hold the agent loop at 1000 ms
pwsh         { command: "ok" }                       → runs normally
workflow     { script: "return 1" }                  → runs synchronously (not banned by default)
```

Verified on instance 3080: both refusals fire, plain calls and non-blocking job
reads behave exactly as before, and the row mounts and unmounts live — no
restart was needed for any of it.

## Boundaries

- The guard sees **arguments**, not duration. A tool with no blocking argument
  that simply runs long is out of its reach; that is what `requireBackgroundTools`
  is for, and what the shell `maxTimeoutMs` cap already handles for commands.
- `ask_user_question` is deliberately never banned: blocking on a human is the
  feature.
- `workflow` and a synchronous `subagent` are **not** banned by default. They do
  real work inside the call, so backgrounding them changes how the result is
  consumed. Enable per tool when that trade is wanted:
  ```yaml
  requireBackgroundTools: [workflow, subagent]
  ```

## Superseded

This plugin began as a single-rule ban that refused only `job_output { wait: true }`;
that early version has been folded into the policy shipped here, so there is nothing
left to install separately.

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-wb-credit-fallback

WorkBuddy 积分耗尽时，自动把会话切到 DeepSeek，并把默认模型永久回落到 DeepSeek——这一轮照常答完，之后新开的会话也不再撞额度墙。

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）本身没有跨 provider 的回退链：

- WorkBuddy 插件在积分不足时让本地 shim 返回 `402 / hard_credit`；
- DSH 的 pi-ai 适配器会把 402 归到 `PI_AI_ERROR`（不是 `QUOTA`）；
- 内置 `dsh-llm-retry` 只会用同一个模型重试。

所以这里用一个 host 侧小插件补上缺口。它只用 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 公开的扩展点，宿主代码零运行时依赖。

## 行为

1. 监听 `agent/request-error`：失败 provider 是 `from`（默认 `workbuddy`）且错误文本命中积分不足标记（`hard_credit`、`insufficient credit`、`402`、`积分不足`、`额度不足`、`余额不足` 等）时：
   - 用 `sessionController.agents.selectForNextRequest` 把当前会话切到 `to`（默认 `deepseek-account / deepseek-flash`）；
   - 用 `agentDefaultModel.saveSelection` 把它写成 profile 默认模型（走官方配置编辑器写回 `cordis.patch.yml`，不手改 YAML），此后新会话直接走 DeepSeek；
   - 返回 `{ kind: "retry" }`，让这一轮重试一次。
2. 监听 `agent/request`：切换尚未落盘时直接重写这次请求的 provider/model，因为同一步的重试不会重新组装系统提示。
3. 保护：每个 turn 最多自动切换一次；内置重试策略已决定重试时让内置优先；非积分类失败（400/401/网络错误）不触发；监听器内部异常全部吞掉，不影响正常请求。

不做的事：DeepSeek 也失败时不再切；积分恢复后不会自动切回 WorkBuddy（在模型选择器里重选一次即可）；不处理 WorkBuddy 登录失效（401 `session_dead`）。

## 安装

桌面客户端的 profile 由 App 独占管理，CLI 不能装，用 App 内入口：

1. 左侧栏「插件」→「添加插件」；
2. 输入本目录的**绝对路径**（安装向导接受绝对路径）；
3. 安装 → 立即启用 → 完全退出客户端（含托盘）再打开。

卸载在插件页里完成，本插件不写任何用户数据。

`dsh web` / `dsh tui` 这类命令行 profile 可以直接从 GitHub 源码安装（桌面客户端的 `desktop` profile 仍只能用 App 内入口）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Yikeqm/dsh-wb-credit-fallback
```

装完重启对应 profile，再刷新页面即可。用 GitHub 源安装时插件会跟随仓库 `main` 分支更新，需要重新 `dsh plugin remove` + `add` 才会取到新提交。

## 配置

bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给了默认值，可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按行 id `wb-credit-fallback` 覆盖：

```yaml
config:
  from: workbuddy            # 触发条件：哪个 provider 报额度不足
  to:                        # 切到哪个 provider/model
    provider: deepseek-account
    model: deepseek-flash
    reasoningEffort: high
  persistDefault: true       # 同时写回默认模型；false = 只救当前会话
```

## 验证

逻辑层：`node tests/smoke.mjs`（用假 ctx 模拟瀑布调用，覆盖触发 / 不触发 / 只切一次 / 默认写回）。

集成层：在独立的 headless profile 里挂两个手工声明的 pi-ai 路由（一个返回 402 `hard_credit`，一个正常流式返回），跑真实 agent loop：

- 第一次运行：`BAD → GOOD`，会话里 `request/header` 从故障 provider 换成回退 provider，`turn/end` 为 `completed`，profile 的 `agent-default-model` 被改写；
- 第二次运行（新会话）：只有 `GOOD`，直接走回退后的默认模型；
- 负向用例：非积分错误（400）不触发切换；回退目标也失败时不会在两个 provider 之间打转。

## 已知限制

- 依赖 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 的 `agent/request` / `agent/request-error` 瀑布与 `sessionController`、`agentDefaultModel` 服务；升级 DSH 大版本后需复核。
- 积分不足靠错误文本匹配；WorkBuddy 若更换措辞需要补标记。
- 插件在宿主进程内运行，如遇异常行为先在插件页禁用它。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH MCP 服务器管理器：在「设置 → MCP 服务器」里添加、编辑、启停、重连、移除 MCP 客户端条目。
plugins.readme_text:
# MCP 服务器管理器

DSH 插件 `dsh-mcp-manager` 0.1.0。入口：**设置 → MCP 服务器**。

## 功能

- 查看 MCP 管理器配置，以及当前 Loader 中已有的 MCP 客户端条目。
- 添加、编辑、启用、停用、重连、移除第三方 MCP。
- 连接方式：stdio（命令、JSON 参数数组、工作目录、环境变量），Streamable HTTP（URL、请求头）。
- 普通值、密钥与已有凭据引用三种配置项模式。密钥通过 DSH `credentials` 服务保存；只在连接时取出，配置文件仅存引用，界面不回显。
- 已有条目的参数不回显，防止历史配置中的明文密钥泄漏。
- 只允许移除当前 profile `insert` 中显式添加的 MCP 条目。内置、组合包、继承/更高优先级配置只读，需到所属配置/预设中管理。
- profile 移除使用平台文件锁、YAML AST、DSH 配置组合器和重载机制；写回前备份，重载失败回滚，保留 `!!js` 与其他条目。

## 安全与边界

- 启用 stdio 会运行填写的命令；启用 HTTP 会把配置的请求头发送给指定服务器。界面执行前会确认。请只使用可信 MCP。
- 不自动安装 MCP 软件。但用户配置的 npx/uvx 可能按其自身规则联网下载软件。
- 密钥不要放在命令、参数、URL 或普通值里。远程生产服务请用 HTTPS。
- 「密钥」编辑留空保留旧值；配置 `Authorization` 时填入完整值，例如 `Bearer <token>`。
- 「凭据引用」填写现有环境变量/DSH 凭据名称，例如 `MY_API_KEY`。
- 删除配置不卸载命令包，也不删除凭据。备份恢复或其他配置可能仍引用凭据。
- 管理数据：`<profile>/mcp-manager/servers.json`；上一个版本备份为 `servers.json.bak`。密钥存储位置及加密能力遵从 DSH 凭据服务，不额外承诺磁盘加密。
- 「已连接」是初次连接及工具发现成功，不是实时在线健康检查。失败时可使用「重连」。
- 旧式 SSE、OAuth 自动登录、任意 MCP JSON 导入暂不支持。
- 未挂载的 agent preset 中的服务器不在当前 Loader 的列表里。

## 本机安装（须确认后执行）

源码：本仓库根目录（克隆后即为插件目录）。

1. 备份 desktop profile 的 `package.json`、锁文件与 `cordis.patch.yml`。
2. 以 `link:` 本地依赖接入，不从 npm 按包名安装。
3. 把 `dsh-mcp-manager` 加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`。本包自带 bundle patch，不在 profile 再插入重复挂载。
4. 同步治理目录 `Plugins.json`，校验 profile 和账本。
5. 完全退出并重新打开 DSH，再进入设置。首次安装仅刷新页面不会加载 Host。

## 测试

`node --test test/*.test.mjs` 运行模型单元测试。运行完整平台集成测试时设置 `DSH_MCP_TEST_RUNTIME` 为包含真实 DSH `package.json` 和依赖的独立运行时目录。测试临时文件默认写入 `D:/Data/.temp/mcp-manager-tests`，可用 `DSH_MCP_TEST_ROOT` 改为另一临时目录。

已通过 14 项测试，在当前安装版本的隔离依赖运行时验证：Host 激活、独立服务 Fiber 下真实复现 RPC getter 的 webServer 注入故障、改用 Connection.fetch 精确注册 `/api/mcp-manager/*` 后成功读写与释放、官方 HTTP carrier 的真实登录 Cookie 与 POST 请求（200 / 未认证 401 / 异站 403 / 释放后 404）、RPC 请求信封及体积校验、设置 Slot 契约和未加载接口提示、真实 stdio 双实例、真实 Streamable HTTP 与请求头凭据、工具发现、重连和移除、乐观并发、原子写入失败补偿、YAML 表达式与相邻条目保留、移除重载失败回滚、内置及更高优先级保护。界面结构测试使用 hook 适配器，不等同于浏览器视觉或完整点击测试；当前桌面 GUI 验收需完全退出并重新打开 DSH 后进行。

2026-10-12 修正：此前仅把 webServer 加进本插件 inject 仍会在线激活失败。Connection 的 RPC getter shadow 会在其提供方作用域解析 webServer；此前把模拟服务提供在根 Context 的测试掩盖了此约束。现在使用官方已认证 `/api` 下的精确 Fetch 路由，不修改平台或其他插件。

plugins.description: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, dependency graph, ideas and review timeline for the session's project. · DSH 右侧栏的 orchd 只读面板。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-orchd

Read-only **orchd** panel for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) **right sidebar**: open a project session and see that
project's task board, dependency graph, ideas and review timeline next to the conversation.
No project configuration — the plugin derives the project from the session.

把 [orchd](https://github.com/7bder/orchd-core) 的项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的**只读面板**：

> 点开一个项目会话，面板自动检测这个项目有没有用 orchd。
> 装了 → 同屏显示任务看板、依赖图、想法与审查时间线；没装 → 给一个接入入口。

**面板没有任何写操作**：`claim` / `done` / `review` / `merge` / `amend` 一律不出现在 UI 里。

---

## 面板内容

| 视图 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **四态检测** | `未安装` / `未初始化` / `就绪` / `异常`，每种状态各自点名原因，不是一句「出错了」 |
| **看板** | 状态分布、待办 / 在途 / 终态，状态条即筛选器；关键词、筛选、排序；800+ 任务虚拟滚动 |
| **任务详情** | 目标、验收标准、验证命令、写范围、上游依赖与下游引用（可点跳转）、审查事件时间线 |
| **依赖图** | DAG：聚焦闭包 / 活跃子图 / 含终态全图；环、自依赖与悬空上游**显式标注**，不静默少画 |
| **想法（IDEAS）** | 只读想法看板：状态分组、归档任务对照、可复制的推进命令 |
| **接入入口** | 未安装的项目给两条路：复制命令自己跑，或让当前会话的 agent 去装（注入前先给你看文本） |

## 安装

```sh
# 推荐：npm 包
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-orchd

# DSH Desktop：用应用自带的终端（欢迎页里那个），**不要**加 --profile
dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-orchd
```

没有 npm 也能从源码装（被市场收录前的等价路径）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:7bder/dsh-plugin-orchd
```

## 截图

![看板：状态条即筛选、搜索、排序、任务列表](assets/screenshot-1.png)

![依赖图：分层 DAG、悬空依赖如实标注、异常提示](assets/screenshot-2.png)

![任务详情：验收标准、可复制的验证命令、依赖与审查时间线](assets/screenshot-3.png)

Desktop 的 `desktop` profile 由应用托管：普通 `dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 会被 CLI 直接拒（
`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`），应用自带终端里不带 `--profile`
的命令才改得到它。装好后**重启 DSH**——宿主侧模块不热替换：会话 header 角落出现开关，右侧栏出现「orchd 任务」页。

> 被插件市场收录后可以在设置里搜索一键安装。Release 页另有 tarball 资产，但那条路依赖
> `github.com/release-assets`（在部分网络不稳），且 pnpm 11 对「URL tarball」的 lockfile 完整性要求更严
> （可能报 `ERR_PNPM_MISSING_TARBALL_INTEGRITY`），所以只作归档与手动备用。

## 前置条件

- **DSH** 提供右侧栏面板席位（`sidebarRightTabs` + `sidebar.right.pane.tab`，session 作用域）。
- **项目侧装了 orchd**（项目根或容器主工作树下有 `.orchd/`）。没装的话面板会给出接入入口，不会静默失败。
- **Python 3** 在 PATH 上（`python` / `py -3` / `python3` 依次探测，也可在配置里写死 `pythonPath`）——
  面板跑的是**项目自带的**引擎入口 `python <项目>/.orchd/__main__.py`，插件不自带、不安装引擎。

## 只读保证

这是硬约束，不是口号：

- 命令白名单 **fail-closed**：不在白名单里的子进程调用根本不 spawn，被拒时记一行结构化日志。
- 子进程环境**剥掉会话身份**，读命令不会带出任何会被引擎当成「有人在动这个任务」的变量。
- 不直读账本、不碰锁、不写项目文件；面板不做文件导出（诊断信息只复制到剪贴板）。
- 开发期在**真引擎、真账本、真 git 仓库**上跑只读冒烟：比对工作区文件哈希、账本事件数、`git status`，要求零变更。

## 配置

配置写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`- id: orchd-tasks` 那一行的 `config:` 下），全部有默认值：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `pythonPath` | `null` | `null` = 自动探测 |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `20000` | 单次引擎调用超时（超时与「引擎报错」在 UI 上是两种状态） |
| `cacheTtlMs` / `pollTtlMs` / `detectTtlMs` | `5000` / `30000` / `10000` | 看板 / 轮询 / 四态检测的缓存 TTL |
| `maxProjectContexts` | `8` | 每会话项目上下文的 LRU 上限 |
| `orchdCoreRepo` | `null` | 接入入口里展示的引擎仓库地址 |
| `allowRoots` | `[]` | 调试用白名单；空 = 不额外收敛 |

## HTTP API

面板的数据全部来自插件自己注册的 8 条同源路由（会话绑定，前端只传 `sessionId`，不传路径）：

```
GET  /orchd/api/context         四态 + 项目身份 + 诊断
GET  /orchd/api/board           状态条 + 任务列表
GET  /orchd/api/task            单任务详情（+ 审查时间线，按需）
GET  /orchd/api/graph           依赖图（节点 / 边 / 环 / 悬空）
GET  /orchd/api/history         审查事件时间线
GET  /orchd/api/ideas           想法看板
POST /orchd/api/install-entry   返回将要注入的文本（本身不注入）
POST /orchd/api/install-inject  执行注入（需显式确认）
```

前缀外的路径一律 404（fail-closed）。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-orchd
```

已知残留：`remove` 之后 profile 的 `node_modules/` 里可能留一个空目录（包管理器行为），手工删掉即可，
不影响启动。

## 边界

面板**只跟当前会话的项目**，不做跨项目聚合、不做项目切换器（DSH 的 Workspace 分组已经是项目导航）；
不做实时推送（引擎没有常驻进程，用缓存 + 手动刷新）；不注册面向模型的工具。

## 许可

MIT。引擎本体见 [7bder/orchd-core](https://github.com/7bder/orchd-core)。

plugins.description: One screen for every work you have shipped: local project facts, GitHub stars and last push, whether the plugin market has picked it up and how many downloads it has, plus pending pull-request wait times against the upstream median.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lighthouse（灯塔）

**一屏看清你发出去的每个作品现在怎么样了 —— 而且能点开看。**

## 界面观察区（v0.2 新增）

DSH 侧栏多一个**灯塔图标**，点开就是一块观察面板 —— 每个作品一张卡：

| 看什么 | 怎么显示 |
| --- | --- |
| 发布了没有 | ✅ 已发布 ／ ❌ 仓库不存在 ／ ❌ 读不到 |
| 市场收录 | ✅ 已收录（带下载量）／ ⏳ 收录中 ／ ❌ 读不到 |
| 收录 PR | ✅ 已合并 ／ ⏳ 等 N 小时（天）／ —— 没有 |
| 星 · 关注 · 留言 | ⭐ / 👁 / 💬 三个数字（GitHub stars / watchers / open issues） |
| 本地与推送 | 本地版本 · 文件数 · 最后推送时间 |

右上角一个「刷新」，打开面板时自动拉一次；数据来自 host 那条只读接口 `/dsh-lighthouse/status` ——
同一个数字在**面板、工具、卡片**里必然一致（走的是同一条采集路径）。

本地拿的是什么版本、GitHub 有没有动静、**市场收没收录、被下载多少次**、给收录 PR 等了多久（对比上游中位数）——
全部来自 API，**一个数字都不经模型生成**，读不到就写"读不到"。

> 名字的来由：船下水之后就看不见了。灯塔是岸上那盏灯 ——
> 专门盯着"我的作品现在在哪一步、有没有人上船"。

---

## 它回答什么问题

- 我发出去的东西，**市场收了吗**？（"未收录" vs "已收录"）
- 有没有人用？**下载多少、在同类里排第几**？
- 收录 PR 等了多久？——**和上游的中位数比，算不算久**？
- 本地那份和线上那份，是同一条船吗？（版本、最后推送时间）
- npm 上有没有？（默认查，可关）

## 作品多了怎么办（v0.2.5）

≤ 12 个作品时是一作品一张卡（信息最全）。**超过 12 个自动切紧凑视图**：

- 文本回执：一行一个作品（`名字｜v版本｜star｜市场｜PR 等待`），不再每个占两行；
- HTML 卡片：换成**一张排序表格**（作品 / 分类 / 版本 / GitHub / 市场 / 收录 PR），汇总条与表头**滚动吸顶**，
  不用滑到底再回来对表头；
- **排序按"要不要人管"**：①需要处理（仓库读不到 / 没有 PR / 市场读不到）②等收录（等得久的在前）③已收录。
  50 个作品时，你第一眼看到的就是那几个有问题的，而不是按名册顺序从上翻。

> 表格是纯静态 HTML（内联样式，无脚本），所以不能搜索/过滤 —— 需要筛选就走名册（`lighthouse_fleet`）把范围缩到一组。

## 中文名与直达链接（v0.3.0）

每个作品显示为 `dsh-lighthouse（灯塔）` —— **英文名 + 中文名**，名字本身就是**超链接**，点开直达仓库；
卡片里另有一行「直达」，把 GitHub / npm / 市场条目页分别列出来（哪个地址能确定才给，绝不编）。

中文名从哪来：名册的 `nameZh` 优先，其次本地 `package.json` 的 `dsh.displayName`。
**滑道发过布（尤其改名）之后**跑一次 `lighthouse_fleet action="sync"`：
它会读每个作品本地的 `package.json`，把**空着**的中文名与链接回填进名册，
并列出「名册包名与仓库对不上」的情况（只报告，不擅自改名）。这样滑道更新了，灯塔也就跟上了。

## 多来源状态

**适用范围（一句话）：数据源只有 GitHub（API）+ 市场登记表 + npm。**
如果作品只放在 Gitee / GitLab，灯塔**读不到那边的 star 与推送时间** —— 名册里只能给它写一条
`mirrors` 链接（点了能跳过去），不会假装有数据。

每个作品都按来源分开报：**本地**（版本/文件数/有没有自测）、**GitHub**（仓库在不在、star、最后推送）、
**npm**（有没有包）、**市场**（收录/下载/同类排名）、**收录 PR**（等待时长 vs 上游中位数）。
某一源读不到就写"读不到"，不会拿另一源的数凑。

## 只读承诺

- **全部是 GET 请求**：不动仓库、不开 PR、不写任何远端。
- **不编数字**：任何一个数据源读不到，就标 `读不到（原因）`，不会用估算值糊过去。
- **名册显式**：灯塔照着名册看，**不自动发现**作品 —— 从目录名或包名前缀去猜"哪些是你的作品"，
  猜错了会把别人的仓库报进你的看板。

## 名册（fleet）

默认路径 `~/.dsh/lighthouse-fleet.json`：

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "owner": "7gzgn",
  "upstream": { "owner": "awesome-dsh-plugin", "repo": "awesome-dsh-plugin", "branch": "main" },
  "works": [
    {
      "name": "dsh-slipway",
      "repo": "dsh-slipway",
      "category": "tools",
      "localDir": "D:\\dsh\\projects\\dsh-slipway"
    }
  ]
}
```

- `owner` 与 `works` **必填**（缺了直接报错，不猜）。
- `localDir` 可省：省了就只看线上那一半。
- 用工具或命令写它：

```
lighthouse_fleet action=init owner=7gzgn works='[{"name":"dsh-slipway","repo":"dsh-slipway","category":"tools","localDir":"D:\\dsh\\projects\\dsh-slipway"}]'
dsh-lighthouse init --owner 7gzgn --works '[…]'
```

## 安装

市场收录后在 DSH 里搜 `dsh-lighthouse` 安装。手动安装：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-lighthouse" -Target "D:\dsh\projects\dsh-lighthouse"
# profile 的 package.json：dependencies 加 "dsh-lighthouse": "link:D:/dsh/projects/dsh-lighthouse"
# 并把 "dsh-lighthouse" 加进 dsh.profile.bundles（漏了不加载）→ 重启 DSH
```

## 用法

### 工具

```
lighthouse_report  [fleetFile] [html] [includeNpm] [marketUrl] [reportDir]
lighthouse_fleet   action=show|init …
```

`lighthouse_report` 返回一段汇总文本，并把一张**单文件 HTML 卡片**落到
`~/.dsh/lighthouse-reports/lighthouse-<时间戳>.html` —— 无外链、无脚本依赖，可直接打开或截图。

### 命令

```powershell
dsh-lighthouse report [--fleet <路径>] [--dir <卡片目录>] [--no-npm] [--no-html] [--json]
dsh-lighthouse fleet  [--fleet <路径>]
```

## 数据从哪来

| 来源 | 取什么 | 备注 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 本地工程 | `package.json` 的版本、文件数、有没有 `test/smoke.mjs` | 只读文件 |
| GitHub API | 仓库是否存在、star/fork、最后推送、**我开的收录 PR 状态** | 需要 PAT（`repo` scope）时更全 |
| 市场接口 | `GET <marketUrl>/dsh-market/registry`（**要同源头**，否则被拒） | **默认取宿主 web 服务的 origin**（`ctx.get('webServer').getOrigin()`，比如 `http://127.0.0.1:56497`）；登记表只拉一次、进程内缓存 5 分钟 |
| npm registry | 包在不在 | 默认开，`--no-npm` / `includeNpm:false` 可关 |

> **市场地址为什么不能再写死端口**：登记表路由挂在宿主自己的 web 服务上，端口每次启动都可能变；
> 写死 `19387` 的后果不是报错，而是报告里一片 **0 收录 / 0 下载** —— 看起来像"没人用"，
> 其实是"没读到"。v0.2.4 起：默认向 `webServer.getOrigin()` 要地址；**读不到时整行不报数**，
> 并明确写"市场数据读不到（不显示 0，免得被当成没人用）"。

PAT 依次找：`tokenFile` → 环境变量 `DSH_SLIPWAY_TOKEN_FILE` → `~/.dsh/.gh-token` → `D:\dsh\.gh-token`。

## 它还会替你盯一件事

**哪些收录 PR 已经等了超过上游中位数**。报告里单独一行点名（`#编号（等了多久）`），
没有超的也明说"都还在正常等待区间" —— 这样"要不要去催"不用自己算。

## 兼容性

- 运行时：**DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**（实测使用的版本）。
- `peerDependencies` 用显式范围；拿不到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 时 `defineTool` 退化成恒等（CLI/测试照常）。
- 插件只注册工具与一段提示词，不挂任何前台服务、不轮询、不占资源（只在被调用时跑一次）。

## 自测

```powershell
node test/smoke.mjs    # 全假网络（GitHub/市场/npm 都是假的），不碰真宿主、不碰外网
```

## License

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-pwsh7

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-pwsh7.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-pwsh7)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-plugin-pwsh7.svg)](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-pwsh7/blob/main/LICENSE)

Windows DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that routes the model-facing **`pwsh` tool to PowerShell 7**
(`pwsh.exe`, major version >= 7) instead of falling back to Windows PowerShell 5.1.

- The executor inherits every behavior of the stock `dsh-pwsh-sandbox` executor: sandbox modes,
  `sandbox_permissions` escalation, denial/runner-failure facts, background jobs, output caps, and
  exit markers. It only replaces executable resolution.
- When PowerShell 7 is missing, a model-facing **`shell_router`** tool reports status, diagnoses
  sandbox problems, and installs PowerShell 7 for the current user or the system, with matching PATH updates.
- In the Web GUI, a **setup dialog** opens whenever PowerShell 7 is missing — on load and again on
  every `pwsh` run — with a download button and live progress (bytes, percent, phase). Closing it
  never cancels an install, and the next failed run re-opens it.

English | [中文说明](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-pwsh7/blob/main/README.zh.md)

---

## Why

On Windows, DSH mounts `pwsh-sandbox` as `ctx.shell`, but the resolved executable can end up being
Windows PowerShell 5.1 in some environments. This bundle keeps the stock PowerShell executor and
overrides only its `pwshPath` resolution:

1. **Take over the `pwsh-sandbox` slot**: a DSH patch entry's `name` asserts the targeted row, it
   does not replace it, so the stock row is disabled by id and a `RouterPwshExecutor extends
   SandboxPwshExecutor` row (`id: pwsh7-executor`) is inserted. An explicit `config.pwshPath` still
   wins; otherwise the plugin-resolved PowerShell 7 is used.
2. **Insert the bare `dsh-plugin-pwsh7` row**, which registers the `shell_router` tool
   (`status` / `diagnose` / `install`), a small system-prompt section, and the Web setup routes.
   That row's name is also what DSH's client-module scanner uses to discover `client.js`; the
   executor row's `./pwsh-executor` subpath is not a client-bundle source.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11.
- A DSH profile that supports bundles (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` / Web profile). Tested against
  DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.2.
- Node.js >= 22 is only needed to run the repository test suite.

## Installation

Install from npm through the DSH plugin manager:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=dsh-plugin-pwsh7@0.2.2
```

Or install from a local checkout (a directory install links the checkout, which is convenient while
developing):

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=D:\path\to\dsh-plugin-pwsh7
```

The new bundle is applied through HMR immediately. After changing the plugin's source, restart DSH
to load a fresh module generation.

## Usage

The model-facing `shell_router` tool:

| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| `status` (default) | Resolved PowerShell 7 path and version, config file, current sandbox policy, shipped-package resolution. |
| `diagnose` | Runs real PowerShell 7 commands under the **current sandbox policy** (version + workspace write) and reports exit codes, stdout/stderr, denial/runner-failure classification, and concrete hints. |
| `install` | Ensures PowerShell 7 exists. `method: "auto"` (default) prefers the portable zip for the selected scope, then falls back to winget; `portable`/`winget` force one strategy. Existing working installations within the selected scope are reused and their PATH is repaired. |

### Setup dialog (Web)

The browser half renders into DSH's root `shell.overlay` slot, so it works in the ordinary Web GUI
and in the desktop shell without a second window:

- **When it opens:** on first load when `pwsh.exe` cannot be found, and again every time a `pwsh`
  tool run fails for that reason (`missingSeq`). "Not now" hides it until the next failed run; a
  page reload opens it again while PowerShell 7 is still missing.
- **What it does:** `Download and install` starts the same scoped installation job as `shell_router install`.
  The dialog shows `downloading → extracting → verifying`, transferred bytes, total, and percent.
  `Cancel download` aborts it.
- **Why one job:** the dialog and the tool share one coordinator, so a model-triggered install is
  visible in the dialog (with progress) and a dialog-triggered install is awaited by the tool.
  Concurrent installs would race on the same archive under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\tmp`.
- **Transport:** `GET /pwsh7/state` (snapshot), `GET /pwsh7/events` (SSE, progress coalesced to
  ~7 frames/s), `POST /pwsh7/install`, `POST /pwsh7/cancel`. SSE drives smooth progress; a 3 s
  `/pwsh7/state` poll stays active as the fallback for carriers that buffer event streams.
  These routes are same-origin and accept POST bodies only as `application/json`.
- **Failure:** the dialog keeps the installer's message, offers `Retry`, and links to the official
  PowerShell releases page. A failed install does not affect `pwsh` routing until one succeeds.
- **Scope:** the dialog belongs to the Web GUI. A headless/CLI composition still gets the
  `shell_router` tool and the same installer, just without a window.

### Explicit paths

Resolution order for the pwsh executable:

1. `DSH_PWSH_PATH` environment variable
2. `pwshPath` in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\config.json`
3. `%ProgramFiles%\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe`
4. `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\powershell7\…\pwsh.exe` (portable installs, newest first)
5. `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe`
6. every `PATH` entry
7. `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\pwsh.exe` (Store alias)
8. `%ProgramFiles(x86)%\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe`

The stock `pwsh-sandbox` row still accepts its official `pwshPath` config field; an explicit config
value takes precedence over automatic detection.

### Config file

`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\config.json`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "pwshPath": "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe",
  "installed": {
    "pwsh": {
      "path": "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe",
      "version": "7.6.7",
      "method": "existing",
      "at": "2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z"
    }
  },
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

## Automatic installation

Choose `scope: "user"` (default) or `scope: "system"` in `shell_router install`, or select the scope in the Web dialog.

| Scope | Destination | Persistent PATH |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\powershell7\<version>` | Current user (`HKCU\Environment`) |
| `system` | `%ProgramFiles%\PowerShell\7` | System (`HKLM` environment) |

System installation requires starting the DSH host as administrator; an unelevated host fails before downloading. User installation needs no elevation. Both preserve existing PATH entries and registry value types, avoid duplicate entries, refresh the host process PATH, and notify Windows. Already running terminals may need reopening. PATH write failures are reported as installation failures.

```text
shell_router action=install scope=user
shell_router action=install scope=system
```

Portable download source:

| Component | Source | Destination |
|---|---|---|
| PowerShell 7 | Latest `PowerShell/PowerShell` GitHub release, `PowerShell-*-win-x64.zip` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\powershell7\<version>\` |

- HTTPS streaming download into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\tmp`, with progress callbacks and
  cancellation.
- Extraction uses the Windows built-in `tar.exe` (bsdtar). No downloaded installer is ever executed.
- After extraction the new `pwsh.exe` is executed once to verify a major version >= 7 before it is
  written into `config.json`.
- `auto` falls back to `winget install Microsoft.PowerShell`; when elevation would be required the
  result carries the exact manual elevated command instead of hanging on UAC.
- winget receives `--scope user` or `--scope machine`; fallback never changes the selected scope.
- Live-tested on Windows: 106,364,316-byte zip downloaded in ~31 s, extracted to 244.8 MB, verified
  `7.6.7`.

## Sandbox behavior

- The executor runs through `ctx.sandbox.conf

plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek Harness Threads

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）侧边线程对话插件，提供独立回复面板及可选的 Slack 风格聊天界面。点击任意一轮回答下的「回复」，即可在右侧栏继续追问。

当前版本：**0.13.9** · 包名：`dsh-threads` · [版本下载](https://github.com/LeoAndJellyfish/DeepSeek-Harness-Threads/releases/tag/v0.13.9) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/LeoAndJellyfish/DeepSeek-Harness-Threads/issues)

## 安装

### Web 版（`dsh web`）

从 GitHub 安装固定版本：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LeoAndJellyfish/DeepSeek-Harness-Threads#v0.13.9
```

安装完成后重启 `dsh web`，刷新浏览器。在一轮已完成的回答下确认「回复」入口，在对话标题栏确认「线程」按钮及 Slack 样式开关。

安装开发分支当前版本：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LeoAndJellyfish/DeepSeek-Harness-Threads
```

### 官方桌面客户端

在 DSH 桌面端会话中发送以下指令，由宿主内置的 `plugin_manager` 安装到当前桌面 profile：

```text
请使用当前桌面端内置的 plugin_manager 安装
github:LeoAndJellyfish/DeepSeek-Harness-Threads#v0.13.9。
先检查当前 profile 和已安装的同名插件，已有安装时核对来源与版本；
通过工具支持的安装或更新操作完成，并报告实际安装版本和重启要求。
```

桌面端使用宿主管理的 `desktop` profile；上述 `--profile web` 命令用于独立 Web 版。安装后按宿主提示重启，随后检查回复入口。

### 离线资源包

下载 Release 中的 `dsh-threads-0.13.9.tgz`，在文件所在目录执行：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-threads-0.13.9.tgz
```

也可下载 ZIP，解压后使用包含 `package.json` 的目录绝对路径：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "file:D:/Plugins/dsh-threads"
```

Release 附带 `SHA256SUMS`，可通过 `Get-FileHash <文件路径> -Algorithm SHA256` 核对下载文件。

### 更新与卸载

更新时使用原安装来源及目标版本，优先通过宿主插件管理界面的更新入口操作。早期本地开发包名为 `@local/dsh-threads`，迁移到公开包前应通过对应 profile 的插件管理入口移除旧注册，再安装 `dsh-threads`。线程和文字草稿存放于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-threads/store.json`，迁移前可备份该文件。

Web 版卸载：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-threads
```

### 运行条件

插件使用 DSH 的会话分叉、右侧栏、聊天节点插槽和 Markdown 模块。客户端声明为 `web`，由 DSH Web 界面加载；官方桌面端通过内置 Web 界面加载。宿主版本升级可能调整这些接口。

## 功能

- 独立线程面板：会话分叉、归档恢复、工具审批、Markdown 与数学公式。
- 线程导航：回复条数、运行状态、未读提示、最近更新时间。
- 消息输入：文字草稿持久化、粘贴与拖拽图片、线程结论引用。
- 可选 Slack 样式：DeepSeek 账号头像与鲸鱼助手标、日期分隔、悬停操作条、折叠插话，以及 `/goal` 命令输入与结果卡片。
- Host 持久化：线程索引、文字草稿和界面偏好在重启后保留。

## 用法

1. 刷新页面（安装/升级后需要一次）。
2. 把鼠标移到任意一条**已完成**回答的底部动作行，点气泡图标「回复」。
3. 右侧栏出现「线程」页签：顶部引用被回复的那条回答，下面是回复流和输入框。
4. 第一次发送时才真正创建线程——它是一条从该轮分叉出来的子会话，继承到该轮为止的上下文。
5. 线程存在后，该轮下方会常驻一行「N 条回复」，点它随时回到线程。

## 它是怎么实现的

| Slack | DSH |
|---|---|
| Channel | 会话（Session） |
| 一条消息 | 一轮对话（用户提问 + 助手回答） |
| Thread | 从该轮 fork 出的子会话（`parentSession` 指向主会话） |
| Thread 面板 | 右侧栏 `thread` 页签 |

- 线程索引（主会话 + 锚点 seq → 子会话）及文字草稿持久化于 Host 侧 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-threads/store.json`，浏览器 `localStorage` 提供运行内兜底。对话内容存在子会话日志中；草稿发送成功后清空。
- 助手回复用宿主自己的 Markdown 渲染器（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的 `MarkdownText`，web shell 静态模块表提供），和聊天区同一套：CommonMark、KaTeX 数学公式、代码块高亮/复制、脚注。引用卡片也用同一渲染器。
- 每条发进线程的消息都会带一段 `<dsh-thread>` 前缀，告诉分叉出来的 agent「你在侧边线程里，回复只有线程面板能看到」。面板渲染时会把这段前缀剥掉；如果直接用「打开子会话」进主界面，会看到原始前缀。
- 子会话会以缩进形式出现在左侧栏，标题沿用分叉时的递增标题。
- 线程会话在左侧栏被归档后，面板会禁用输入框、显示「已在左侧栏归档」提示，并给一个「恢复会话」按钮；草稿保留，恢复后可直接继续。
- 线程里的 Agent 请求工具确认时，面板底部直接出现审批卡片（工具名、理由、「允许一次 / 拒绝」），和主界面审批 UI 读的是同一份 `PendingApproval` 状态。
- 对话标题栏的「线程」按钮打开本会话的线程列表（按最近更新排序，点一行跳到对应线程页签）。
- 线程页签标题是动态的：显示被回复回答的前 18 个字，同时开几条时能分清。
- 线程面板的「带回主对话」把线程最后一条回答以引用块写进主对话输入框（不直接发送，你自己决定发不发、改不改）。
- 线程输入框支持粘贴/拖拽图片，按宿主默认限制：最多 20 张、单张 20 MB；超过 2048px 长边或 4 MP 的图会先在浏览器里缩放（WebP，透明底转白）再发送。
- 线程子会话继承父会话的 Agent 预设（Host 半边在子会话创建、Agent 尚未产生时写入 `agent-preset/selected`；注册表重建 Agent 读的正是这个投影，因此不受 `agentPresets.select()` 的「已开始」限制）。
- 左侧栏里属于线程的子会话行前会显示线程小图标，和普通分支会话区分开。
- 对话标题栏的 Slack 开关（胶囊 + 滑动方块，`role="switch"`）切换消息行样式：Slack 模式下 `user`、`assistant-step`、`steering` 换成头像 + 作者 + 时间的 Slack 行，其余节点仍由宿主渲染；随时可切回原生。
- Slack 行悬停出现整行高亮和浮动操作条（复制、回复进线程、从这个回答分支）。
- Slack 模式下按天插入日期分隔（「今天」「昨天」或「10 月 8 日 星期四」，跨年带年份）；首条消息也显示。
- 用户消息恢复文件卡片（名称/类型/大小）、引用摘要（`referenceLabels`）与技能名（`skillNames`）。
- 中途插入的消息（`steering`）渲染成单行「插话」折叠行，点击展开，不再撑成一条完整消息。
- 线程卡片显示运行中圆点（脉冲）、未读圆点，并在线程完成时刷新条数与最后回复时间。
- 线程输入框可勾选「同时发到主对话」，把这条线程消息以 `[来自线程]` 前缀也发进父会话（会触发父 Agent 回复）。
- 线程面板头部显示最后回复时间与参与者头像，失败时提供「重试」。
- 图片点击打开灯箱（点背景或 Esc 关闭）；正文链接、引用块、代码块使用爵士配色。
- 工具与过程行保留宿主富卡片，只通过 `data-chat-flow-kind` 把外壳缩进对齐到 Slack 正文（Slack 模式下生效）。

## 已知边界

- 线程继承锚点之前的完整上下文，每次回复的输入 token 会变大（前缀缓存可抵消一部分）。
- 「带回主对话」只写草稿，不会自动发送；主对话输入框原有的文字会被保留并接在后面。
- 面板只渲染用户/助手文本（助手部分走完整 Markdown），工具调用折叠成一行，不渲染完整工具卡与轨迹。
- 审批卡片只支持宿主的临时决定（允许一次 / 拒绝）；持久权限策略仍由宿主侧处理。
- 图片只支持图片类型、只存在内存里（切换/重载后需重新粘贴；文字草稿仍然持久化），不支持文件上传。
- 线程列表和索引、草稿、皮肤偏好统一存在 Host 侧 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-threads/store.json`（经 `/dsh-threads/store` 读写，和页面同一套来源/身份校验），端口变化和重启都不丢；`localStorage` 只是同一次运行内的兜底。
- 皮肤偏好与线程索引一起持久化在 Host store；目前替换了 `user` / `assistant-step` / `steering` 三类节点，工具卡、过程行仍由宿主渲染；被替换的行暂未提供宿主原有的编辑/重发交互（复制、回复、分支已补）。
- 有插话的轮次过程组会被宿主强制展开（`hasInterleavedInput`），无法从节点渲染器改变；要改需接管 `conversation.chat.flow`，暂缓。
- 深色模式的对比度只做了静态检查的一部分：亮色下 `#14ADFF` 对白底仅 2.48，已改用深一档的 `--sk-azure-ink` 承担文字；深色块的 token 解析仍未验证。
- Markdown 渲染器来自宿主的静态模块表（`dsh.client.external` 声明）；宿主大版本改名时这里需要跟着改，缺省会退化为纯文本。

## 文件

- `client.js` — 全部客户端逻辑：线程索引、回复入口、右侧面板、Slack 皮肤。
- `index.js` — Host 半边：`/dsh-threads/store` 持久化路由 + 线程子会话的 Agent 预设继承。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — 安装入口。

# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

# dsh-model-picker · 模型速选器（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

[简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

在 DeepSeek Harness 会话窗口右下角 **模型下拉框的左侧** 添加一个小按钮。
点击按钮弹出全量模型选择窗口：按提供商分组、实时搜索、提供商筛选、
真实能力标签、推理徽章、当前选中高亮，加载 / 失败 / 会话占用等状态都有清晰呈现。
**选择模型后立即回写模型下拉框并生效** —— 因为它与原生下拉框共用同一条
per-session 模型目录与 `selectModel` 提交路径（"任一端切换，另一端立刻显示"）。

## 效果

![模型速选窗口（深色主题，中文界面）](screenshot_zh.png)

![模型下拉左侧的触发按钮](button.png)

- **触发按钮**：28px 圆形图标按钮，紧贴模型下拉左侧，与 composer 工具栏
  「+」按钮同风格（悬停 / 焦点环 / 禁用态齐全）。
- **选择窗口**（居中弹窗，主题变量配色，深浅色主题自适应）：
  - **头部**：标题 + 提供商/模型计数 + 关闭；
  - **最近使用**：打开即见上次用过的模型（最多 8 个，自动记录、本地持久化），
    每行显示 **`提供商 · 模型`**（如 `火山方舟 · deepseek-v4-flash-ga`），
    点一下即切回常用模型；
  - **提供商筛选**：搜索框左侧的自定义下拉（全部提供商 / 单个提供商），
    跟随主题渲染（不用原生 `<select>`，避免深色主题下系统面板惨白）；
  - **搜索**：模型名 / 模型 id / 提供商名模糊匹配，↑↓ 移动高亮、Enter 选中、Esc 关闭；
  - **列表**：按提供商分组（DeepSeek 账号 / 官方优先），分组带色条与计数徽章，
    每行显示 **完整模型名** + **能力标签** + 「推理」徽章 + 「当前」徽章 + 选中勾，
    大列表按需懒渲染（滚动才加载，打开更快）；
  - **底部**：当前模型摘要 + **推理档位（reasoning effort）选择器** + 关闭按钮；
  - **状态**：加载中（spinner）、加载失败（重试）、提供商加载失败（逐条提示）、
    当前模型已不可路由（警告）、会话被占用（专用文案）。

### 能力标签是真实数据

行内的 `📝 文本` / `🖼️ 图像` 标签**不是**从模型描述文字里猜的，而是读
**用户自己配置里声明的 `input` 列表**（pi-ai 提供商配置，如
`providers.<id>.models[].input: [text, image]`）。实现走 DSH 已有的
`settings` Remote 读取 settings 文档，扫描各命名空间的 `providers → models[].input`
建索引；配置里没写 `input` 的提供商就不显示标签（如实反映配置，不做臆测）。
增删配置里的 `input`，标签随之变化。

> **契约说明（已验证）**：能力标签用 `group.id` 查询索引，而 `group.id` 与
> settings 中 `providers` 的**配置 key 同命名空间**（DSH 的 modelCatalog 以
> `provider.id` 作为分组 id、`provider.name` 作为显示名）。因此
> `providers.volcengine-agent-plan` 这类配置 key 能被可靠匹配；若未来 DSH
> 改变这一命名约定，标签会安静地不显示（不会报错），插件其余功能不受影响。

> **为什么只能从配置读（已验证）**：浏览器侧拿到的 `modelCatalog` RPC 返回的
> 模型对象**只有 `id` / `name` / `description` / `reasoning`，不含 `input`** ——
> DSH 的 Host 侧在构建浏览器目录时把 `input` 字段投影丢弃了（见
> `buildModelCatalog`）。因此插件无法从模型目录兜底读取能力，配置是浏览器侧
> 唯一的 `input` 来源。想给某个模型显示能力标签，就在 pi-ai 提供商配置里为它
> 写 `input`：
>
> ```yaml
> # profile 的 cordis.patch.yml，llm-pi-ai 提供商配置内
> models:
>   - id: deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731
>     input: [text, image]   # 声明后插件即显示「文本 / 图像」标签
> ```
>
> 这也解释了为什么**同一个模型 id 在不同用户那里标签可能不同**——它如实反映
> 各自配置，而非模型本身的客观能力。

## 工作原理

1. 注册进 composer 的 **`conversation.input.right`** slot —— 这是一个
   `kind: list`、`scope: session` 的官方扩展点，composer 栏在渲染模型
   seat（`conversation.input.model`）之前渲染它，因此按钮天然出现在
   模型下拉的**左边**。
2. 通过 `ctx.inject(['slots', 'modelDirectories'], …)` 拿到
   `ctx.modelDirectories`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`
   注册的共享服务），对当前会话解析出与原生下拉**同一个**
   `ModelDirectory` 实例。
3. 弹窗里选择模型 → `directory.select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })`
   → 走与原生下拉完全相同的 `selectModel` RPC。成功后共享 store 更新，
   原生模型下拉的标签**自动回写**，会话模型切换立即生效。
4. 能力标签由 `ctx.inject(['…', 'remote', 'remote.settings'])` 注入的
   `settings` Remote 读取：`settings.describe()` 返回各命名空间的合并配置，
   从中提取 `provider → model → input[]`。注意 **`remote.<namespace>` 必须显式
   写进 inject 列表**（cordis 规则），只注入根 `remote` 会在访问时报
   `cannot get property "remote.settings" without inject`。
5. 子代理（subagent addressed）会话没有模型目录，按钮自动隐藏。

## 安装

支持 **web 与 desktop** 两个 profile（`platform: web` 的插件在两者中均生效）。

### 方式 A：git clone 后本地安装（推荐）

```sh
git clone https://github.com/faxble/dsh-model-picker.git
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-model-picker
```

把 `/path/to/dsh-model-picker` 换成实际 clone 路径；桌面版把 `web` 换成
`desktop`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-model-picker
```

安装后重启 DeepSeek Harness，在「设置 → 插件」中启用 `dsh-model-picker`，
或确认它已自动启用。

### 方式 B：远程直接安装（免 clone）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:faxble/dsh-model-picker
```

### 方式 C：手动加入 profile（开发者调试用）

1. 在 profile（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`）的 `package.json` 中：
   - `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-model-picker": "file:D:\\Dev\\VibeCoding\\dsh-model-picker"`；
   - `dsh.profile.bundles` 增加 `"dsh-model-picker"`。
2. 在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`。
3. 重启 DeepSeek Harness。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-model-picker/
├── package.json        # 包元数据 + dsh.client 声明（platform: web）
├── index.js            # Host 半身（no-op，仅承载 bundle 行）
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle patch：一行 insert（name 为裸包名）
├── client.js           # 浏览器半身：ModuleLoader bundle（由 src/ 构建）
├── install.ps1         # 安装脚本（web / desktop）
├── src/                # 源码（ES modules，开发用）
│   ├── dict.js         #   zh/en 文案字典
│   ├── pure.js         #   纯逻辑：排序/搜索打分/MRU/能力标签（单测覆盖）
│   ├── style.js        #   CSS（主题变量）
│   ├── icons.js        #   SVG 图标
│   └── entry.js        #   ModuleLoader bundle 入口（组件 + apply）
├── scripts/build.mjs   # esbuild 打包脚本
├── test/               # node:test 单元测试
└── README.md
```

## 说明

- 纯前端插件：**运行时无构建、无运行时依赖**（只用 shell 已提供的 `react`），
  全部颜色来自 DSH 主题 CSS 变量，切换深浅色主题无需重载。
  `client.js` 是构建产物，开发期用 `pnpm build` 从 `src/` 生成。
- 不修改任何 DSH 核心代码；`conversation.input.right` 目前没有任何占用者，
  注册不会遮蔽既有 UI。
- 界面文案**中英双语**，随 DSH 系统语言自动切换（zh / en），外国用户可直接使用。
- 附加功能：**最近使用（MRU）置顶**、**搜索打分排序**（精确 > 前缀 > 包含）、
  **推理档位（reasoning effort）选择器**、大列表**懒渲染**、焦点陷阱等无障碍支持。
  - 最近使用行显示 **`提供商 · 模型`**（如 `火山方舟 · deepseek-v4-flash-ga`），
    提供商名在模型左侧、本地化并浅灰次要显示，跨提供商时避免同名模型混淆。
- 主题取值注意：**不要用 `--dsw-alias-brand-text` 做选中行文字色** ——
  它的语义是"品牌色块**上**的文字"（浅色主题设计值），深色主题下解析为深色，
  配软高亮底会变成黑字看不清；文字统一用 `--dsw-alias-label-primary`。

## 开发调试

- 改 `src/` 后执行 `pnpm build` 重新生成 `client.js`，再复制到 profile 触发
  HMR 热更新（页面无需刷新，DSH 会检测到文件变更并重新加载 bundle）：

  ```powershell
  pnpm build
  Copy-Item .\client.js $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-model-picker\client.js -Force
  ```

- 单元测试：`pnpm test`（`node --test`，覆盖 `src/pure.js` 的纯逻辑）。
- 构建校验：`pnpm check`（`node --check` 产物）。**CI 会校验 `client.js` 是否为
  最新构建**，改了 `src/` 忘了 build 会让 CI 失败。
- 若要源码改动即时生效（免复制），改用 `link:` 符号链接方式安装。
- 移除插件：DSH「设置 → 插件」里卸载 `dsh-model-picker` 即可。

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe

plugins.description: DSH 话匣子：让模型边做边说、卡住了就开口、把提问讲清楚，而不是闷头自己扛。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chatterbox（话匣子）

往系统提示里注入一段**常驻互动协议**的 DSH 插件：让「话少、爱自己扛、爱反复自查」的模型回到
**边说边做**的默认节奏。

- **边做边说**：动手前先说要做什么，做完一小段就聊两句，不把话攒到最后。
- **卡住了就开口**：需要人类的东西直接说；换目标、缩范围、弱化结论，都是他的决定，不必一个人扛。
- **把提问讲清楚**：默认在对话里问，先给背景和推荐；只有「挑一个」本身替人省力时才给选项。
- **验证有预算**：一次独立核查通常就够，把「已核对 / 待核对 / 已知风险」分开写。
- **说人话**：中文、短句、先说事实再给判断。

**默认对所有模型生效**（`modelPattern: ''` = 普适模式）；**陪伴模式默认不注入**（`skipPresets`）。

插件的语言刻意是**邀请式**的，不是纠错式：协议里不出现「失误」「悄悄」「废话」这类把人当小孩的词
（`node --test` 里有一条用例专门守这件事）。要求模型「说人话、别表演」，它自己先得是那个语气。

```
安装（本地目录）：plugin_manager action: install_bundle  target: "C:\Users\29411\dsh\插件\dsh-chatterbox"
安装（npm）：     dsh-chatterbox
安装（Release）： https://github.com/Astepluver/dsh-chatterbox/releases/latest/download/dsh-chatterbox.tgz
```

---

## 它解决什么（诊断结论，不是猜测）

「新模型话变少了、爱自己扛、爱反复自查」这三个现象，在本机逐条查过：

| 事实 | 证据 |
|---|---|
| 宿主里**没有任何**按 model id 分支的提示词、工具或 loop 逻辑 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent/lib/index.js` 的 `system-prompt/assemble` 监听器只把 `provider`/`model` 当**变量**塞进装配结果，没有 `if (model === …)` |
| 两份 shipped 预设的人设逐字相同 | `dsh-web-app/presets/{standard,ptc}.patch.yml:14` 都是 `You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.` |
| 「1017」是**界面徽章**，不是 model id | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deepseek-model-label-1017`：`lib/client.js` 只在 `provider ∈ {deepseek-account, deepseek-official} && model.id === 'deepseek-flash' && model.name === 'DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash'` 时加徽章；它的 host 半边是空的 `function apply() {}`。整个 `app.asar`（1.8 亿字节）字节扫描 `flash-1017` 命中 **0** |
| 本机两条 DeepSeek 路由的 model id | 官方 `deepseek-account/deepseek-flash`（界面挂 1017 徽章的那条）与网关 `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`——**都不含 1017** |
| shipped 提示词里**没有一条**要求「工具调用之间叙述进展」 | 全仓最接近的只有 `dsh-tool-todo/lib/index.js:21` 的 `… to plan multi-step work and show progress` |

结论：没有一条现成文本把「边做边说」拉住，模型自己的默认脾气一变，行为就直接变了；
而把白名单钉在发布日期上（`1017`）必然过时。所以默认人人有份，`modelPattern` 只留作**排除**某个模型的旋钮。

另外，「反复自查」有一部分来自**用户自己的预设**而不是模型：本 profile 的「分析模式」人设
（`profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）写着「反复检验分析过程」「能对拍就必须对拍」
「报告之前回头对一遍」。本插件**不动别人的预设**，只是把「验证要有预算」放回系统提示，让两种力量互相平衡。

## 机制

```
apply(ctx, config)
  └─ ctx.effect(() => ctx.systemPrompt.section({
        name: 'plugin:chatterbox',      // 全局唯一
        order: 720,                      // dsh-methodology 700 · PTC_ONLY 800
        interpolate: false,              // 关键：见下
        text: (context) => sectionText(...)   // 每个模型步骤前重新求值
     }))
```

- **`interpolate: false` 是必需的**：`section` 默认会做 `{{变量}}` 插值，宿主在渲染期严格解析，
  未知/畸形引用**直接 throw**；那个 throw 发生在 agent-loop 的 `renderPrompt()` 里，
  插件的 try/catch 拦不到，会让**每一轮根会话**以 error 收尾（2026-10-17 实测复现）。
  关掉之后，`extra` 里写 `{{` 也只是字面量。
- 段落文本为空串时宿主直接丢掉这一段（关掉分条不会留下空壳）。
- 每次 `assemble()` 重新求值（在 `agent/pre-step`、`agent/request` 之前），按会话/preset/模型逐步生效。
- 与 `dsh-methodology` 用同一个注册点、同一种零依赖写法（裸 config，不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，
  也不导出 `Config`），order 排在其后，两者不冲突。
- **所有异常路径都兜底**：段落求值、模型读取、诊断写入都不可能影响 prompt 装配；
  求值真的失败时会在诊断文件里留一条 `kind: "error"`，而不是静默消失。

## 配置（在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的插件行里覆盖）

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；false 时不注册任何东西 |
| `order` | `720` | 段落排序值 |
| `modelPattern` | `''` | **空 = 所有模型**；填子串（如 `deepseek`）或 `/正则/` 即收窄 |
| `matchProvider` | `true` | 收窄时是否连 provider 一起匹配（`provider/model` 整体） |
| `whenModelUnknown` | `'apply'` | 收窄时拿不到模型身份的兜底 |
| `scope` | `'root'` | `root` 只给根会话；`all` 连子代理一起给 |
| `skipPresets` | `['companion']` | 这些 preset 不注入（按会话 header 的 `agentPreset` 精确匹配），比 `scope` 更强 |
| `narrate` / `askInConversation` / `questionBox` / `verificationBudget` / `plainSpeech` | `true` | 五条分条的开关 |
| `extra` | `''` | 追加到协议末尾的文本（字面量注入，不插值） |
| `reassertAfterSilentSteps` | `6` | **连续多少步没出一句文字就重申一次**（0 = 关）。长会话对抗稀释的主力 |
| `reassertOnCompaction` | `true` | 每次压缩之后重申一次 |
| `reassertEveryTurns` | `0` | 另外按轮重申：每 N 轮一次（0 = 关；默认关，上面那条更准） |
| `reminder` | 见 `cordis.patch.yml` | 重申文本（两三行，落在历史末尾） |
| `diagnostics` | `true` | 每次求值记一行 JSON |
| `diagnosticsPath` | `''` | 留空 = 插件目录下 `.state/diagnostics.jsonl`（相对路径按进程 cwd 解析） |
| `diagnosticsMaxLines` | `500` | 超过就丢掉前一半；硬上限 5000 |

模型身份按三来源取，先拿到先用：**assemble 瀑布观测到的 `provider`/`model` → `agent.options`
→ `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`**。普适模式下完全不查模型身份。

## 长会话里为什么会「变淡」，以及重申

朋友反馈「聊久了 chatterbox 就失效，模型重新变沉默」。逐条查过，结论分两半：

**一、不是提示词没送到。** 循环自己的投影函数保证「线上最新一条非空 system 消息 = 当前渲染出来的
提示词」：提示词与线上不一致时，要么原地重写 node 0，要么追加一条新的
（`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:264-282`；压缩的范围永远从 index ≥ 1 开始，`node 0` 不受遮蔽）。
唯一能挡住已注册段落的机制是 `complete: true` 段（`dsh-system-prompt` 收尾只保留那一段），
本机没有任何插件用它。而且 in-history 路由的真实故障模式是**抛错**（`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`），
不是变冷淡。⇒ 「压缩把段落吞掉了」这个解释被证伪。

**二、是模型侧遵守度在衰减。** 本机实测同一台机器上两条装了本插件的会话，助手「带文字」的比例：

```
消息区间    带文字比例
   1- 20        80%
  21- 40        50%
  41- 60        75%
  61- 80        40%
  81-100        35%
 101-120        50%
 121-140        45%
 141-160        65%
 161-180        15%   ← 长取证过程
 181-189        11%
```

关键细节：掉到 11% 的那一整段沉默发生在**同一个 user turn 里**（约 60 步）。所以修法不是
「每 N 轮再说一遍」（那一轮里一次都不会触发），而是**按「连续多少步没说话」触发**：
`reassertAfterSilentSteps`。触发时插件会把一行极短的提醒，作为 runtime-context 快照
**追加到历史末尾**——也就是离模型最近的位置。

代价：每条重申约 110 字；模型只要正常说话就不会触发。

## 怎么确认它真的生效

看诊断文件（默认 `<插件目录>/.state/diagnostics.jsonl`），每次求值一行。**本机实测**：

```json
{"time":"…","kind":"section","sessionId":"session-4aa0a2f4-…","origin":null,"model":"deepseek-flash","provider":"deepseek-account","apply":true,"reason":"no-pattern（普适模式）"}
{"time":"…","kind":"section","sessionId":"e14f9dcf-…","origin":"subagent","model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash","provider":"opencode-go","apply":false,"reason":"scope=root 且本会话是子代理"}
{"time":"…","kind":"reassert","sessionId":"session-…","count":1,"trigger":"silent:6"}
{"time":"…","kind":"prompt-missing","sessionId":"session-…","seq":699,"len":10414,"turns":4}
```

- `kind:"section"`：装配层拿到（或没拿到）文本，附理由。
- `kind:"reassert"`：重申了一次，`trigger` 是 `silent:N` / `compaction` / `turns:N`。
- `kind:"prompt-missing"`：**某个系统提示里没有本段落**。这是「模型没看到」与
  「模型看到了但不照做」唯一客观的分界——朋友那边再出现变淡时，先看有没有这一行。

更强的证据：真实会话日志里，根会话那一步的 system message 依次是
identity(0) → persona(50) → methodology(1969) → **chatterbox(3133)** → sci-viz(750)——
段落确实进了模型看到的内容，不是「注册了但没生效」。

## 已验证 / 未验证

**已验证**：`node --test` 23 例全绿（门控/语气/诊断/异常路径，含「纠错腔词表」、
「注册必须带 `interpolate:false`」两条守卫）；`node --check`；安装结果 `application: applied`
且 `Config.listConfigs` 能查到行；`apply: true`/`false` 两条分支在真实会话里各跑出过；
段落文本在真实 prompt 中的位置已核对；`npm pack --dry-run` 产物齐全；
命名声明过 `validate-names.mjs`；`query-registry.mjs` 查过中央索引（未被登记）。

**重申链路已在真机跑通（2026-10-18，0.2.0）**，四段证据闭合：

```
1) 诊断 {"kind":"loaded","reassertAfterSilentSteps":6,…}                  ← 新版被加载
2) 诊断 {"kind":"reassert","count":1,"trigger":"silent:6"}                 ← 连续 6 步没说话触发
3) 会话日志 seq=1670  user/message  source=runtime-context  894 字         ← 提醒被追加到历史末尾
4) 模型侧：那一轮运行时上下文里确实出现了「（提醒 · 互动习惯）」两行提醒      ← 送到了
```

另外用真实事件流回放新代码：748 个装配点、首次重申落在历史里那段沉默的起点。

**未验证**：让模型**更愿意说话**这件事本身。机制（段落 + 重申 + 触发）可证、「模型因此变得更好聊」
不可证。DSH 自带的市场索引校验器在 `app.asar` 内，Node 无法 import，`market/index.json`
是按校验器源码逐条实现 + 本地 `--check` 保持一致，尚未被官方校验器实跑过。

## 已知限制

- **软引导，不是硬约束**：本插件不拦任何工具调用。需要机器强制的地方（例如子代理只读）
  应该用 `ctx.tools.guard` 另写。
- 不改变 `ask_user_question` 的存在：工作区里明确要求用提问框的流程照旧可用。
- 只给根会话（`scope: 'root'`）：子代理与 Agent Teams 队友拿不到（他们对面不是人；
  队友与一次性子代理共用 `origin: 'subagent'`）。想让队友也有，把 `scope` 改成 `'all'`。
- 同一层里段落名必须唯一：把本 bundle 同时挂进 profile 和某个 preset 会**同步抛错**（不是静默覆盖）。
- **token 成本**：默认配置下段落约 1.1k 字（中文），随每次请求常驻，属于系统提示里的稳定前缀。
- 改 `scope` / 开关会让系统提示前缀变化，从而失效一次提示缓存复用。
- 诊断文件只按行数上限截断，不做轮转；每步一次读+写（实测 ~0.3 ms/次）。

## 发布与收录

本机已有一套跑通过的流程（桌面 `插件发布`，dsh-sci-viz 用过），本仓库配套一份同样的工具包：

| 步骤 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 在 GitHub 建 **Public** 仓库 `Astepluver/dsh-chatterbox`（三个勾都不勾） |
| 2 | 把「上传用」文件夹里的东西全选拖进仓库（网页上传，绕开本机 Git 凭据问题） |
| 3 | About → ⚙️ → **Topics 填这 6 个**：`dsh-plugin`、`dsh-plugins`、`dsh-plugin-desktop`、`dsh-desktop`、`dsh-plugin-market`、`deepseek-harness` |
| 4 | 发 **Release**：tag `v0.1.0`，附件名必须正好是 **`dsh-chatterbox.tgz`** |
| 5 | （可选）双击 `❹ 发布到 npm.cmd`，别人就能用一行包名安装 |

**「收录的 tag 要求」就在这里**：第三方采集程序（`插件\dsh-plugin-mesh\backend\dsh_mesh\config.py:42-49`）
只看**两条**——topic 命中白名单，或**仓库名以 `dsh-` 开头**（`build.py:295-299`）；
无 topic 且描述短于 10 字会被丢弃（`build.py:287-289`）。0 星也能收录。

另外有一套**与上面无关**的机制：DSH 的实验性「自定义插件市场」（Plugins → Discover），
它读的是用户自己加的 index URL，格式为 **format 1**，硬规则见 [`market/README.md`](market/README.md)——
其中 `category` / `labels[]` 必须在索引自己的 `metadata` 里声明过，那是另一层"tag 要求"。

## 版本
