# dsh-plugin-git-composer [![CI](https://github.com/ls-open/dsh-git-composer/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ls-open/dsh-git-composer/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/ls-open/dsh-git-composer?color=blue)](https://github.com/ls-open/dsh-git-composer/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) > **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 桌面客户端与 Web 端的 Git 工作区状态感知与 PR 协同胶囊插件。 在输入框上方常驻显示 Git 分支名、真实代码增删行数（`+X -Y`）、一键点击审查行级 Diff，并无缝联动 GitHub PR 与 Actions CI 流水线状态。 --- ## 🖥️ 界面效果一览 挂载于 DSH 桌面端 / Web 端对话输入框（Composer）正上方：

--- ## 🎯 核心功能特性 全面打通本地代码修改感知、差异审查与 GitHub 云端流水线协同： | 交互模块 | 功能细节 | 行为表现 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **工作区胶囊** | 分支与仓库常驻 | 毫秒级提取当前所在仓库名与分支名（如 `my-repo main`） | | **一键快速切分支** | 零 Token 快捷检出 | 点击分支名下拉展开本地分支列表，毫秒级本地切换，无需额外向 AI 发送指令 | | **真实增删统计** | 动态 `+X -Y` | 底层调用 `git diff --numstat`，随着模型每次修改文件实时动态刷新，非静态伪造 | | **行级 Diff 审查** | 点击胶囊看改动 | 点击 `+X -Y` 徽章，**自动调用 DSH 官方内置的 Diff 审查抽屉**，逐行高亮查看改动细节 | | **自适应按钮** | 本地提交 vs 提 PR | • **无 Remote（纯本地仓库）**：自适应为 `Commit changes`，点击即让 AI 自动写提交信息并在本地 commit
• **有 Remote（GitHub 仓库）**：自适应为 `Create PR ▾` 下拉菜单 | | **PR 发起菜单** | 3 种提交模式 | 点击下拉可选：`Create PR`（直接提审）、`Create draft PR`（草稿 PR）、`Manually create PR...`（网页打开） | | **PR 状态感知** | 自动状态升级 | 当分支已关联 PR 时，自动渲染第二条独立卡片：显示 `⑂ #PR号` 及该 PR 的增删统计 | | **CI 流水线指示灯** | `⚬ CI ▾` 实时状态 | 轮询 GitHub Actions Checks：通过显示绿色点、构建中显示旋转动画、失败显示红色点，点击下拉可看每项 Job 结果 | | **风琴折叠堆叠** | `Show more` / `less` | 存在多条卡片时自动收折，绝不遮挡或挤占主对话输入框 | | **卡片独立关闭** | 右侧 `×` 按钮 | 点击可临时隐藏单条胶囊卡片 | --- ## 🚀 安装与启用指南（支持多种灵活方式） DSH 原生支持从**内置市场、GitHub 远程直装、npm 镜像、本地目录**等多种途径安装插件，你可以按自己的使用习惯选择最便捷的方式： ### 方式 1：DSH 客户端「插件市场」一键安装（最便捷） 1. 打开 DSH 桌面客户端，点击左侧菜单栏 **Plugins（插件市场）**； 2. 在搜索框输入 `dsh-plugin-git-composer`； 3. 点击 **Install（安装）**，安装完成后在列表中确保勾选为 **Enabled（启用）** 即可。 --- ### 方式 2：GitHub 远程直链安装（无需手动下载文件） 如果你不想手动下载 zip 或源码，可以直接通过 GitHub 仓库地址远程安装： - **GUI 界面操作**： 进入 DSH 客户端 **Settings（设置）** → **Plugins（插件）** → 点击 **Install from URL**，输入 GitHub 仓库地址： ```text https://github.com/ls-open/dsh-git-composer ``` - **或者通过终端命令直装**： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:ls-open/dsh-git-composer # 或默认 profile: dsh plugin add github:ls-open/dsh-git-composer ``` --- ### 方式 3：npm / 包管理器一键安装 对于通过包管理运行 DSH 的开发者，可通过标准 npm 方式加载： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-git-composer ``` --- ### 方式 4：本地源码 / 离线目录安装（开发者调试推荐） 如果你需要二次开发或处于离线内网环境： 1. 下载或克隆源码至本地目录（例如 `~/Downloads/dsh-git-composer`）； 2. 运行构建： ```bash cd ~/Downloads/dsh-git-composer && npm install && npm run build ``` 3. 在 DSH 客户端的 **Settings → Plugins** 中点击 **Install Local Plugin**，选择该文件夹即可。 --- ## ⚠️ 注意事项与前置说明 1. **GUI 客户端完全兼容**： - DSH 桌面客户端基于 Electron 构建，其前端渲染层与 Web 端共用一套 Cordis 插件插槽体系（`composer:header`）。包含 `cordis.patch.yml` 自动配置 Host 与 Client 端，两端完全通用。 2. **Git 环境要求**： - 宿主机需安装基础 `git` 工具； - 打开非 Git 文件夹时，插件会自动保持静默，绝不占用任何界面空间或弹错。 3. **GitHub PR / CI 特性依赖**： - “一键创建 PR”与“CI 流水线监控”通过本地官方 GitHub CLI（`gh`）完成； - 若未安装或未登录 `gh`，插件会**自动优雅降级为本地模式（只显示 `Commit changes` 和行级 Diff 审查）**，不影响正常使用。 --- ## 📂 项目结构 ``` dsh-git-composer/ ├── cordis.patch.yml # DSH 插件自动挂载声明（Host 端与 WebUI Client 端） ├── src/ │ ├── core/ │ │ ├── git.ts # 高性能 Git 状态、动态增删行数与 Diff 提取 (<15ms) │ │ └── github.ts # GitHub CLI 交互与 Actions CI 状态解析 │ ├── ui/ │ │ └── ComposerGitBar.tsx # 输入框上方高保真胶囊组件（动态行数、Diff 触发、PR 状态灯） │ ├── client.ts # 浏览器端插件入口（挂载 composer:header 插槽） │ └── index.ts # Cordis 宿主端插件入口（apply(ctx) 及工作区监听） ├── assets/ │ ├── preview.png # 真实 DSH 对话框效果预览图 │ └── preview.svg # 矢量设计源文件 ├── package.json # 双模导出（ESM/CJS、./client）与类型定义 ├── tsup.config.ts # 现代化打包配置 ├── tsconfig.json └── README.md ``` ## 📄 授权协议 MIT License

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

plugins.description: 为 DSH NEXT 提供会话删除、搜索管理、删除确认和可选备份的社区插件。
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Chat Prune

为 DSH NEXT 整理对话：统一查看、批量归档、按规则保留，确认后修剪。

安装 · 快速上手 · 使用指南 · 更新记录 · 参与贡献

DSH Chat Prune 是一个社区维护的对话管理插件。它在 DSH NEXT 侧边栏提供快捷删除和“管理对话”入口，让你在清理之前看清记录、来源、占用和保护状态。 ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | |---|---| | 侧边栏入口 | 删除单条对话，或从底部打开管理窗口；适配展开与折叠状态 | | 搜索与筛选 | 按标题、工作区、会话 ID、来源、状态、更新时间和大小查找记录 | | 批量管理 | 跨页选择，批量归档、取消归档、置顶、取消置顶或删除 | | 保留规则 | 每个工作区保留最近 N 条，只选择早于指定天数的候选记录 | | 多来源管理 | 合并多个 DSH 数据目录；连接各自的本机宿主后统一操作 | | 预览与备份 | 执行前核对完整目标，逐条反馈结果，可停止后续操作 | | 主题适配 | 跟随宿主的浅色、深色和自定义主题即时变化 | ## 运行环境 - **系统：Windows。** macOS / Linux 暂不支持在线删除。 - **宿主：DSH NEXT。** 需要客户端插件、工作区服务和会话持久化服务。 - **安装工具：桌面版自带的 `dsh` 命令。** 源码开发建议使用 Node.js 24，插件最低要求 Node.js 20。 宿主接口可能随版本变化，详细兼容边界见[技术说明](./docs/technical-reference.md)。 ## 安装 先启动一次 DSH NEXT 完成 profile 初始化，再从系统托盘正常退出。使用桌面版提供的命令安装： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/Cans518/dsh-chat-prune/releases/download/v0.4.5/dsh-chat-prune-0.4.5.tgz ``` 重新打开 DSH 即可使用。安装包已包含构建产物，安装时会自动启用插件，无需克隆仓库、编译或手动添加 YAML 挂载条目。 也可以在 [Releases](https://github.com/Cans518/dsh-chat-prune/releases/latest) 下载 `.tgz` 和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`，校验后从本地安装： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\Downloads\dsh-chat-prune-0.4.5.tgz" ``` 终端找不到 `dsh` 时，请先启用 DSH NEXT 桌面版的命令行入口，再重新打开终端。使用 Web profile 时将 `desktop` 换成 `web`；请安装到实际使用的 profile。 ## 快速上手 ### 删除一条对话 展开左侧工作区，鼠标移到具体会话行，点击垃圾桶。核对目标与备份设置后确认删除；Escape 或“取消”可放弃操作。 ### 批量整理 1. 点击侧边栏底部的“管理对话”。 2. 搜索或筛选记录，选择本页或全部筛选结果。 3. 选择归档、置顶或删除等操作，点击“预览所选操作”。 4. 核对完整目标清单，再确认执行。结果逐条显示，可停止尚未开始的操作。 ### 按规则修剪 在管理窗口打开“按保留规则修剪”，例如设置“每个工作区保留最近 10 条，只修剪早于 30 天的记录”，生成候选后预览并确认。 “最近 N 条”按每个来源中的整个工作区计算。置顶、运行中、无法安全释放、记录缺失或时间未知的对话受保护。 多来源连接、筛选规则、备份配置和常见问题见[使用指南](./docs/user-guide.md)。 ## 数据安全与备份 **归档保留记录，删除会移除本地记录。** 单条删除默认不备份，批量删除默认勾选备份；确认前请核对设置。 - 删除由数据目录所属宿主执行，并检查会话写入所有权；正在运行或无法安全释放的会话会被拒绝。 - 开启备份时，备份失败则不删除。备份保存在对应数据目录的 `deleted-sessions/`。 - 恢复需要先正常退出 DSH，再按备份中的 `restore.json` 手动还原记录和索引；备份不会自动清理。 - 未连接宿主的额外来源只读展示；移除来源设置不会删除对话。 如何开启全局备份见[使用指南](./docs/user-guide.md#备份设置)，恢复步骤见[技术说明](./docs/technical-reference.md#备份与恢复)。 ## 更新与卸载 更新前正常退出 DSH，并另存自己修改过的插件配置；按新 Release 的说明执行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <新安装包地址>`，再重新打开 DSH。 卸载： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-chat-prune ``` 卸载不会恢复已删除的记录，也不会清理已有备份。手动停用过的插件需要到 DSH 的插件管理页重新启用。 ## 文档 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [使用指南](./docs/user-guide.md) | 多来源连接、筛选、批量操作、备份设置与常见问题 | | [技术说明](./docs/technical-reference.md) | 宿主接口、删除边界、所有权、备份恢复与客户端入口 | | [参与贡献](./CONTRIBUTING.md) | 开发环境、测试、目录职责与提交建议 | | [发布流程](./docs/releasing.md) | 版本更新、自动发布、附件校验与补发 | | [更新记录](./CHANGELOG.md) | 面向使用者的版本变更 | ## 本地开发 ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Cans518/dsh-chat-prune.git cd dsh-chat-prune npm ci --legacy-peer-deps npm run build npm test ``` 修改客户端源码后需重新构建并提交 `client.js`。CI 在 Windows 的 Node.js 20 和 24 上运行验证；新版本推送到 `main` 并通过检查后，Action 自动打标签、打包并创建 Release。 ```text .github/ CI、发布工作流与 Issue 模板 assets/ 项目图标 docs/ 使用、技术及维护文档 lib/ 宿主接口、会话管理与纯筛选规则 scripts/ 构建、校验、安装与维护工具 test/ 逻辑、浏览器及宿主集成测试 client-*.js 客户端源模块 client.js 已提交的客户端构建产物 ``` ## 参与贡献 欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/Cans518/dsh-chat-prune/issues) 报告问题、提出功能建议，或提交 Pull Request。问题反馈请附插件版本、DSH 版本、操作步骤和脱敏后的错误信息。 开始开发前请阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)。测试使用临时目录与虚构记录，请勿使用真实对话验证删除行为。 ## 许可证 本项目的代码与图标采用 [MIT License](./LICENSE)。DSH Chat Prune 为社区项目，与 DSH 官方无隶属关系。

--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

# dsh-plugin-verispring

Verispring three-role session architecture plus a bundled local knowledge graph (manon), substantially improving main-session context and reducing premium model API costs.
[中文](README.zh.md) | English

## What it enforces

| # | Gate | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Dispatch spec gate | `subagent` / `subagent_fork` requires the dispatch spec content to have appeared in the session (a read result containing the spec's first-line marker; state is persisted in the session log and survives restarts) |
| 2 | Resident scout | The first dispatch of a session is pinned to the scout role at runtime (`description` is a display label only); once resident, repeats are denied with a `send_message` reuse pointer; escape hatch `touch /tmp/dsh-caseos-scout-reset-<pid>` (path is in the denial), and the reset is persisted too |
| 3 | Map first | Non-scout dispatch requires `<session workspace>/.project-map.md` (project root = `.git`/`.manon` present; otherwise fail-open) |
| 4 | Pinned model | Routes are enforced at runtime per role: the first dispatch uses the panel's scout route, later ones the executor route; explicit `provider`/`model` on the call is ignored. `subagent_fork` is always denied |
| 5 | Commit gate | `git commit` requires a prior read of `~/.dsh/specs/代码写作规范.md` |
| 6 | Leader scope | The leader's tool face shrinks to the review five (`bash`/`edit`/`write`/`read`/`read_image`) plus the dispatch face (`subagent`/`send_message`/`interrupt_agent`/`list_agents`), intersected with the tools that actually exist in the leader's view (desktop serves them from the preset layer, headless from the root layer); dispatch tools are shadowed by slim definitions. Scout and executor subagents get the full face of the `verispring-subagent` preset, and scouts are hard-denied `edit`/`write` through the dispatch request. Kill switch `CASEOS_SCOUT=0` drops the scout part of the division clause |
| 7 | manon bridge | Resolves the local graph CLI (`MANON_KG_BIN` > bundled `manon/manon-kg` > legacy `~/manon/manon-kg`) and, when present, injects a concise usage section: command surface, store location, scout ownership, semantics in `~/.dsh/specs/Manon调用规则.md`. **The load-bearing part is the invocation rule**: dsh's subprocess service strips KEY/TOKEN-shaped env vars from children (anti-leak), so a bare `manon-kg sync` always fails with a missing key — the injected form sources `~/.dsh/manon.env` inside the bash command first (the scrub only strips the first hop; grandchildren inherit freely). Secret values never pass through or get printed |

The bundle patch also configures the subagent tool: `backgroundMode: continuable`, `maxDepth: 1`,
and the executor persona; both presets turn `modelSelectionSettings` off on `tool-subagent`
(routes are enforced per role, so model selection has no effect, and when it is on the `subagent`
tool registers into each session's own layer where the routing wrapper cannot shadow it). The
dispatch entry uses DSH's official activation API and returns a child id immediately; use the
child continuation tools for subsequent messages. In headless/CLI runs the process exits with
the turn, so child work is not retained after the process ends.

## Context compaction (per role)

| Role | Mounted on | Trigger → summary cap |
|---|---|---|
| Main session (leader) | compaction group of the `standard` preset | 40% of the context window (~400k on a 1M window) → summary capped at 40k tokens |
| Scout/executor subagents | compaction group of the `verispring-subagent` preset | 60% of the context window (~600k) → summary capped at 60k tokens |

Both policies prune oversized tool results first (a result over 8192 characters keeps its first
4096 and last 1024), then condense the safely balanced history with DSH's structured template; no
verbatim tail is kept, and context overflow retries automatically. The summary length is chosen
by the model from a fixed template; the cap only bounds it, and real summaries usually run far shorter.

Subagents on `verispring-subagent`: the harness spawn request has no preset field and a child
inherits its parent's preset by default; dispatch-gate switches the child inside its creation
window (`agent/created`, before the first prompt) and records an `agent-preset/selected` event,
so a cold resume recomposes from the session log. The headless one-shot runner
(`dsh --profile … "<task>"`) composes no preset for the main session, so the main session does
not get the `standard` 400k policy — only a root-level `compaction-basic` if the profile enables
one; subagents are unaffected.

## Install

```bash
# Install / update (tracks main; pin a release with a tag like #v1.3.3)
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:brandonzyy/dsh-plugin-verispring

# Desktop app: Settings → Plugins → install, paste the same spec
```

The desktop app enables HMR by default (the base bundle turns it on whenever a profile
context exists), so installs initiated through the plugin manager **apply immediately** —
no restart needed. Already-running sessions keep their current tree; new sessions and new
dispatches pick up the new one. A restart is only required where HMR is explicitly disabled
(headless/SDK/ACP). Updates: uninstall and reinstall the same spec (the platform reserves
the Update button for official on-demand bundles).

## manon component (bundled)

`manon/` ships the full local code-graph CLI: the `manon-kg` entry, the
`matrixone_graph`/`codeindex`/`core` sources, and a frozen `requirements.txt`
(click/httpx/networkx/numpy/rich/PyYAML + the full tree-sitter language family — all
prebuilt wheels). Bridge resolution order: explicit `MANON_KG_BIN` > **bundled component**
(version-matched to this package) > legacy `~/manon/manon-kg`.

On first run the component bootstraps a Python venv and installs its dependencies (one-time
network, python3 ≥3.11 required), then works offline. The venv lives under
`${DSH_HOME:-~/.dsh}/manon-kg-runtime` (the installed package directory is read-only; the
runtime never writes into the package). tree-sitter language packs load
dynamically; a missing pack only downgrades that language. Keys come from
`~/.dsh/manon.env` + `~/.dsh/verispring.env`, sourced inside the bash command by the
injected invocation.

## Prerequisites (the gates tell you what is missing)

- **Profile composition**: the agent preset registry and a `preset-standard` entry (shipped by the
  desktop app and the web bundle). A bare `dsh-headless` profile has neither, and the plugin patch
  fails to load with `entry "preset-standard" not found`.
- **Spec files**: `~/.dsh/specs/子代理派遣规范.md` and `~/.dsh/specs/代码写作规范.md`
  (resolved against the home directory). Missing specs mean the corresponding gate keeps
  denying with directions — by design: every denial must be satisfiable.
- **Model route**: the profile needs a `verispring` provider with a `deepseek-flash`
  model (via `llm-pi-ai` or an equivalent adapter). For another gateway, update
  `agentOptions` in `cordis.patch.yml` and `DEFAULT_ROUTES` in
  `gates/dispatch-gate.js`, keeping the two in sync (a saved panel wins via `~/.dsh/verispring.json`).
- **manon (optional)**: bundled — no local install needed. Keys live in `~/.dsh/manon.env`
  (`MANON_EMBEDDING_API_KEY`, sync embeddings) and `~/.dsh/verispring.env`
  (`VERISPRING_API_KEY`, deep-query fallback); the injected invocation sources both files
  itself, so model/endpoint overrides (`MANON_DEEPQUERY_*` / `MANON_EMBEDDING_*`) set there
  apply to every session. Without manon, every other gate is unaffected.

## Configuration panel (v1.3+)

After install, the bundle detail page displays the configuration directly. The panel uses
the DSH shared form controls and reads the live model catalog, so provider and model choices
stay aligned with the Models configuration. The three agent route slots are editable and apply on save; the main session uses the native DSH model picker.
While the panel has never been saved (everything at defaults), the plugin rewrites no
enforcement surface — `verispring.json` and `manon.env` keep your
native values:

| Panel field | Persisted to | Takes effect |
|---|---|---|
| Surveying/executi

# dsh-douyin-publish（视频发布器 · 抖音 / B站）

**把一段本地视频，一路送到投稿页的"待发布"状态。**

打开投稿页 → 版式自检 → **把文件直接塞进页面自己的上传控件** → 填标题 → 填文案/话题 → 设可见性 → **默认停手**。

> 这是九个作品里唯一的"功能"（其余多是工具）：它不止给 AI 加一个动作，
> 而是替使用者跑完一条链 —— 开页面、交文件、填表、判断该不该发。
> 也正因为如此，它的默认值必须**保守**。

---

## 0.4.2：B站真正吃文件的是那个"藏着"的 input（2026-10-17 晚，真机）

第二次真机跑，卡在"等了 61 秒编辑表单没出来"。查下来：B站投稿页有**三个** `input[type=file]` ——
一个**隐藏**的（外面包着 `.bcc-upload-wrapper`）、一个看得见的按钮里的、一个给字幕的 `.txt`。
**真正驱动上传的是隐藏的那个**；塞进看得见的那个，页面一动不动（文件在 input 里，但没人接）。

旧代码按"可见优先"挑，正好挑错。现在：

1. 候选按 **DOM 先后**排，不再按可见性；
2. 塞完先**看页面有没有往前走**（编辑表单出现），没走就**换下一个候选**试，最多 3 个；
3. 回执里写明"塞进了第 N 个上传控件"。

## 0.4.1：真机上遇到的两个"不是改版"的情况（2026-10-17 晚）

第一次拿真 B站账号跑 v0.4.0，卡在"版式自检"——不是选择器坏了，是两件真事：

1. **上传按钮比 `input[type=file]` 晚渲染**。旧代码只要看到 file input 就去自检，
   而 B站的上传区还在画 → 误报 `layout-changed`。现在会**等上传区真的出现**（最多 15 秒）。
2. **B站会提示"本地浏览器存在 N 个未提交的视频 → 继续编辑 / 不用了"**。自动化不该接管别人的旧草稿：
   现在看到这个提示会点「不用了」，从新稿开始（旧稿原样留着），并在回执里记一笔。
   如果页面**直接**把旧稿恢复成编辑态（没给"不用了"），会明确报 `resumed-draft`，
   让你先去处理那条旧稿——而不是猜成"改版"。

## 配乐：让用户自己在平台曲库里挑（v0.6.0）

**不是本地音乐库**。抖音自己的曲库里有搜歌、试听、使用那一套，那是平台的东西，
我们不去复制它 —— 我们只负责**把那个面板打开、再往前送一步**：

```
douyin_upload({ ..., pickMusic: true })                  // 打开面板 + 聚焦搜索框
douyin_upload({ ..., pickMusic: true, musicSearch: "轻快" })  // 打开面板 + 顺手搜「轻快」
```

流程是：填完标题/文案/话题/封面 → 点右侧「添加音乐」标签 → 等「选择音乐」侧边面板长出来
→ **把「搜索音乐」框聚焦** → **停**。剩下的打字/试听/点「使用」由人在浏览器窗口里做
（平台会自己把歌混进视频）。

真机核对的细节（2026-10-18）：入口不是文案「添加音乐」，而是右侧那颗 `div[class*=preview-button]`
标签；点开后的面板里有一个 `input[placeholder*="搜索音乐"]`，它外面盖着遮罩，**点不可靠、`el.focus()` 可靠**。
`mode=publish` 时不打开面板（避免和发布撞在一起）；B站的曲库面板还没核对，传了会标 warn 跳过。

**`musicSearch` 是实验性的**：我在这台机器上没能稳定把词打进去 —— 脚本改 `value`（native setter、
`execCommand`）都能改值，但抖音的搜索只在**真实键盘事件**时才触发；而插件会话里的按键投递时好时坏。
所以它默认只做"打开面板 + 聚焦"，词打不进去时回执会**如实说**"请你手动在搜索框里输"，不会假装成功。
不想点的话，用下面的 `bgmPath` 走本地混音。

**另一条路（可选）**：`bgmPath` 给一段本地音频，它会先用 ffmpeg 混好再上传（原视频不动），
`bgmVolume` 默认 0.35 —— 适合"我就要这一首，别让我点"的场景。

## 两条默认值是刻意的

| 参数 | 默认 | 要改成别的必须显式说 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `visibility` | **`private`（仅自己可见）** | `visibility: 'public'` / `'friends'` |
| `mode` | **`draft`（不点投稿）** | `mode: 'publish'` |

发布是**不可逆且对外可见**的动作。所以这个插件默认只做到"表填好、停投稿前"，
你要发，就再说一次。想先看看会发生什么，用 `dryRun: true`。

**平台没有你要的可见性时，插件直接拒绝**（`visibility-unsupported`），
不会"默认当你没说过"然后按公开发出去。

## 文件是怎么交给页面的（v0.4 的关键改动）

以前靠"真点上传按钮 → 等系统『打开文件』对话框 → 用 UI 自动化填路径"，
那条路要碰另一个进程的窗口、会挡住使用者、还得起 PowerShell，
**而且它出过一次"看起来成功、其实没交上"的事故**（见下）。

现在默认走**注入**：

1. 本机在 `127.0.0.1` 的一个随机端口起一个**只读、只服务这一个文件、带随机令牌**的小服务；
2. 页面自己 `fetch` 回来，用 `DataTransfer` 造一个真 `File`，塞进页面的 `input[type=file]`，
   派发 `input`/`change`；
3. 之后就是页面自己的上传逻辑在跑 —— 和"人手选文件"完全一样，但**不弹对话框、不挡人**。

安全边界写死：只绑回环地址、只认一条路由（令牌不对一律 404）、不列目录、用完就关（另有空闲超时兜底）。

**什么时候退回系统对话框**：文件超过 `maxInjectBytes`（默认 512MB）、
或注入被页面拦下（CSP/CORS）。退回时会**回读校验**，读不回来就判失败 —— 不点确认、不假装成功。

## 它做什么（每一步都留证据）

| 步 | 动作 | 细节 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ① | 检查视频 | 大小 / 分辨率 / 时长 / 编码（ffprobe，拿不到也不拦） |
| ①' | **配乐（可选）** | 给了 `bgmPath` 就先用 ffmpeg 混一段新视频：原视频有声→与原声混合（`bgmVolume` 默认 0.35）、无声→BGM 铺满；**原视频不动**，混音失败直接报错不硬发 |
| ② | 借浏览器会话 | 用自己的会话键，和别的任务不串台 |
| ③ | 打开投稿页 | 平台档案里的地址（抖音 / B站） |
| ④ | 等上传控件 | 轮询到 `input[type=file]` 出现为止 |
| ④' | **版式自检（投稿页）** | 上传控件 / 「上传视频」区域缺一个 → 立刻报 `layout-changed` 并点名，不硬着头皮跑 |
| ⑤ | **交文件** | 注入（默认）；大文件或注入失败才退回系统对话框 |
| ⑥ | 等编辑页 | 按平台的"编辑控件是否出现"判（B站**不换 URL**，URL 只当旁证） |
| ⑥' | **版式自检（编辑页）** | 标题框 / 投稿按钮缺一个 → 同样当场报 `layout-changed` |
| ⑦ | 填标题 | **整段写入后回读**（B站会预填文件名，所以要覆盖而不是追加） |
| ⑦' | **填文案 + 代填话题** | 抖音：文案与 `#话题` 都进简介，打完回读；B站：文案进简介，话题进「标签」并回车确认 |
| ⑧ | 设可见性 | 抖音按中文标签点 checkbox；B站展开「更多设置 → 可见范围」再选，**回读选中态** |
| ⑧' | **设封面帧** | 只有抖音做：打开「选择封面」→ 时间轴挪到 `coverTime`（**默认第 1 秒**，第 0 帧常是黑场）；设不上只标 warn |
| ⑨ | 投稿，或**故意不投稿** | `mode=draft` 时这一步记 `skipped` |

失败会分类说清：`no-browser` / `platform-unsupported` / `visibility-unsupported` /
`upload-page-timeout` / `edit-page-timeout` / `layout-changed` / `handover` / `visibility` / `bgm`。

## 平台

| 平台 | 状态 | 差异 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **抖音** | ✅ 真机核对过 | 话题写进简介；可见性三档（公开/好友/仅自己可见）；封面帧可设 |
| **B站** | ✅ 真机核对过（2026-10-17） | **不换 URL**就切到编辑态；标题预填文件名；话题进「标签」（回车）；可见范围在「更多设置」里（公开可见/仅自己可见，**没有好友**）；封面帧未核对 |
| 小红书 / X | ⛔ 还没核对 | 传 `platform="xiaohongshu"` 之类会**明确拒绝**（`platform-unsupported`），不拿别的平台的选择器去瞎点 |

要扩到别的平台，前提是**先真机把那个平台的投稿页走一遍**（登录态、上传入口、标题/简介框、
话题落地方式、可见性入口、投稿按钮），再往 `lib/platforms.js` 补一份档案 ——
这是"给别人用"的底线，不能拿猜的选择器充数。

## 它依赖什么

- **浏览器插件**（借宿主的 `ctx.browser` 服务）—— 没有时**明确报错**，不会假装能用。
- **可选**：`ffprobe`（没有也能发，只是少了元信息）。
- 大文件才需要的退路：自带 `lib/handover.ps1`（与作者的 `dsh-file-handover` 同源，
  但各作品独立成仓，不互相依赖）。

## 安装

市场收录后在 DSH 里搜 `dsh-douyin-publish` 安装。手动安装：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-douyin-publish" -Target "D:\dsh\projects\dsh-douyin-publish"
# profile 的 package.json：dependencies 加 "dsh-douyin-publish": "link:D:/dsh/projects/dsh-douyin-publish"
# 并把 "dsh-douyin-publish" 加进 dsh.profile.bundles（漏了不加载）→ 重启 DSH
```

**发布前先做这两件事**：① 装好浏览器插件；② 在浏览器窗口里**登录对应平台的创作中心**
（登录态存在浏览器 profile 里，一次登录可跨重启复用）。

## 用法

```
douyin_upload videoPath=D:\videos\a.mp4 [platform=douyin|bilibili] title="标题" \
  [description="文案"] [topics="猫,狗"] [coverTime=1] [visibility=private] [mode=draft|publish] [dryRun]
```

典型流程：`dryRun: true` 看一眼 → 正式跑一次（停投稿前）→ 到浏览器里核对 → `mode: 'publish'` 真发。

## 已知限制

- **版式绑定**：选择器基于真机实测（抖音 2026-10-16、B站 2026-10-17）；
  平台改版后需要同步更新。插件**先自检再动手**：关键控件缺一个就当场报 `layout-changed` 并点名缺什么。
- **注入会把文件读进浏览器渲染进程**：所以设了 `maxInjectBytes`（默认 512MB）上限，超过自动退回系统对话框。
- **抖音话题是"联想式"的**：代填是把 `#话题` 打字进简介框，**是否被转成真标签由页面决定**；
  所以填完一定回读，读不齐就明说"请在页面上看一眼"，不假装成功。
- **B站标签上限 20 字**：超长的话题会被页面截断，回执里会提醒。
- **封面是尽力而为**（仅抖音）：靠封面弹窗里的时间轴定位；弹窗里没有时间轴时只标 warn、保留默认封面。
- **验证码 / 风控不硬试**：检测到就停下请人到浏览器窗口处理，再继续。
- **系统对话框那条退路仅 Windows**：注入这条路是跨平台的。
- **不做内容创作**：剪片、封面图、文案是内容管线的事（用 ffmpeg 等），这个插件只负责"送上去"。

## 自测

```powershell
node test/smoke.mjs   # 165 项：假浏览器 + 假 spawn + 真起一个回环小服务；断言编排序列、默认值、失败分类、版式自检、话题/标签、可见性、平台拒绝
```

## License

MIT
