plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Git

一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的原生 Git 插件。采用紧凑的 IDE 风格，并随宿主明暗主题自适应，在当前 DSH 工作区下提供分支、提交历史、提交图、文件差异和 Git worktree 管理。

## 已实现

- **Git 初始化**：在未使用 Git 的已注册工作区中，经确认执行 `git init --initial-branch=main`；已有 `.git` 元数据（包括损坏元数据）不会被覆盖。
- **右上角 Git 入口**：向会话工具栏追加入口，不覆盖宿主原有按钮。没有活动会话时提供右上角备用入口。
- **底部面板**：支持拖动调整高度、键盘调整、最大化、收起，以及多个独立 Git 视图标签。
- **主题自适应界面**：表面、边框与文字色全部取自 DSH 宿主令牌；强调色、语义色和提交图/差异配色随宿主明暗主题调整，浅色主题下不会出现低对比的荧光色。焦点环、悬停/禁用态、按钮按压反馈、弹层触发点缩放与 `prefers-reduced-motion` 一并处理。
- **三栏仓库视图**：左侧分支/更改，中间提交历史及真实父子关系提交图，右侧变更文件树、提交正文、作者、时间与引用。
- **分支下拉**：搜索本地和远程分支；更新、提交、推送、新建分支、抓取远程；签出前明确确认。
- **不同的右键菜单**：当前分支与其他本地/远程分支分别提供适用操作，也有可通过键盘打开的“更多操作”按钮。
- **分支旁的加号**：紧邻分支选择；两个选项严格为“GIT工作区”和“工作树”。前者新增仓库视图，后者显示真实的 `git worktree list` 结果。
- **清晰的菜单与选择框**：分支下拉、右键菜单及子菜单均为不透明实色背景；工作区选择框采用圆角。
- **平铺历史筛选**：分支、用户、日期始终显示在提交图顶部，支持组合与一键清除；日期包括今天、最近 7/30/90 天与最近一年（按 Git 提交时间）。
- **优选（cherry-pick）**：位于提交图顶部最右侧，将选中的普通提交应用到当前本地分支；要求工作区干净并明确确认，支持冲突后继续或中止，不猜测合并提交的主父提交。
- **工作树**：创建、查看、打开为插件查看目录、复制路径、锁定/解锁、安全移除；保护主工作树、当前查看目录、已锁定或有改动的工作树。
- **日常 Git**：逐文件/全部暂存与取消暂存、提交已暂存内容、分支创建/重命名/安全删除、合并、变基、仅快进更新、设置上游、非强制推送、抓取远程、远程分支删除。
- **冲突处理**：保留冲突现场；在编辑器解决冲突后，可在“更改”中暂存并继续/中止合并、变基或优选。
- **友好的空状态**：非 Git 目录不是异常；另行区分 Git 未安装、目录消失、权限/执行失败。

### 实现说明

插件按紧凑的深色 IDE 布局实现，对接依据为 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2**、Cordis **4.0.4** 的公开服务与注册契约。

该宿主没有公开的原生 bottom-panel 插槽，因此底部面板通过公开 `shell.overlay` 实现为**固定、可缩放的底部覆盖层**，不会伪造不存在的宿主 API。它不会把宿主聊天区域整体重新排版，增大面板会遮住其下方内容。

插件不会自行修改 DSH 的运行中配置，也不会自行重启宿主；安装后是否需要重启由宿主提示决定。

## 安装

插件以**组合包**（bundle）形式安装：包由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明一个配置层，安装进某个 **profile** 后，该层向组合中插入一行 `dsh-git` 插件。

- `<你的-profile>` 需替换为你实际使用的 profile 名；桌面应用所用 profile 可从 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/` 下的目录名确认。
- 命令中的 `dsh` 指已安装的 DSH CLI。

### 方式一：从源码构建后安装（推荐）

需要 Node.js **22+**、pnpm 与 Git。下述命令克隆源码、构建产物，再把 checkout 链接进 profile：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/cyrusgogogo/dsh-git.git
cd dsh-git
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build

# 本目录已包含 dist/ 构建产物，链接进 profile
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add .
```

也可以先打包，再安装 tarball；生成物可以拷给其他人直接安装：

```sh
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add ./dsh-git-0.1.2.tgz
```

### 方式二：直接从 GitHub 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add github:cyrusgogogo/dsh-git
```

git 安装拉到的是**源码而非构建产物**，因此 pnpm 会运行本包的 `prepare` 脚本（`node scripts/build.mjs`）在安装时构建发布入口。pnpm ≥10 默认拒绝执行依赖的构建脚本，第一次 `add` 可能因此失败并打印修法：把 pnpm 给出的确切包键写进该 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml`，然后重新执行 `add`。

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-git: true
```

这等于**允许该包的代码在安装时于你的机器上执行**（不在 agent 沙箱内），请只对可信来源授权；需要可复现的安装时锁定 commit，例如 `github:cyrusgogogo/dsh-git#<sha>`。

### 安装后核对

```sh
# 组合后的配置中应出现 id/name 为 dsh-git 的根行
dsh --profile <你的-profile> --dump-config
```

保存成功不代表当前进程已激活。若宿主报告 `restart-required`，请重启 DSH 并刷新 Web 页面。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> remove dsh-git
```

安装/分层依据：[官方插件发布与安装说明](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/publish.md)。插件只追加自己的配置行，不修改其他插件的完整配置对象。

### 从源码开发

要求 Node.js **22+**、pnpm、Git **2.31+**。

```powershell
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build
pnpm run test
pnpm run test:ui
pnpm run dev
```

浏览器测试优先使用 Playwright 对应的 Chromium，Windows 缺少时尝试本机 Edge。可通过 `DSH_GIT_BROWSER` 指定测试浏览器可执行文件；没有可用浏览器时，按需手工执行 `pnpm exec playwright install chromium`。测试不需要访问真实 DSH 页面、不需要模型密钥、不连接外部 Git 远程。

在 Windows DSH agent 沙箱中，捕获子进程输出和浏览器进程管道可能返回 `spawn EPERM`。这属于运行测试的沙箱边界，不是插件声称能够绕过的权限；需由操作者为相应测试命令授权。

`pnpm run dev` 只监听并重建本项目产物，不会自动把插件注入已安装的 profile；宿主端的客户端 HMR 取决于它实际加载的位置和对应的重建通知。

当前只在 Windows 上完成实机验证；macOS/Linux 的实现路径存在，但未做实机验收。

## 使用

1. 在 DSH 选择工作区/会话，点击右上角 **Git**。
2. 面板跟随主会话所属的注册工作区，也可以在面板右上角显式选择目录。
3. 非 Git 目录可选择 **初始化 Git 仓库**，确认后创建空的 `main`；已有 `.git` 元数据（包括损坏元数据）不会被覆盖。
4. 点击侧边栏分支筛选其历史；**双击**或右键“签出”进行切换。下拉列表点击其他分支同样需要确认。
5. 搜索提交，在提交图顶部直接按**分支、用户、日期**筛选；点击提交查看文件树，点击文件查看只读统一差异。
6. “更改”用于暂存；提交对话框只提交**已暂存**内容，不默认暂存全部文件。
7. 分支选择旁的 **＋ → 工作树** 查看/管理 worktree。“打开”仅切换**本插件**的仓库查看目录，不会偷偷修改 DSH 会话的工作区或 cwd。
8. 在干净工作区中，选中普通提交后点击最右侧的 **优选**，确认提交哈希和当前分支再执行 cherry-pick。发生冲突时先关闭错误对话框，在编辑器解决冲突并于“更改”中暂存，再通过顶部提示条继续；也可以确认中止以恢复操作前状态。

### 键盘

- 标签页：左右方向键、Home、End；当前标签为主要 Tab 停靠点。
- 提交列表：上下方向键、Home、End。
- 分支菜单、下拉、对话框：Radix 管理焦点与键盘行为；Esc 关闭，执行中的操作对话框不会被 Esc 意外关闭。
- 面板上边缘：聚焦后使用上下方向键调整高度，Home/End 调整到预设/最大高度；双击切换最大化。

## 安全与限制

- **执行者是 DSH 宿主机器上的 Git**，不是模型工具沙箱中的 Git。现有 Git hooks、SSH、凭据助手和用户配置可能执行代码/访问网络。仅对可信工作区使用写操作。
- 不使用 shell，不允许客户端提供任意命令、可执行文件或 cwd；工作区路径只从宿主注册表解析。
- 选择的 linked worktree 必须与原工作区的规范化 Git common directory 一致；不允许陈旧登记把操作导向另一个仓库。
- 同一仓库的修改串行执行，并在锁内重新发现仓库，检查对话框打开时的 HEAD/分支预期值。
- 对解析出的真实短分支名再次校验；显式终止选项解析，防止异常引用名变为 `--force` 等选项。
- 远程操作依据 `remote.<name>.fetch` refspec 反向定位来源。**映射歧义会拒绝操作，不会猜测远程名并删除错误仓库的分支。**
- 不提供强制推送、`reset --hard`、`branch -D`、强制覆盖 checkout 或强制移除工作树。
- 远程删除需额外输入完整分支显示名；会真实影响远程和协作者，请谨慎操作。
- 取消/超时会终止拥有的 Git 进程树；已经完成的提交、推送等副作用**不会因此自动回滚**。
- 工作区外普通文件读取、Git 元数据路径、越界路径不接受；未跟踪文件读取校验真实路径并限量。
- 命令输出有上限；大差异会截断并明确提示。二进制差异不提供图像对比，未提供文件编辑器、stash、revert、合并提交的 cherry-pick 或复杂交互式 rebase。
- 工作树创建要求目标在当前仓库外、父目录已存在，且目标为空/不存在；不负责创建任意祖先目录。
- 视图打开且页面可见时每 10 秒刷新本地状态；**不会自动 fetch/push**。用户手动“获取”才执行网络抓取并清理过期远程跟踪引用。
- 当前仅识别 merge/rebase/cherry-pick 进行中的状态；不尝试代管其他外部工具的复杂 Git 流程。

这不是防御恶意本机进程的文件系统沙箱；外部编辑器/Git 命令仍可能并发修改仓库。插件的串行化与预期检查只覆盖其自身请求和可检测状态变化。

## 配置

[组合包 patch](<cordis.patch.yml>)使用稳定根行 ID。覆盖配置时应保留完整 `config`，宿主的 patch 不是对象深合并。

| 配置 | 默认值 | 范围 | 含义 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `maxCommits` | 300 | 20–1000 | 每次加载的提交数量，支持继续加载 |
| `commandTimeoutMs` | 30000 | 1000–120000 | 本地 Git 命令超时 |
| `networkTimeoutMs` | 120000 | 1000–600000 | 网络 Git 命令超时 |

## 项目导航

- [宿主入口](<src/index.mjs>)：Standard Schema 配置、原生 Connection Fetch 路由、错误封装、生命周期。
- [Git 服务](<src/host/git-service.mjs>)：工作区授权、仓库发现、数据读取与安全修改。
- [Git runner](<src/host/git-runner.mjs>)：无 shell 子进程、取消、超时与输出限额。
- [解析器](<src/host/parsers.mjs>)：NUL 格式 status、refs、log、worktree 与文件列表。
- [客户端入口](<src/client/index.jsx>) / [状态模型](<src/client/model.mjs>)：公开插槽接入、请求取消和界面状态。
- [面板](<src/client/panel.jsx>) / [分支](<src/client/branches.jsx>) / [样式](<src/client/styles.css>)：界面实现。
- [协议](<src/shared/protocol.mjs>)：允许的请求类型与边界校验。
- [构建脚本](<scripts/build.mjs>)：宿主 ESM 与 DSH lazy-CJS 浏览器产物。
- [真实 Git 回归测试](<tests/git-service.test.mjs>) / [模型与协议测试](<tests/model-and-protocol.test.mjs>) / [浏览器测试](<tests/ui/plugin.test.mjs>)。
- [验收与兼容性记录](<docs/verification.md>)。
- [开发笔记](<docs/research/dsh-plugin-development-notes.md>)与[参考笔记](<docs/research/dsh-plugin-reference-notes.md>)。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](<LICENSE>)。第三方构建依赖的许可与版权声明见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](<THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md>)。

plugins.description: Upgrade check + multi-host compatibility matrix for DSH plugins, official format-1 market index, Windows/WSL install doctor, and a reusable GitHub Action that comments a compatibility matrix on plugin PRs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-health

[![CI](https://github.com/EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-health.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-health)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Compatibility matrix, official format-1 index builder, and Windows/WSL install doctor for
[DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugins.

> Status: `0.1.6`. Built against the official DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` compatibility rules and the
> published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` validator.

**Live official format-1 index:** <https://easonmws.github.io/dsh-plugin-health/index.json>
(300 plugins, rebuilt nightly) · **npm:** `npm install -g dsh-plugin-health` ·
**repo:** <https://github.com/EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health>

> **Upgrading to DSH 0.2.1? Run the check first.**
>
> In a scan of the top 120 ecosystem plugins, **3 would stop loading on `0.2.1-rc.2`** because
> they pin exact `@deepseek-ai/*` peer versions. Full report:
> [docs/upgrade-0.2.1.md](docs/upgrade-0.2.1.md).
>
> ```sh
> dsh-plugin-health matrix --plugins plugins.txt --versions 0.2.0-rc.2,0.2.1-rc.2
> ```

## Why

DSH ships no official plugin market index, publishes a prerelease roughly every two days with
breaking changes, and its plugin manager has no version picker or upgrade action. Today an author
can only check a plugin against the one DSH version installed on the machine, and Windows/WSL
install failures leave partial directories and stale locks behind.

This tool covers the three gaps that the existing doctor/market tools do not:

1. **Multi-host compatibility matrix** — will a plugin load on `0.1.7-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2`,
   `0.2.1-alpha.4`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, ...? Evaluated with the exact official semantics
   (`engines.dsh` first, otherwise `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peers, prereleases included,
   `workspace:` ranges mapped to the host version).
2. **Official format-1 market index** — turn a community catalog into a JSON index that the
   built-in DSH **Discover** tab accepts, validated by the same parser the DSH Host uses.
3. **Windows/WSL install doctor** — read-only by default; repairs quarantine, never delete, and
   patch edits keep the user's comments.

## Install

```sh
npm install -g dsh-plugin-health
# or run the checkout:
git clone https://github.com/EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health.git && cd dsh-plugin-health && npm ci
node bin/dsh-plugin-health.js --help
```

Requires Node.js 20+.

### Install inside DSH (bundle mode)

The package is also an installable DSH bundle. Installing it into a profile adds a read-only
`plugin_health` agent tool that reports missing third-party bundles, broken package directories,
`cordis.patch.yml` residue, proxy/registry configuration, profile drift, and installed plugins
incompatible with the running DSH version.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-health
```

The bundle declares `engines.dsh`, adds no UI, and changes nothing by itself.

## 1. Compatibility matrix

```sh
dsh-plugin-health matrix \
  --plugins examples/plugins.txt \
  --versions latest,next,alpha,0.1.7-rc.2 \
  --out dsh-health-out/matrix \
  --fail-on any
```

- `--plugins` accepts a file (one spec per line, `#` comments allowed), a comma list, or repeated
  flags. A spec is `name`, `name@version`, or a local plugin directory.
- `--versions` accepts exact SemVer versions or npm dist-tags of `@deepseek-ai/dsh`
  (`latest`, `next`, `alpha`, ...).
- Output: `matrix.json`, `matrix.md`, and static SVG badges (`badges/`).
- `--fail-on any|none|<host>` makes the command usable as a CI gate.

The evaluation mirrors `packages/boot/app-boot/src/plugin-compatibility.ts`:

| Manifest declares | Check |
|---|---|
| `engines.dsh` | that range alone; peers are ignored |
| no `engines.dsh`, has peers | every `@deepseek-ai/dsh` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range |
| peer range `workspace:^` / `~` / `*` | the running host version |
| prerelease host versions | participate in ranges (`includePrerelease: true`) |

Limitations: the matrix is **static** (manifests + official requirements). It does not yet boot
each host and mount the plugin; that runtime smoke test is on the roadmap. Git-only plugins can be
checked from a local clone with a directory spec.

### Example run (2026-10-17, 7 plugins × 4 hosts)

```
dsh 0.1.7-rc.2: 6/7 compatible, 1 incompatible
dsh 0.2.0-rc.2: 5/7 compatible, 2 incompatible
dsh 0.2.1-alpha.4: 5/7 compatible, 2 incompatible
dsh 0.2.1-rc.2: 5/7 compatible, 2 incompatible
✗ dsh-win32@0.17.14: incompatible on all four (narrow @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local peers)
✗ dsh-find-plugin@0.4.0: incompatible from 0.2.0-rc.2 (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools peer)
```

The first result reproduces the real failure tracked in `dsh-win32` issue #89 (a peer upper bound
that is too narrow for later host lines) without installing anything.

### GitHub Action: matrix on every pull request

The repository ships a reusable workflow. Add
[`examples/dsh-compat.yml`](examples/dsh-compat.yml) to a plugin repository (as
`.github/workflows/dsh-compat.yml`) and every pull request gets a compatibility matrix comment plus
a job summary, with the matrix artifact uploaded:

```yaml
name: dsh plugin compatibility
on: pull_request
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  matrix:
    uses: EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health/.github/workflows/matrix-review.yml@v0.1.5
    with:
      plugins: '.'
      versions: 'latest,next,alpha'
      comment: true
```

## 2. Format-1 market index

```sh
dsh-plugin-health index \
  --catalog https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json \
  --host 0.2.1-rc.2 \
  --index-url https://easonmws.github.io/dsh-plugin-health/index.json \
  --matrix dsh-health-out/matrix/matrix.json \
  --limit 300 --out site
```

The command writes `site/index.json` (format `1`) plus `site/build-report.md`, then validates the
document with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` — the official reader used by the DSH Host.
Host the directory on any static origin (GitHub Pages is fine; no redirects) and paste the
`index.json` URL into **Plugins → 自定义插件市场 → 发现 → 添加索引源**.

Index facts:

- market title/description and every plugin title/description are localised (`en` required, `zh` kept);
- categories come from the catalog, plus labels (`npm`, `compatible`, `incompatible`,
  `unchecked`, `capability risk`) and sort keys (`downloads`, `stars`, health score);
- the health score is deterministic: popularity (log downloads 55, log stars 25) ± compatibility
  and capability-risk adjustments, 0–100;
- versions listed per plugin default to the dist-tag latest first, then the highest versions
  (`--max-versions`, default 3), with the npm publish timestamp and `engines.dsh`.

Current scope: npm-published catalog entries only (2,607 of 5,704 in the October 2026 snapshot).
GitHub/tarball-only entries are skipped and reported; git source support (commit-pinned) is on the
roadmap.

## 3. Windows/WSL doctor and repair

```sh
dsh-plugin-health doctor --home C:\Users\me\.dsh --profile desktop --runtime 0.2.1-rc.2
dsh-plugin-health repair --home C:\Users\me\.dsh --profile desktop --apply --yes
```

Checks: declared third-party bundles that are not installed (bundles shipped by the DSH
installation are treated as provided), unreadable/partial package directories, missing profile
dependencies, broken or empty `cordis.patch.yml` entries, `.bak-*` / `.lock` / `.lock.takeover-*`
residue, large plugin-manager logs, proxy configured without `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`, WSL and long
Windows paths, installed-plugin incompatibility against `--runtime`, and plugin-set drift between
profiles.

Repairs are opt-in (`--apply`), default to a dry run, and never delete:

- files/directories move to `<home>/.plugin-health/quarantine/<timestamp>/` (a `repair-log.json`
  records every action);
- `cordis.patch.yml` is edited textually (top-level `- []` entries only) after a backup, so comments
  and formatting survive.

## Roadmap

- runtime smoke: install and mount the plugin in an isolated profile per host version;
- git/tarbal

plugins.description: Grok for DeepSeek Harness: model discovery, chat provider, image and video generation, TTS and durable local media tools over your own OpenAI-compatible gateway.
plugins.readme_text:
![Grok ByAPI for DeepSeek Harness](docs/assets/banner.svg)

# dsh-grok-byapi

Native Grok for DeepSeek Harness: a chat provider plus image, video, and TTS tools over your own OpenAI-compatible Grok gateway.

[![CI](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node >=22.19](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19.0-339933.svg)](#compatibility) [![dsh 0.2.x](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.x-blue.svg)](#compatibility) [![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-6f42c1.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![GitHub tag](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi?label=tag&include_prereleases)](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi/tags)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

> **Early alpha (`0.2.0-alpha.2`).** Not on npm yet — install from git (or from a release tarball once published). Use a separate test profile first. See [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md) for what was actually verified and [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for changes.

One plugin, one gateway connection. Chat models appear in the model picker; image, video, and TTS models stay out of it and are used through tools instead. Any chat model — Grok or another provider — can call those tools. The plugin talks to a Grok gateway you already run (CLIProxyAPI by default), keeps the API key in the dsh credential service, and saves generated media locally. It is not an OAuth client, does not provide an account or quota, and does not read the Grok CLI OAuth token.

## Demo

| Plugins page | Settings page |
| --- | --- |
| ![Plugin list with dsh-grok-byapi installed](docs/assets/screenshot-plugins.jpg) | ![Plugin settings in the English UI with both components running](docs/assets/screenshot-settings.jpg) |

An image generated by Grok through the image tool:

![Example image generated through the plugin](docs/assets/showcase.jpg)

## Features

| Area | Current scope |
| --- | --- |
| Chat provider | Registers a native dsh LLM provider: route `xAI-CLIProxyAPI`, display name **Grok**. Streaming text and tool calls go through the official pi-ai adapter. |
| Model catalog | `GET /models` discovery, auto-categorized as chat, image, video, speech, research, or unknown. Only chat models enter the picker; unknown models do not. Per-model overrides are available. |
| Settings page | Connection, API key, verification, timeout, the chat-model table (the picker's source of truth), and media-model selection. Copy follows the dsh language (English or Chinese). |
| Durable media tasks | Task records are per session and survive restarts. Downloads write `.part` files and are renamed after validation. Storage is isolated by connection and task. |
| Results in chat | Tool result cards, file preview, and a sidebar player for MP4, MP3, and WAV. Tool cards and the player follow the dsh language. |

Together, the plugin's two components register seven tools:

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `grok_models` | Refreshes the catalog and returns models grouped by capability. Optional `verify_key` checks address and key with one `GET /models`. |
| `grok_generate_image` | Generates and saves images: `prompt`, optional `model`, `n` (1–4, default 1). |
| `grok_generate_video` | Submits a video job: `prompt`, optional `model`, `duration` (1–15 s, default 2). Fetch it with `grok_media_status`. |
| `grok_speak` | Text to speech saved as MP3: `input`, optional `model` and `voice`. |
| `grok_media_list` | Lists media tasks created in the current session. |
| `grok_media_status` | Checks a task and downloads the result when ready: `task_id`. |
| `grok_media_retry_download` | Retries a failed download without regenerating: `task_id`. |

Not implemented yet: image editing, video editing or extension, automatic background polling or completion notifications, a live task dashboard, speech-to-text, realtime voice, and direct OAuth. Classification is rule-based, not a guarantee, and model counts depend on your gateway.

## Compatibility

| Component | Requirement | Verified |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` via `engines.dsh` | `0.2.1-rc.2` end to end (chat, image, video, TTS, playback) |
| Node.js | `>=22.19.0` | Node 24 on Windows; CI runs Node 22.19 and 24 on Linux and Windows |
| Gateway | OpenAI-compatible `/v1` endpoint; CLIProxyAPI recommended | CLIProxyAPI v8.0.30 |
| Other dsh 0.2.x | Inside the `engines.dsh` range | Not individually verified |

`engines.dsh` is the compatibility gate; `peerDependencies` pin the SDK packages the source uses but do not decide compatibility, so rerun the integration tests after a dsh upgrade. A direct xAI or other compatible endpoint can serve chat, but image, video, and TTS need the gateway to expose the matching Grok endpoints.

## Install

> npm is not published yet: `npm install dsh-grok-byapi` and `dsh plugin add dsh-grok-byapi` do not work. Use one of the paths below.

**From git, pinned to a tag (recommended):**

```powershell
dsh --profile grok-byapi-test --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test add "git+https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi.git#v0.2.0-alpha.2"
```

`--dump-config` creates the profile from your default profile and prints the merged configuration without starting a server. `dsh plugin add` records the bundle in that profile — no manual YAML edit. The package has no `prepare` or `postinstall` script, so installation runs no build code and needs no `allowBuilds` entry.

**From a GitHub Release tarball (once the release is published):**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test add "https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi/releases/download/v0.2.0-alpha.2/dsh-grok-byapi-0.2.0-alpha.2.tgz"
```

**From local source (development):**

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi.git
cd dsh-grok-byapi
npm install --ignore-scripts
dsh --profile grok-byapi-test --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test add "$PWD"   # bash/zsh: "$(pwd)"
```

Start dsh with that profile:

```powershell
dsh --profile grok-byapi-test --no-open
```

Keep the plugin in a dedicated profile until you are satisfied; this keeps the provider, tools, and settings out of your daily environment. For a fully isolated trial, point `DSH_HOME` at a scratch directory.

## Update and uninstall

Updating a tag-pinned git install means removing it and adding the new tag; local installs update with `git pull` and `npm install --ignore-scripts`; tarball installs are removed and replaced with the new `.tgz`. Restart dsh afterwards.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test remove dsh-grok-byapi
```

Removing the plugin takes its layer out of the profile: the provider, the seven tools, and its settings page are gone. Generated media and task records are not deleted — remove the data directory yourself if you want them gone. A credential created for the plugin is also not removed by uninstall; delete it in dsh if you no longer need it.

## Configuration

Use the plugin settings page for normal setup. Manual configuration in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` is possible but optional:

```yaml
- id: grok-byapi
  name: dsh-grok-byapi
  config:
    connection:
      baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1
      api: openai-responses
      apiKeyEnv: GROK_ALL_API_KEY
      timeoutMs: 60000
    media:
      imageModel: grok-imagine-image-2.0
      videoModel: grok-imagine-video-1.5
      speechModel: grok-tts
      dataDir: ''
```

| Key | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection.baseURL` | `http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1` | Gateway base URL. `127.0.0.1` is the machine running dsh; use your own HTTPS URL for a remote gateway. |
| `connection.api` | `openai-responses` | Chat protocol; `openai-completions` is the alternative. |
| `connection.apiKey` | empty | Direct key override for local testing; takes precedence over the credential. Leave empty in normal use. |
| `connection.apiKeyEnv` | `GROK_ALL_API_KEY` | Credential refer

plugins.description: DSH 插件：会话中记录待办，自动记录上下文中关于这个待办事项的关键内容，等需要处理时可在新会话中直接开始任务，无需从头调查也不用再次说明情况
plugins.readme_text:
**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

# Todo Assistant

**为 DSH 会话中的旁支任务保存上下文，并在需要时把它交接给未来的会话。**

开发时，你可能突然发现一个
Bug、想到一项配套功能，或意识到当前实现还缺少某个步骤。但主任务正在进行，你不想现在中断；等以后回来处理时，也不想重新调查一遍，更不想再次向
AI 解释来龙去脉。

Todo Assistant 让你先把这件事记下来。AI
会整理与该任务相关的必要信息，任务卡片可以在之后被查看、补充，并带入新会话或当前输入框。

它不只是记录"还有什么没做"，也帮助保留"为什么要做、之前已经知道什么、下一步该做什么"。

## 适合哪些场景？

### 发现 Bug，但暂时不修

你正在实现一个大功能，顺手发现了另一个模块的问题。先把问题和相关线索记下来，继续完成当前主任务；之后再单独处理。

### 想到配套功能，不想打断主线

实现过程中，你发现还需要一个设置项、一个编辑入口，或某个补充流程。先记录想法，等当前阶段完成后再回来处理。

### 把任务交给另一个会话

当你准备处理一张卡片时，可以让插件新建一个会话，并把卡片内容作为开场上下文；也可以将提示插入当前会话的输入框，由你决定何时发送。

### 减少重复调查和重复说明

卡片可以保留开发者的原始请求、任务相关信息、文件路径、下一步、必读内容和补充记录。必要时还可以按需回读原始会话中的指定片段，而不是一开始就把整段历史全部塞进上下文。

## 核心工作方式

-   **先捕获，再处理。** 记录旁支任务不要求你立刻离开当前工作。
-   **只保留相关信息。**
    卡片围绕当前待办组织信息，避免把主任务的全部上下文无差别复制进去。
-   **按需读取原文。**
    原始会话内容可以先查看目录，再选择需要的片段；回读成本较高，因此不会被当作普通的每轮提醒。
-   **交接由你决定。**
    可以新开会话，也可以插入当前输入框；插入操作不会自动发送。
-   **创建需要明确同意。** AI
    不应擅自创建待办。使用标记语法本身即表示你同意记录。
-   **提醒保持轻量。**
    插件根据当前会话访问的文件路径与该会话创建的未完成卡片做粗略相关性匹配，不需要每轮调用模型。

## 快速开始

### 1. 安装

在 DSH 中执行：

``` text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target = https://github.com/zangoose335/dsh-todo-assistant.git
```

`install_bundle` 需要审批，并且安装后需要重启
DSH。也可以从本地仓库安装，或按需固定到某个 Git commit。安装细节见下文。

### 2. 在右侧栏打开插件

在右侧栏点击 `+`，选择 **Todo Assistant**。

卡片按工作区查看；不属于任何工作区的卡只在
「全部工作区」视图里可见。侧栏提供未完成、待修复、待添加、已完成和全部等视图。

### 3. 记录一项旁支任务

你可以直接告诉 AI
希望记录什么，并明确同意创建；也可以使用下面的标记语法。同一条回复里可以放多个标记，一次记录多个待办。

``` text
#MEMO 会议记录完成后需要支持修改标题。先完成当前主功能，之后再实现标题编辑，并确认修改后的标题能正确保存和显示。
#/MEMO
```

`#DB` 和 `#MEMO` 都是待办标记，作用相同；`DB`
是"待办"的拼音首字母，`MEMO`
是更容易被国际用户理解的替代写法。**它们不代表不同的任务类型。** AI
应根据内容判断这是待修复问题、待添加功能还是其他事项。

标记规则：

-   `#db`、`#DB`、`#memo`、`#MEMO` 不区分大小写。
-   使用 `#DB … #/DB` 或 `#MEMO … #/MEMO`
    成对包住要记录的内容；结束标记可以省略，此时记录到消息末尾。
-   代码围栏和行内代码中的标记会被忽略。
-   标记内容表示开发者已同意记录，AI 不需要再次询问是否创建。
-   没有标记时，AI 仍必须先得到开发者明确同意，不能自行创建待办。

输入框支持 `#db` / `#memo` 的轻量补全。AI
回复上的"记录待办"面板也可以帮助选择回复中的段落并送入捕获流程。

## 卡片包含什么？

每张卡片首先是一份**任务简报**，再附带来源与现场：

-   **目标（goal）**：要解决什么问题、实现什么需求；
-   **背景（why，可选）**：为什么需要它；
-   **已确认事实与决定（confirmed）**：每条都标出可信度；
-   **约束（constraints）**：实现时不能违反的条件；
-   **线索（leads）**：文件、符号或文档路径，只作辅助；
-   **下一步（nextAction）**：开始执行时先做什么；
-   **待确认（openQuestions，可选）**：尚未确认、可能影响执行的问题。

`brief.nextAction` 是唯一的规范下一步。旧字段 `nextStep` 作为兼容镜像保留：只提供
brief 可以建卡，只提供 nextStep 仍兼容；两者冲突时以 brief 为准并返回 warning，任何正常写入都会同步二者。

简单任务可以只有 goal + nextAction，不要求填满其他字段。每条 brief 信息必须标明
`requirement`（开发者要求）、`decided`（已确认决定）、`verified`（已验证事实）、
`inferred`（AI 推断）、`unknown`（未知）或 `superseded`（已被替代）；推断不会被写成已确认事实。

旧卡没有 brief 时，插件从 `core`、`mustRead`、`park` 和 `touchedFiles` 派生只读简报。派生信息只用于读取，
不会批量改写旧数据；旧卡的可信度默认按 `unknown` 处理，不能当成已验证事实。

开发者原话由 Host 从用户消息中保存，不依赖 AI 转述，因此可以用来核对 AI
是否误解了原始需求。带 `#DB`/`#MEMO` 标记时，标记内的文本会完整保存；没有标记时，AI 只摘取与当前待办有关的那几句。若模型没有给出摘录，多段消息只保存第一段；第一段只是创建指令时不保存 request。

## 处理任务与交接上下文

打开卡片后，你可以选择：

-   **新会话中处理**：创建一个新会话，并将卡片整理成开场上下文。开场会要求先读代码/资料并给出方案，不直接改文件；确认方案后再实现。处理中需要你决定时，会在任务过程中使用 DSH 的提问面板，而不是等到最后才问。
-   **插入当前会话**：将一条处理提示插入当前输入框。它只会预填，不会自动发送；需要你决定时，同样会在处理过程中提问。

处理完成后，AI 应询问你是否将卡片标记为完成；得到确认后才更新状态。

卡片也支持追加
note，以记录新证据、进度或补充事实，而不是悄悄覆盖原始记录。

## 上下文读取与提醒

### 分层读取

-   **索引**：快速查看标题、状态和类型。
-   **卡片**：先读任务简报（目标/背景/已确认事实/约束/下一步/待确认），再按需看必读信息、文件和补充记录。
-   **原始会话**：先查看可回读消息的目录，再选择指定片段读取。

原始会话回读可能消耗较多 token。插件的工具说明要求 AI
先征得开发者同意，再查看目录并读取指定片段。手动创建、没有原始会话范围的卡片可能无法回读原文。

### 相关性提醒

插件会收集当前会话中的部分文件工具路径，并与该会话创建的未完成卡片比较。如果文件路径完全相同，或共享足够长的目录前缀，侧栏可能显示"相关"标记，并在后续步骤提醒
AI。

这是一种**轻量路径信号**，不是语义级的任务理解，也不能保证发现所有相关修改。它主要用于提示
AI：如果本轮产生了值得保留的新证据，可以通过 note 追加到卡片。

## 其他功能

-   按工作区查看；不属于任何工作区的卡在「全部工作区」中显示；
-   近似重复待办检测：共享文件是前提，标题或任务目标相似可辅助命中；同一文件但目标不同不会仅因标题相似被拦截；
    命中只是提示，不会自动合并或取消创建；开发者确认创建后可用 `forceCreate` 继续，确认补充则用 `todo_note`；
-   短编号，例如 `#3.2`，便于在对话中引用卡片；
-   `#` 引用选择器：正常会话中候选按当前会话所属工作区筛选；缺少会话 ID 时退回查询全部工作区；
-   每个工作区独立的通用规则，并在插件创建新会话时带入；
-   卡片状态、补充记录和原始上下文回读工具。

## 当前阶段与限制

当前已完成 P0-BASE、T1、T2、T3、T4 的基础实现：

- TaskBrief 创建、持久化、读取、旧卡派生和右栏展示；
- `brief.nextAction` 与旧 `nextStep` 的统一契约；
- brief 参与去重（共享文件 + 标题/目标相似度）；
- version-1 旧数据兼容，以及 brief 持久化和降级风险模拟。

**Gate 1/T5 已按 `docs/PLAN.md` §6 的正式验收条件通过；该结论仅适用于当前未提交工作区，不是已提交/已发布版本的验证。**
验证依据：`node scripts/verify-brief.mjs` 117/117、`node scripts/verify-domain.mjs` 193/193、`git diff --check` 通过；十个场景中场景 1–9 有真实模型/确定性证据，场景 10 由 `todo/brief-required` / `todo/brief-source-only` 拒绝保证；场景 7 已在最新 3641 字符工具描述下完成两次独立测试。除场景 7 外，场景 1–9 的现有证据主要来自较早描述版本，尚未全部在 3641 版下重跑。

**发布前仍未验证（不阻塞 §6 代码 Gate）：** 真实 DSH UI 中 duplicate 提示的可见性与选择、真实旧版本读写兼容、备份/恢复/升级/降级/迁移/回滚演练、场景 C 澄清探针。补齐前不得把发布检查描述为已完成。

当前未实现完整历史检索/授权、任务交接的 brief-first 种子、Project Plan、Markdown 导入导出和拖拽。
升级前建议先备份 `~/.dsh/storages/todo_assistant.json`；旧版本 schema 可能 strip 掉新 `brief` 字段，
不要用旧版本写回新数据。

## 安装方式

所有方式都通过 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 安装，并且需要审批。

**从 GitHub 安装：**

``` text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target = https://github.com/zangoose335/dsh-todo-assistant.git
```

**从本地仓库安装：**

``` text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target = <仓库的绝对路径>
```

**固定到某个 commit：**

``` text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target = https://github.com/zangoose335/dsh-todo-assistant.git#<commit>
```

如果未来发布到 npm，也可以按包名和版本安装。`install_bundle` 需要 `pnpm`
位于 PATH 中。

安装或更新 Host 侧代码后，重启 DSH 以加载插件。只修改 `client.js`
时通常刷新页面即可。

安装后，在右侧栏点击 `+`，选择 **Todo Assistant**。

## 开发与设计

本仓库包含实现与验证代码。若你希望了解数据结构、工具定义、标记解析、路径提醒、原文回读和
Host/Client 通信等实现细节，请阅读：

-   [`docs/DESIGN.md`](docs/DESIGN.md)：设计原则与实现决策
-   [`scripts/verify-domain.mjs`](scripts/verify-domain.mjs)：无头验证脚本

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 黑桃伍

plugins.description: DSH plugin: use ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription models in DeepSeek Harness via OAuth, no API key.
plugins.readme_text:
# Chatgpt-DSH

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that signs in with a ChatGPT Plus or Pro account
and exposes its ChatGPT models in DSH on the subscription quota. No API key needed.

The plugin package lives in `chatgpt-plus-dsh/`. This repository contains the
package plus top-level documentation; the package directory itself ships only
runtime files.

## How it works

The plugin registers a `chatgpt-plus` provider route with DSH's `llm` service, so
the account's ChatGPT models show up in the DSH model picker. Requests go to the
ChatGPT backend used by the Codex CLI (`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api`), billed
against the ChatGPT subscription rather than API usage.

Sign-in uses OpenAI OAuth (Authorization Code + PKCE S256) with the Codex CLI's
public client. A short-lived listener on `127.0.0.1:1455` receives the redirect;
if that port is busy, the settings page offers a paste-the-URL fallback. The
resulting grant (access, refresh and ID tokens) is kept in DSH's credential store
under `chatgpt-plus/account` and refreshed automatically before it expires.

## Features

- Sign in / sign out with a ChatGPT Plus or Pro account from the DSH settings page.
- Account models listed from the ChatGPT backend, with periodic refresh and usage
  figures shown in the settings UI.
- Streaming chat completions via the Codex Responses endpoint, including tool
  calls and reasoning items where the model returns them.
- Background token refresh plus single-flight refresh shared across concurrent
  requests and DSH processes sharing one home.
- Settings page served from DSH's own web server (same-origin JSON endpoints);
  responses never contain token material.
- Runs alongside `dsh-chatgpt-sub` in one profile: provider route, credential
  key, HTTP prefix and data directory are all distinct.

## Technology stack

- JavaScript (ES modules), Node.js `>= 20.11`.
- Zero runtime dependencies — `lib/` imports only Node built-ins and sibling
  modules. The settings UI (`lib/client.js`) is a module-loader factory using
  `react` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` supplied by the host.
- Tests run on Node's built-in test runner, no test dependencies.
- Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer (`llm.registerAdapter` and
  credential records APIs).

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 20.11 or newer (`node --version`).
- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2+.
- A ChatGPT Plus or Pro account for sign-in.

## Installation

No `npm install` is required — the package declares no dependencies or peers.

1. Place the `chatgpt-plus-dsh/` directory where DSH loads plugins from
   (for example a `link:` install, or `dsh plugin add <path>` — see your DSH
   docs for the exact command in your setup).
2. Add the bundle row to your profile so the plugin is mounted. The stock row
   from `chatgpt-plus-dsh/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: chatgpt-plus
      name: 'chatgpt-plus-dsh'
```

3. Start DSH, open Plugins → ChatGPT Plus, and click **Sign in with ChatGPT**.

Optional row config keys (all may be omitted): `callbackPort`
(OpenAI only accepts `1455` for this client), `signInTimeoutMs`,
`requestTimeoutMs`, `streamIdleTimeoutMs`, `clientVersion`.

## Configuration

There is no `.env` file. Secrets live only in DSH's credential store
(`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, record `chatgpt-plus/account`, file mode 0600);
non-secret preferences and the cached model list live under
`$DSH_HOME/chatgpt-plus-dsh/` (directory 0700, owner-only ACL on Windows).
All tunables are row config keys (see above) with defaults in
`chatgpt-plus-dsh/lib/constants.js` (`DEFAULTS`).

## Running locally

```powershell
node --version            # needs >= 20.11
cd chatgpt-plus-dsh
node tests/run-all.mjs    # offline test suite, no network access
```

To exercise the plugin against a real DSH build, install the package into a DSH
profile as described above and open the ChatGPT Plus settings page.

## Building and testing

There is no build step. The supported check is the offline suite:

```powershell
cd chatgpt-plus-dsh
node tests/run-all.mjs
```

It runs every `tests/*.test.mjs` in its own process and exits non-zero on any
failure. Last verified: 93 passed, 0 failed (Node 24, Windows).

## Project structure

```text
chatgpt-plus-dsh/
  lib/
    index.js       # plugin entry: registers provider route, token lifecycle, settings endpoints
    controller.js  # sign-in flow, token refresh, preferences, usage/model fetching
    provider.js    # `chatgpt-plus` LLM adapter (Codex Responses endpoint)
    oauth.js       # PKCE helpers, token exchange/refresh, grant payload
    models.js      # model catalog fetch, quota/usage parsing
    rpc.js         # same-origin settings-page endpoints
    client.js      # settings page UI (host module-loader factory)
    store.js       # credential-store + $DSH_HOME persistence
    errors.js      # error taxonomy and user-facing messages
    util.js        # file, time and platform helpers
    constants.js   # identifiers, OAuth/backend endpoints, defaults
  tests/           # offline suite (`run-all.mjs` + `*.test.mjs`)
  locale/en.json   # plugin card title/description
  cordis.patch.yml # bundle row mounting the plugin
  package.json     # manifest (no dependencies, no peers)
```

`verify/` (local only, not published) holds sandbox QA harnesses and screenshots.

## Troubleshooting

- **Plugin fails to load with a message about missing APIs**: update DSH to
  0.2.0-rc.2 or newer (`assertHostSupport` in `lib/index.js` names the missing API).
- **Sign-in listener can't bind port 1455**: another process (or a second DSH
  profile signing in) holds it. Use the paste-the-URL fallback the settings page
  shows, or free the port and retry.
- **"Refresh token was rejected" / signed out unexpectedly**: the grant expired
  or was revoked (including by signing in elsewhere, since rotation invalidates
  the old family). Sign in again from the settings page.
- **Requests fail after the token expires though auto-refresh is off**: either
  enable "Refresh tokens automatically" or use "Refresh token now" in
  Plugins → ChatGPT Plus.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Restores opaque backgrounds on floating panels that the liquid-glass theme (dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine) made translucent — a copy-paste recipe, one selector per plugin.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-glass-opaque-fix 让被液态玻璃主题「玻璃化」的浮层恢复正常的不透明背景。 一个可照抄的样板：**改一处选择器**，就能修好另一个插件与玻璃主题的兼容问题。 > 本项目由 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 智能体开发。 --- ## 一、问题是什么 液态玻璃主题插件（`dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine`）实现「透出壁纸」的方式，是**改写宿主自己的背景别名**。 它的样式表里有一组 `body[data-we-glass-page]` 规则，把宿主的 ``` --dsw-alias-bg-layer-1 --dsw-alias-bg-layer-2 --dsw-alias-bg-layer-3 ``` 重新映射成由 `color-mix(…, transparent)` 合成的**半透明膜**。 **这是主题的正当设计** —— 壁纸正是从这些膜下面透出来的。 **但它是一个全局改动。** 任何**用这些别名画面板**的插件，都会**跟着一起变半透明** —— 哪怕那个插件跟壁纸毫无关系。 ### 后果 | 现象 | 说明 | |---|---| | 浮窗/弹窗变半透明 | 文字压在壁纸上，难以阅读 | | **插件里没有开关可调** | 因为那个插件是按「宿主别名本来不透明」写的 | | 用户无解 | 只能二选一：要么关壁纸，要么忍受看不清 | **这不是谁的 bug，是两个正确设计撞在一起的结果。** 本仓库负责收尾。 --- ## 二、为什么改主题或改插件的设置都没用 我们实测过两条最直觉的路径，**都走不通**。 ### 路径一：找主题的「浮层不透明度」设置 `dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine` **确实有**「浮层玻璃 · 玻璃透明度」这个设置项（`浮层玻璃·独立配置` / `Popover glass · glass opacity`）。 **但它管不到第三方浮层。** 它的选择器只有三类： ``` body[data-we-glass-floaters] [data-install-registry] ← DSH 官方安装注册面板 body[data-we-glass-floaters] .we-update-notice ← 主题自己的更新提示 body[data-we-glass-floaters] .we-repo-panel ← 主题自己的壁纸仓库 ``` 全是 `we-` 前缀的自家组件，或官方组件。**没有 `[role=dialog]`、没有任何通用匹配** —— 所以第三方浮层不在它管辖范围内。 而且那条滑块在数学上也**到不了不透明**： ```js // wallpaper-engine 1.3.3 const glassAlpha = Math.max(0.10, 0.25 - (selection.glassAlpha / 100) * 0.15); ``` | 滑块 | alpha | 效果 | |---|---|---| | 0 | **0.25** | 最「实」，**但仍 25% 透明** | | 100 | 0.10 | 最透 | **下限锁死在 0.25** —— 这是主题的可读性铁律，不是配置失误。 ### 路径二：改被影响插件的文件 我们最初的做法，是把一条 CSS 规则**打进主题插件的 bundle**： ```css /* 曾经这样修过，现已失效 */ body[data-we-glass-page] .cm-stat-dialog { background: var(--we-panel-color) !important; } ``` **它撑到主题下一次更新就没了** —— 实测 `1.3.2 → 1.3.3` 把这条规则整个抹掉，浮层重新变半透明。 **为什么必然如此**：冲突的两边都是**第三方插件**，**两边都会更新**。 | 补丁位置 | 谁更新会抹掉它 | |---|---| | 主题插件的 `lib/client.js` | **主题**更新 | | 被影响插件的文件 | **被影响插件**更新 | **所以正确的做法是第三个位置：你自己的插件。** 它不属于任何一方，没人会覆盖它。 --- ## 三、修复原理 三步，**每一步都不能少**。 ### 第 1 步：用不会被改写的颜色变量 ``` ❌ var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1) ← 正是被主题改成半透明膜的那个 ✅ var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-00) ← 主题从不赋值，天然不透明 ✅ var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-875) ← 深色版本 ✅ var(--we-panel-color) ← 主题基于上面两个定义，色调更协调 ``` **实测依据**：在 `wallpaper-engine 1.3.3` 的 bundle 里搜索这两个 `--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-*`，**赋值次数为 0** —— 主题不碰它们。 所以它们是**构造上就不透明**的，装不装壁纸都可靠。 本插件用的表达式： ```css background: var(--we-panel-color, var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-00, #ffffff)) !important; ``` 优先用主题的面板色（与周围玻璃同色调），主题不在时退回静态中性色。 ### 第 2 步：加 `!important` **这是必需的，不是习惯性写法。** 主题的令牌映射挂在 `body[data-we-glass-page]` 下，**作用域优先级高于一个裸的 class 选择器**。不加 `!important` 压不过它。 ### 第 3 步：父与子一起写 如果浮层有独立的头部/主体，**它们也要列上**： ```css .cm-stat-dialog, .cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-head, .cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-body { background: … !important; } ``` **原因**：子元素自己的 `background` 会盖在父元素之上。只给父元素设不透明，子元素那块**仍会是半透明的** —— 表现为面板上一条条透光的带。 --- ## 四、怎么用它修另一个插件（给 AI 的操作指南） **整个流程改动的只有一处：`client.js` 里的 `RECIPES` 数组。** ### 步骤 ``` ① 打开那个半透明的浮窗 ② DevTools → Elements → 点选该浮窗 → 读它的 class 属性 ③ 把类名加进 client.js 的 RECIPES（形如 '.that-class'） ④ 重启 DSH（改动 client.js 需要重启才加载） ⑤ 复查：浮窗应不再透出壁纸 ⑥ 若头部/主体仍透光 → 把子元素选择器也加进去 ``` ### 要改的那一处 `client.js` 顶部： ```js const RECIPES = [ { id: 'cost-meter', plugin: 'dsh-cost-meter', note: '费用明细 dialog。已验证 1.8.32。', selectors: [ '.cm-stat-dialog', '.cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-head', '.cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-body', ], }, // ← 在这里加新条目 // { // id: 'some-plugin', // plugin: 'dsh-some-plugin', // note: '设置弹窗；选择器取自 DevTools。', // selectors: ['.some-dialog'], // }, ]; ``` ### 怎么找到正确的选择器 | 目标 | 做法 | |---|---| | 定位浮窗元素 | DevTools → 左上角「选择元素」图标 → 点浮窗 | | 读类名 | 看 `class="…"` 属性，优先选**最外层**那个面板元素 | | 确认它真的透光 | DevTools → Computed → 看 `background-color` 的 alpha 是否小于 1 | | 确认生效 | 加完规则后，看 computed 里 `background-color` 是否变成不透明 | ### 排查：加了规则但没效果 按顺序查这三条： | 检查 | 方法 | |---|---| | **样式注入成功了吗** | DevTools → Elements → 搜 `style[data-plugin-css="dsh-glass-opaque-fix"]`，应能找到 | | **选择器匹配到了吗** | 在 Console 里跑 `document.querySelectorAll('.你的选择器').length`，应 ≥ 1 | | **优先级够吗** | 看 computed 的 `background-color` 值旁有没有被划掉（划掉说明被别的规则赢了） | --- ## 五、已收录的修复用例 | 插件 | 浮层 | 选择器 | 验证状态 | |---|---|---|---| | [`dsh-cost-meter`](https://github.com/) | 费用明细 dialog | `.cm-stat-dialog` + `.cm-stat-dialog-head` + `.cm-stat-dialog-body` | ✅ **实际使用中**（1.8.32） | **关于验证状态的诚实说明**：✅ 表示这条配方在开发机上**实际解决了问题**。其他条目若由他人补充，请在 `note` 里写清验证到哪个版本 —— **本仓库的价值在于配方可靠**，一条没验证过的选择器比没有更糟。 ### 为什么点名这些插件 因为**不点名就没法照抄** —— 「某个插件的某个浮窗」这种描述，AI 和人都无法定位到具体选择器。 **这些插件都没有错。** 半透明是玻璃主题的全局作用域导致的，被影响的插件只是按宿主的正常语义写了样式。本仓库做的是**在第三个位置收尾**，而不是指出谁的缺陷。 --- ## 六、安装 ### 方式一：本地目录（开发/自用推荐） 1. 克隆或用本地副本，放到任意目录 2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加两处： ```jsonc { "dependencies": { "dsh-glass-opaque-fix": "link:A:/你的路径/dsh-glass-opaque-fix" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // … "dsh-glass-opaque-fix" ] } } } ``` 3. 在 `profile/node_modules/` 下建目录链接（Windows 用 Junction）： ```cmd mklink /J "C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-glass-opaque-fix" "A:\你的路径\dsh-glass-opaque-fix" ``` 4. **重启 DSH** ### 方式二：复制一个配方，不用装插件 如果你只想修**一个**插件、也不想装东西： 1. 读第四节，找到选择器 2. 把那段 CSS 加进**你自己已有的某个插件**里 3. 或直接加进任意会被加载的样式表 **代价**：以后主题或那个插件更新时，你可能要重新加一遍 —— 这正是本插件把规则独立出来的原因。 ### 环境要求 | 依赖 | 要求 | |---|---| | DSH | 能加载 `dsh.client` 插件的版本 | | 主题插件 | 可选。没装玻璃主题时，本插件不产生可见变化（规则仍注入，但底色本来就是不透明的） | **无需第三方依赖，无构建步骤。** --- ## 七、设计取舍 - **只加规则，不改别人的文件。** 这是它能活过插件更新的**唯一原因**。任何"顺手改一下主题插件"的做法都会回到原来的困境。 - **配方集中在 `RECIPES` 数组里。** 要改的地方只有一处，且改了哪条一目了然 —— 而不是散在几百行 CSS 里。 - **用 `ctx.effect` 绑定生命周期。** 卸载插件时样式随之移除。一个**已删除却仍在改页面**的插件，比它修的问题更糟。 - **没有配方时不注入空 `

# dsh-plugin-persona — DSH 人格管理器

给当前 DSH 客户端提供一套「模型人格（人设 / 人格提示词）」的完整管理：多套自定义人设、**每个会话独立绑定**、默认人格、随时切换（可选择立即生效或下个会话生效），并把同一套能力作为工具暴露给模型自己调用。

- Host 半（`lib/index.js`）：在会话自己的 agent scope 里覆盖 `deployment:persona-prefix` / `deployment:persona-suffix`，注册 HTTP JSON 桥，注册 3 个模型工具。
- Web 客户端半（`lib/client.js`）：设置页「模型人格」+ 输入框左侧的人设切换芯片。

## 功能

**设置页（设置 → 模型人格，`settings.section#persona-manager`，order 25）**

- 人设库：新建 / 编辑（名称、emoji、描述、前缀、后缀）/ 删除，`complete`（独占整个 system prompt）与 `suppressRuntimeContext`（抑制运行时上下文）两个开关。
- 设为默认 / 取消默认（默认人格只决定「没有绑定的会话」用什么）。
- 导入 / 导出 JSON；显示存储路径；显示模型工具注册状态（Host 半如果注册失败，这里会直接给出错误文本）。

**输入框芯片（`conversation.input.left#persona-manager.switcher`，order 120）**

- 一眼看到当前会话生效的人格（emoji + 名字，`跟随默认` / `临时文本` 也会显示出来）。
- 下拉即可切换：跟随默认、任选人设、`临时文本…`（只作用于本会话的一次性人格）、`仅对下一个会话生效`（只记账、不重注入，因此不动当前 KV 前缀）、`立即重注入`。

**模型工具（Host 半注册，模型可自行调用）**

- `persona_list` — 列出所有人设，并说明本会话当前生效的是哪个。
- `persona_switch` — 切换本会话人格；参数 `id` / `custom`（临时文本）/ `deferred`（true = 下次会话生效）。
- `persona_create` — 新建并保存一个可复用的人设。

**HTTP JSON 桥（客户端半使用，也可以脚本直接调）**

- `GET /dsh-persona/api/state?sessionId=<id>` → 完整视图（人设库、默认、本会话绑定、生效结果、`active`、`tools` 注册状态、`storePath`）。
- `POST /dsh-persona/api/call`，body `{"method": "...", "params": {...}}`，方法：`state` `create` `update` `remove` `setDefault` `switch` `activate` `import` `export`。失败返回 4xx + `{"ok":false,"error":"..."}`。

## 安装

推荐走 DSH 插件管理（需要 danger-full-access 或逐次批准）：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <本目录的绝对路径>
```

它会 `pnpm link` 进 profile 并把包名写进 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，同时激活 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 Loader 行 `persona-manager`。

也可以手动安装：把本目录放进（或链接到）profile 的 `node_modules/dsh-plugin-persona`，再在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里加入 `"dsh-plugin-persona"`。

## 生效时机与 KV 缓存（重要）

- **只绑定 / 立即生效**：`switch` 默认只写绑定（下个会话或下个 agent 才生效）；`activate` 或界面上的「立即重注入」才会改写当前会话正在用的提示词。
- DSH 的 system prompt 走 `systemPromptUpdate: 'in-history'`：提示词变化会**追加在已缓存历史之后**，所以「立即生效」不会破坏已有前缀的缓存复用；代价是旧人格文本会留在历史里，直到 compaction 把它压掉。
- **重新加载**：客户端半（`lib/client.js`）的改动由 client-hmr 轮询自动热更新，刷新页面即可看到；Host 半（`lib/index.js` 等）的改动**必须重启 DSH 进程**（Node ESM 缓存，加载器不带 cache-busting 查询串）。

## 数据

- 默认 `$DSH_HOME/persona/personas.json`，可用环境变量 `DSH_PERSONA_STORE` 覆盖。
- 结构：`{version: 1, defaultId: string|null, personas: Persona[], bindings: {[sessionId]: {personaId?: string, custom?: string}}}`。
- 上限：200 条人设、名称 64 字符、单段文本 64 KiB、请求体 1 MiB。
- 写入是原子的（临时文件 + fsync + rename），读取永不抛（坏文件/缺失都当空库处理）。
- 首次运行会种入 3 个内置人设：精简架构师 / 严格评审员 / 耐心的讲解者。

## 实现要点（为什么这样做）

- DSH 的 `systemPrompt` **没有「改文本」接口**，只有 `section()` / `context()` 注册，而且注册是 per-context 的分层覆盖（`ScopedLayers`）。因此插件把人格注册进**该会话自己的 `agent.ctx`**，用它覆盖 preset 带来的人格 section；同一 scope 内重复注册同名 section 会抛错，所以每次切换都**先 dispose 旧的再注册新的**。
- **不能全局注册** persona section：会与 prompt registry 自带的全局 section 冲突并直接报错。
- `agent id === session id`，所以会话绑定直接用 sessionId 当键；新会话在 `agent/created` 时套用（绑定 → 默认 → 什么都不做，跟随 preset），插件被重新加载时也会给已存在的会话补注入一次。
- 不用自定义 session 事件（`SessionEventMap` 是仓库自有的，未知类型在读取时会被拒），也不依赖存储服务，插件自带原子 JSON 存储。
- 客户端半是**手写的 lazy-CJS bundle**（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`），只 `require` 平台 seed 表里的 `react` / `react/jsx-runtime`；bundle 模型里没有 `ctx.styles` 之类的服务，CSS 用原始 `<style>` 元素在 factory 阶段插入（由 client-modules 的 `claimStyles` 认领，HMR 时能正确回收）。
- 模型工具**不 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`**（第三方插件解析不到 app.asar 里的包，会静默失败），改为手写等价对象：标准 JSON Schema 的 `parameters` + `output: {schema, render}`。

## 开发与测试

```bash
node test/check-persona.js    # 语法 + store/runtime 语义（原子写、resolvePersona 优先级、覆盖注册、释放、后缀 order 10200）
node test/verify-host.js      # 驱动真实 HTTP 路由 + 三个模型工具（含 deferred 不改写当前提示词的回归断言）
node test/verify-client.js    # 在假 window/document 里加载 bundle，真的渲染并点按钮，断言发出 switch 调用
npm test                      # 三个一起跑
```

三个 harness 都是纯 Node、无子进程（当前沙箱禁止管道），失败会打印 `FAIL …` 并以非 0 退出。

## 目录

```
lib/index.js        Host 半：HTTP 路由 + 3 个模型工具 + agent 生命周期 + 视图
lib/store.js        原子 JSON 存储、规范化与限额
lib/runtime.js      在 agent scope 内注入/释放 persona section
lib/client.js       Web 客户端半：设置页 + 输入框芯片（手写 bundle）
cordis.patch.yml    注入 Loader 行 persona-manager
test/               check-persona.js / verify-host.js / verify-client.js
```

plugins.description: 在deepseekharness中接入豆包语言模型，阅读对话。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-doubao-tts

把火山引擎豆包「双向流式语音合成 V3」接进 DSH Web GUI：**每条已定稿的助手回答后面多一个朗读按钮**，点一下就把这条回答合成成语音播出来。

```sh
# 安装（示例用 web profile；桌面版请把 profile 换成 desktop）
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/qin-yu-1314/dsh-doubao-tts

# 本机没有 git 时，改用 Release 里的压缩包：
#   dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/qin-yu-1314/dsh-doubao-tts/releases/latest/download/dsh-doubao-tts-0.2.2.tgz"
```

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 适用 profile | `web` / `desktop`（桌面版由应用内插件页管理） |
| 最低 DSH 版本 | `>= 0.1.5-rc.2`（需要 slot 系统与 `settings.section`） |
| 许可证 | [MIT](LICENSE) |
| 运行时依赖 | 无（自带 WebSocket 实现，安装期不需要 pnpm 拉任何包） |
| 前置条件 | 火山引擎「大模型语音合成」已开通，需要自己的 API Key 或 App ID + Access Key |

装好后到**侧栏「设置」→「豆包语音合成」**填密钥与音色，点「测试合成」验证。

```
浏览器                    DSH 宿主（插件服务端）              火山引擎
┌──────────────┐  GET    ┌──────────────────────────┐  WSS  ┌────────────────┐
│ 朗读按钮      │ ──────► │ /dsh-doubao-tts/speak     │ ────► │ bidirection v3 │
│ <audio> 播放  │ ◄────── │ ① 按 messageId 取正文     │ ◄──── │ 二进制帧 + 音频 │
└──────────────┘ 音频流   │ ② 合成 ③ 落盘缓存         │       └────────────────┘
                          └──────────────────────────┘
```

## 它做什么

- **客户端半边**：往 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` 这个 slot 注入一个朗读按钮（官方反馈插件用的是同一个 slot）。手写 `__ModuleLoader__` bundle，**不需要构建步骤**，只 `require('react')`，不挑宿主版本。
- **服务端半边**：注册 `/dsh-doubao-tts/*` 路由，按火山 v3 **二进制帧协议**合成音频，边收边以 chunked 流式回给浏览器；同一段文本只付费合成一次（落盘缓存）。
- **取正文**：客户端只传 `sessionId` + `messageId`，服务端优先查活会话（`ctx.sessions`），回落读持久化日志 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<slug>/<sessionId>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` —— 并顺手做朗读清洗（丢掉代码块、去掉 Markdown 记号、URL 换成「链接」）。

## 安装

插件包 = 一个声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` 的 npm 包。**本地目录直接装**：

**方式一（推荐，桌面版）**：侧栏「插件」页 → 添加插件 → 填本目录的绝对路径：

```
C:\Users\wllj\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\tts-plugin\dsh-doubao-tts
```

**方式二（CLI，需要先完全退出 DeepSeek Harness Desktop）**：

```powershell
F:\deepseekharness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add "link:C:\Users\wllj\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\tts-plugin\dsh-doubao-tts"
```

**方式三（应用可以开着跑，不需要 pnpm）**：本插件零运行时依赖，所以只差「一个目录联接 + 两处登记」。脚本默认干跑：

```powershell
node tools/install-local.mjs              # 只打印将要改什么
node tools/install-local.mjs --apply      # 真装（改前备份，失败自动回滚）
node tools/install-local.mjs --uninstall --apply   # 卸载
```

装完后：

| 事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 生效方式 | **新增** bundle 由 HMR 热加载，**不必重启进程**；但**浏览器页面要刷新一次**才会拉取新的客户端 bundle |
| 改代码后 | 替换一个**已加载**包的 JS 需要**重启进程**（HMR 只监听 profile 的 manifest / cordis patch，不监听插件自身文件） |
| 页面表现 | 助手消息动作行（复制/分支那一排）最右边出现喇叭图标；未配凭据时点击显示红色提示，而不是静默失败 |
| 挂载位置 | 本仓库目录就是插件安装源（`link:`）。若以后清理工作区，插件会失效——把它复制到固定目录后重装即可 |

> 本机已按方式一装好并验证过：`profiles/desktop/package.json` 里 dependencies 为 `link:C:/…/dsh-doubao-tts`、`dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾含 `dsh-doubao-tts`，`node_modules` 下是 SymbolicLink；`/dsh-doubao-tts/status` 从装前的 404 变成 401（宿主信任栅栏拦匿名请求）、`/probe` 返回插件自己的 405（GET 打到了 POST 路由的分派器）——都证明服务端半边已在宿主进程里注册成功。

## 自检与排障

插件装载后会写一份**不含任何凭据**的自检报告（`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\doubao-tts-selfcheck.json`），用来回答「到底装上了没有」：

| 字段 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `phase: "loaded"` | 服务端半边进了宿主、5+1 条路由注册完毕 |
| `phase: "status-requested"` | **浏览器里的客户端 bundle 执行了**（它装载时就会拉一次 `/status`），`lastStatusRequest.host` 是那次请求的 Host |
| `phase: "client-registered"` | 客户端把按钮**注册进了 slot**；`clientReport.status` 为 `registered` / `register-failed` / `no-slots-service`，失败时带原因 |
| `fence` | 用的是宿主栅栏还是插件自己的回环校验 |
| `configured` / `missing` | 缺哪个凭据字段 |

按钮不出现时，这份报告能区分三种完全不同的原因：客户端 bundle 没加载（停在 `loaded`）、slot 没声明/注册被拒（`register-failed` + 具体错因）、或只是没配凭据（`configured: false`）。

一键核验（重启或重装后跑一次就有结论）：

```powershell
node tools/verify-install.mjs
```

它检查 profile 登记（`link:` 依赖 + `bundles` + 联接可解析）、自检报告的阶段、以及三条路由的匿名探针，并把每个状态码翻译成人话：

| 探针返回 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `404` | 路由不存在 → 插件服务端没加载 |
| `401` | 路由在，但被宿主信任栅栏拦下（匿名请求本就不该通过，**这是正常的**） |
| `405` | 路由在，且打到了插件自己的方法分派器（GET 打 POST 路由） |
| `200` | 路由在且放行 |

> 早期版本会按宿主 cwd 把自检报告写在 `profiles/desktop/` 目录里；**以 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\doubao-tts-selfcheck.json` 为准**，旧路径那份可以删掉。

## 配置凭据

复制 `volc_tts.env.example` 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\volc_tts.env` 并填写（或改用环境变量）：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `VOLC_API_KEY` | 新版 API Key（与下面一对二选一） |
| `VOLC_APP_ID` + `VOLC_ACCESS_TOKEN` | 老版一对密钥；也接受 `VOLC_ACCESS_KEY` |
| `VOLC_RESOURCE_ID` | **必须与音色所属商品一致**，否则报 `55000000`：合成 2.0 音色用 `seed-tts-2.0`，1.0 公版用 `volc.service_type.10029` |
| `VOLC_SPEAKER` | 音色 ID，控制台音色列表里复制 |

凭据在[火山引擎控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/) → 语音技术 → 大模型语音合成 → 开通管理里获取。改完配置**不用重启**（配置有 5 秒缓存），直接验证：

```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:19387/dsh-doubao-tts/probe -Method POST -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -Expand Content
```

`{"ok":true,"ms":…,"bytes":…}` 就说明通道打通了；失败会回可执行的错误说明（错误码已翻译成中文提示）。

## 路由

| 路由 | 方法 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/status` | GET | 配置是否齐全、音色、格式、缓存统计、日志根目录、`capabilities`（服务端能力清单） |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/settings` | GET/POST | 设置界面用：GET 回显（**密钥只回掩码**）+ 生效值/来源/缓存；POST 原地改写 env 文件 |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/speak` | GET/POST | `?sessionId=&messageId=` 或 `?sessionId=&seq=[&turn=]` 或 `?text=`；返回音频。支持 `voice` `format` `clean=0` `download=1` |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/probe` | POST | 用一句测试文本真实合成一次，验证凭据/音色/网络 |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/client-report` | GET | 客户端半边回执注册结果（落进自检报告） |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/cache` | GET | 缓存条数与占用 |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/cache-clear` | POST | 清空缓存 |

## 设置界面

**侧栏「设置」→「豆包语音合成」**（挂在 `settings.section` 槽，与「通用」「模型」并列）：

| 分组 | 可改项 |
|---|---|
| 鉴权 | API Key / App ID / Access Key / Access Token（密钥是密码框，只显示掩码占位；**留空 = 不修改**） |
| 音色 | Resource ID（下拉：`seed-tts-2.0` / `volc.service_type.10029`）、音色 ID（可手填，下拉给参考值） |
| 音频 | 格式（mp3/pcm/ogg_opus）、采样率、语速、音量 |
| 连接 | WebSocket 端点、是否先发 StartConnection |
| 按钮 | 保存 / 测试合成 / 重新读取 / 清除已保存的密钥 / 清空音频缓存 |
| 状态 | 是否已配置、缺哪些字段、缓存条数与占用、**配置来源文件**、以及会覆盖它的系统环境变量 |

设计要点：

- **写回原文件**：改的是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\volc_tts.env` 本身，**保留注释、行序与其他键**，只动对应的行（先写 `.tmp` 再 rename，原子写）。
- **密钥不回明文**：GET 只回 `{set:true, masked:"••••••••5f53"}`；输入框永远为空、掩码只当占位符，所以保存时不会把掩码写回文件。
- **立即生效**：保存后服务端立刻清掉配置缓存，不用重启、不用刷新页面。
- **能力协商**：客户端 bundle 刷新页面就更新，服务端代码要重启进程才换。`/status` 的 `capabilities` 用来判断当前服务端支持什么，避免「新界面调旧接口」的静默失败。


### 为什么挂两个 slot

| slot | 位置 | 可见性 | 定位参数 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` | 复制/分支那一排图标里 | **默认 `opacity: 0`，悬停才淡入**（ui-chat 的 `[data-actions-reveal=hover]`） | `messageId` |
| `conversation.chat.turnTail` | 同一节点的兄弟 slot | **常显** | `seq`（该助手消息的事件序号）+ `turn` |

只挂第一个等于把入口藏起来（实测反馈「看不到喇叭图标」）；而且**当某一轮正在生成时**，`data-actions-reveal` 会退化成 `hover`（`endsWithResponse` 要求它是时间线上最后一轮），连最近一轮的动作行也要悬停才出现，甚至当前轮根本不渲染动作行。所以第二个 slot 才是真正的入口——它拿不到 `messageId`，只能拿 `seq`，服务端因此也支持按 `seq` 取正文。

`/status` 的 `capabilities` 用于协商：客户端 bundle 随页面刷新立刻更新，而服务端代码要重启进程才换，存在「新客户端 + 旧服务端」的窗口期；此时常显按钮会显示「需要重启一次 DSH」，而不是发一个注定 400 的请求。

错误码：`400 MISSING_PARAMS`、`404 MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND`（附已知 messageId 便于排障）、`404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND`、`422 EMPTY_TEXT`（只有 reasoning/工具调用、没有正文）、`503 NO_CREDENTIALS`、`502 VOLC_ERROR`（带火山原始错误码）、`502 AUTH_FAILED`（上游拒绝密钥，带服务端原话）、`504 ENDPOINT_UNREACHABLE`（连不上火山）。

命令行（不开 GUI）：

```powershell
node tools/probe.mjs                                    # 探针：验证凭据/端点
node tools/probe.mjs --api-key bogus                    # 故意用假密钥，看服务端如何拒绝
node tools/speak-message.mjs --out reply.mp3            # 自动挑最近一条助手消息朗读
node tools/speak-message.mjs --session <id> --seq <n>   # 走 seq 通路（常显按钮同一条路）
node tools/speak-message.mjs --text "你好" --out a.mp3
```

## 真机验证结果（本机）

| 验证项 | 证据 |
|---|---|
| 装进 profile | `dependencies` 为 `link:C:/…/dsh-doubao-tts`，`dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾含包名，`node_modules` 下是符号链接且 `entry.js`/`client/doubao-tts.js` 均可解析 |
| 服务端半边装载 | 装前 `/dsh-doubao-tts/status` 是 **404**，装后是 **401**（宿主栅栏拦匿名请求）；`/probe` 返回插件自己的 **405**（GET 打到 POST 路由的分派器） |
| 客户端半边执行 | 自检报告（宿主 pid 36204）在装载后 **0.06 秒**就记录了来自 `127.0.0.1:19387` 的 `/status` 请求——这个请求只由客户端 bundle 发起 |
| **控件注册成功** | 自检报告 `clientReport.status = "registered"`，`slot = conversation.chat.assistant-actions`，`error = null` |

--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: Agent-initiated restart for DeepSeek Harness: journal, WMI relaunch, automatic continuation after restart. Windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-restart

[English](./README.md) | [中文](./README.zh.md)

Lets DeepSeek Harness (DSH NEXT desktop) pick up unfinished work by itself after the agent restarts the app.

## What problem it solves

Restarting kills the current turn, and a new turn only starts when something triggers it. The usual choices are waiting for the human to speak again or losing context and starting over. This plugin makes restart part of the workflow:

- Record the pending work before restarting; open a fresh turn automatically afterwards, so the user never has to restate it.
- Only agent-initiated restarts trigger this. Closing and reopening the app by hand does nothing.
- The restart tool confirms the helper actually started; if it did not, it reports failure instead of a silent success.

## Compatibility

- Built for DSH NEXT desktop `2.0.17-next` (bundled `@deepseek-ai/*` at `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Windows only: restart relies on PowerShell and WMI.
- The continuation message is queued through host services (`sessionController`, `sessions`). Those are internal interfaces and may change between DSH releases, so re-verify after upgrading. The plugin does not promise compatibility with older DSH versions; when it cannot work it reports an error instead of failing silently.

## Features

### 1. The `restart_harness` tool

- Writes a restart journal (reason, pending work, voice state, session id) and generates an external helper script.
- Creates the helper through WMI so it leaves the app's process tree: wait, kill the app, wait for exit, write a one-shot marker, then relaunch.
- After launching, checks `restart.log` to confirm the helper actually started; otherwise reports failure.

### 2. Automatic continuation after restart

- Five seconds after the app is ready (plugin apply), queues a message with source `restart` into the session and opens a new turn.
- Queued once. No goal, no completion mark, no system-prompt injection. Retries every 3 seconds, up to 6 times.
- The UI renders it as a system notice (“execution requested”), not as a user message.

### 3. Handover to the voice plugin

- Records whether voice mode was on before restart and writes `voice-resume.json` on startup.
- The voice plugin (`dsh-voice-mode-desktop`) reads that file and decides whether to restore voice mode. The two plugins install independently and do not depend on each other.

## Execution flow

1. The agent calls `restart_harness(reason, pending)`; the plugin writes `restart-journal.json`.
2. The plugin generates the helper script and creates the helper process through WMI, outside the app's process tree.
3. The helper waits, kills `DSH NEXT`, waits for exit, writes the one-shot marker `agent-restart.flag`, and relaunches the app.
4. On startup the plugin reads the journal only when the marker exists (manual launches have no marker); it writes `voice-resume.json` for the voice plugin and removes the marker.
5. Five seconds after the app is ready, the plugin queues the source-`restart` continuation message and opens a new turn.
6. The agent finishes the pending work and reports; the journal becomes `continued`.

## Integration with the voice plugin

Before restarting, the plugin records the voice state (on/off, active session id) in the journal. After restart it writes `voice-resume.json`; the voice plugin reads it on startup and restores voice mode when needed, then acknowledges and deletes the file.

So voice state survives the restart: if it was on before, it is on afterwards and you can hold to speak. Only agent-initiated restarts use this path; manual launches do not auto-restore. If the voice plugin is not installed, restart still works without voice restoration.

## Why not in-app relaunch or a community restart plugin

Restarting in-process via Electron's relaunch looks cleanest, but it is unreachable here: the plugin runs in a host subprocess without the Electron `app` object. The renderer does expose a restart command, but it shows a native confirmation dialog and must be relayed through the UI. Removing the dialog would mean patching DSH's main process — platform core, overwritten by upgrades, not worth it.

Community restart plugins were evaluated too: they ship their own watchdog process plus a token-protected HTTP route, wrapping the external-process approach in more moving parts and requiring per-version adaptation. The cost outweighs the benefit.

That leaves an external helper process created through WMI: the only restart path verified to work on this machine, and it leaves DSH core untouched so the plugin can be updated independently.

## Known limitations

- Restart needs a path outside the app's process tree; spawning directly from the host is unreliable on this machine, so the tool reports that failure and points at the external WMI call.
- Windows only.
- Voice restoration only happens when the voice plugin is installed.

## Install

Requirements: Windows, DSH NEXT desktop `2.0.17-next`, PowerShell and WMI available.

Option A (recommended):

1. Install the npm package: `npm install @nutshelllee/dsh-agent-restart` (or add it to the DSH profile dependencies).
2. Add `- id: agent-restart, name: "@nutshelllee/dsh-agent-restart"` to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` insert list.
3. Restart DSH; `restart_harness` appears in the tool list.

Option B (local development): link this repository into `node_modules/@nutshelllee/dsh-agent-restart` of the profile, then follow steps 2 and 3.

## License

MIT, see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.description: Agent tools and a loopback REST API for DSH session housekeeping: list, move across workspaces, delete with backup, tag, archive and unarchive.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-manager

Agent tools and a loopback REST API for DSH session housekeeping — list, move across workspaces, delete with an optional backup, tag, archive and unarchive.

DSH's own GUI covers only part of this surface (it can archive, but not unarchive; it has no tags; cross-workspace moves need a restart). This plugin puts the whole surface on two rails that share one implementation:

- **Agent tools** — six tools the model can call directly.
- **Loopback REST API** — the same six operations over HTTP, so a browser plugin can drive them without an IPC bridge. [`dsh-session-tree`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-tree) uses this to render tags, drag-and-drop and the archive menu in the sidebar.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| Runtime | Node.js 22+ (ships with the DSH desktop runtime) |

Earlier DSH releases are untested. The plugin reads `workspaceRegistry`, `sessionPersistence`, `storageDomain` and `webServer`; a release that renames or removes any of those will make the corresponding feature fail soft (logged as a warning) rather than crash the host.

## Install

```bash
# from git (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:minhaoli/dsh-session-manager

# or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-manager
```

`<your-profile>` is the profile you actually boot — `desktop` for the Electron app, `web` / `headless` / `node` for the CLI modes. The `desktop` profile is managed by the Electron app and refuses `dsh` CLI writes while the app is running; install into it from the app's own plugin manager, or close the app first.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` also appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` and the loader mounts it on the next start. If you installed by hand, add the row yourself:

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: session-manager
      name: 'dsh-session-manager'
```

## Agent tools

All six take JSON arguments and return `{ ok: true, ... }` or `{ ok: false, error }`.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `session_list` | Enumerate persisted sessions with workspace, archive state, tags and title. Filters: `workspaceId`, `path`, `archived`, `tag`. |
| `session_move` | Move sessions across workspaces. Rewrites the log header `cwd` and renames the directory on disk, then updates the registry live — the GUI reflects it without a restart. |
| `session_delete` | Permanently delete sessions and their log directories. Pass `backupDir` to copy each directory first. |
| `session_tag` | `set` / `add` / `remove` / `clear` / `drop` / `list` tags. Stored in `~/.dsh/session-tags.json`. |
| `session_archive` | Hide a session from every grouping surface; log and workspace slot preserved. Idempotent. |
| `session_unarchive` | Restore an archived session to its original position — the direction the GUI is missing. |

Live sessions (the conversation the model is currently running in) are refused by `session_move` and `session_delete`.

## REST API

Registered only when the `webServer` service is present (the `web` and `desktop` modes). Every handler funnels through the corresponding tool's `execute`, so both surfaces behave identically.

Every request is fenced by `isLoopbackRequest(req)` — a non-loopback peer gets `403 {"error":"forbidden: loopback-only"}`. There is no token; the fence is the transport, not a credential. Do not expose the DSH web server beyond localhost while this plugin is mounted.

| Method | Path | Body / query |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions` | — |
| `GET` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/tags` | — |
| `PUT` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/tags` | `{ "sessionId": "...", "tags": ["a","b"] }` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/tags` | `{ "tags": ["a"] }` — drops those tags from every session |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/move` | `{ "sessionIds": [...], "targetWorkspaceId": "..." }` or `{ ..., "targetPath": "...", "createIfMissing": true }` |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/delete` | `{ "sessionIds": [...], "backupDir": "..." }` (`backupDir` optional) |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/archive` | `{ "sessionId": "..." }` |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/unarchive` | `{ "sessionId": "..." }` |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/projcache/warm` | — (diagnostics: returns the title warm-up report) |

Status codes: `200` when the tool returned `ok: true`, `400` for a business failure or a malformed body, `403` off-loopback, `405` wrong method, `500` unexpected throw.

Request bodies are capped at 1 MB and must be JSON objects.

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/dsh-session-manager/tags
curl -s -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/dsh-session-manager/tags \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"sessionId":"abc123","tags":["research","todo"]}'
```

## Behaviour worth knowing

**Moves keep three things in sync.** The physical move (zstd header rewrite plus directory rename) is followed by a registry header re-index and the public `attachSession` / `detachSession` calls, and the projection cache's `identity.cwd` is updated through the storage-domain table handle. Skipping any of the three leaves the GUI showing a stale path.

**Titles are pre-warmed at startup.** `session.list` carries no title for a cold session; the durable title lives in the projection-cache checkpoint, which is only written when a session was attached in some process. After a restart every unopened session is cold and the sidebar falls back to the directory basename. 800 ms after mount the plugin walks persisted sessions lacking a title row and calls the official `coldSnapshot(meta, inheritedEventCount, events)` to write the checkpoint back.

The tail probe that validates an existing title row is **off** (`WARM_TAIL_PROBE = false` in `lib/index.js`). With it on, every start re-read the log tail of all sessions — the dominant cost of a slow sidebar after a restart, at roughly 620 sessions. The trade-off: a rename that happened during a projection-cache write failure window is no longer corrected at startup; the official cold-read ladder still heals it when the session is opened. Set the constant to `true` to restore the old behaviour.

**Archive goes through the registry.** Archiving funnels through `archiveSession()` — the same add-only API the GUI uses. The plugin never rewrites the archive set except on an explicit delete or unarchive, and even then it goes through the registry's public `enqueueOperation` / `setState` write chain so the registry's cached state stays coherent.

**Zero imports by design.** `lib/index.js` uses only `node:` builtins. The file plugin is loaded by native dynamic import, so a bare specifier would have to resolve from the profile's `node_modules`; the builtin-only rule keeps it loadable as a standalone file plugin (the same shape as `zen-useragent.js`).

## Companion plugins

- [`dsh-session-tree`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-tree) — the sidebar UI (tags, grouping, drag-to-move, delete) that consumes this REST API. It replaces the official `ui-workspace` bundle, so disable that row when both are installed.
- [`dsh-session-query-vector`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-query-vector) — semantic session search backend.
- [`dsh-session-search`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-search) — in-conversation find bar.
- [`dsh-ui-reload`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-ui-reload) — one-click frontend reload button.
